entries.name: Gather a Key Fragment
entries.description:
Daily Adventure: Collect a Delve Shadowkey Fragment from completing dungeons in Prime Uber worlds.

This Adventure gives experience and is only available for 24 hours.

entries.name: Gather an Ore
entries.description:
Daily Adventure: Collect any ore to complete this adventure.

This Adventure gives experience and is only available for 24 hours.

entries.name: Upgrade a Gem
entries.description:
Daily Adventure: Attempt to upgrade a gem to complete this adventure.

This Adventure gives experience and is only available for 24 hours.

entries.name: Complete an Adventure
entries.description:
Daily Adventure: Complete an adventure to earn this bonus reward. Adventures can be acquired from friendly creatures on Luminopolis Outposts, Geode Topside landing pads, Clubs, or the Geode Hub.

This Adventure gives experience and is only available for 24 hours.

entries.name: Complete a Challenge
entries.description:
Daily Adventure: Complete an hourly challenge. Challenge are available for the first 20 minutes of every hour. Finish all three tiers to complete this adventure.

This Adventure gives experience and is only available for 24 hours.

entries.name: Complete a Dungeon
entries.description:
Daily Adventure: Complete any Dungeon to complete this adventure. Dungeons can be found in Adventure worlds.

This Adventure gives experience and is only available for 24 hours.

entries.name: Trigger Magic Find
entries.description:
Daily Adventure: Trigger magic find by finding equipment.

This Adventure gives experience and is only available for 24 hours.

entries.name: Invite Bunfest
entries.description:
Daily Adventure: Trigger magic find by finding equipment.

This Adventure gives experience and is only available for 24 hours.

entries.name: Go Fishing
entries.description: Any fish or boots will work! Talk to Saltwater Sam in a Drowned World to get started.

entries.name: Defeat Radiant Giants
entries.description: Travel to the Radiant Ruins world and defeat Radiant Giants. They appear on floating islands to guard the Crystalized Clouds that accumulate there, but something has gotten into them lately...

entries.name: Defeat 3 Delve Bosses
entries.description: Dive down deep into a Delve and defeat 3 of the bosses within.

entries.name: Collect Water Gem Boxes
entries.description: Collect Water Gem Boxes from Drowned Worlds. Water Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

entries.name: Collect Air Gem Boxes
entries.description: Collect Air Gem Boxes from Cursed Skylands. Air Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

entries.name: Collect Fire Gem Boxes
entries.description: Collect Fire Gem Boxes from Igneous Islands. Fire Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

entries.name: Collect Cosmic Gem Boxes
entries.description: Collect Cosmic Gem Boxes from Geode Topside worlds. Cosmic Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

entries.name: Collect a Chaos Chest
entries.description: Obtain a Chaos Chest from creatures or dungeons in Adventure Worlds. Remember, I only count looted chests.

entries.name: Trigger Magic Find
entries.description: Club Adventure

entries.name: Collect Tainted Stars
entries.description: For the fallen stars, help them come home. The Moon Goddess's will lives in all her stars. Q'bthulhu shall not have them.
entries.summary: The Sun Acolyte seeks your aid to collect more stars.

entries.name: Earn a Bomber Royale Coin
entries.description: Yo bro! You look like you're the bomb at bombin'. How about you hop into Bomber Royale and show everyone what's up. If you can earn a coin at all I'll even throw in a bonus!
entries.summary: Prove your worth and earn a Bomber Royale Coin in Bomber Royale.

entries.name: Find Hidden Eggs
entries.description: Bunfest Daily Adventure: I'm Liv and I've hidden eggs all over the place, Trovian! Can you find them? I'll give you a hint. I'm a fan of Faeries, a candy fiend, and I love the knights of old. I also threw them all over the Geode Topside, for good measure.

entries.name: Defeat Egg Dungeons
entries.description: Bunfest Daily Adventure: Those dang Shadowy Buns are going after Liv's hidden Eggs. You can find their bases anywhere her eggs are hidden: Geode Topside, Medieval Highlands, Candoria, and the Fae Forest.

entries.name: Make a Donation
entries.description: Bunfest Daily Adventure: Donate to the cause Trovian. Help us fend off the Shadowy Buns by donating any excess chocolate you find at the Bunfest Bench here in the hub!

entries.name: Complete an Egghunt
entries.description: Bunfest Daily Adventure: It's not all Shadowy Buns and fighting. Sometimes you need to just have fun and enjoy Bunfest. Find one of Bunsly's egghunts and let loose a little.

entries.name: Time to pack this stocking full!
entries.description: Let’s see how many treasures we can squeeze in.. or out.

rewards.name: Wait, did a tiny present just fall out of the stocking?

entries.name: Oh is that a snowflake?!
entries.description: Straight into the album it goes!

entries.name: Tinkersly needs your help!
entries.description: You are reindeer sent, please help me out! Deckryn ran off to chase the snowflakes again, and I just can't wrap the parcels the right way.
entries.summary: Please use Jollywrapper Mk.2 and wrap a parcel or two.

entries.description: Defeat 10 Dungeon Bosses in any Trove biome.

entries.name: Mine Primordial Flame
entries.description: Mine 70 Primordial Flame in any Trove Adventure World.

entries.name: Complete 3-Star Dungeons
entries.description: Complete 3 3-Star Dungeons in any Trove biome.

entries.name: Mine Shapestone

entries.name: Defeat Enemies
entries.description: Defeat 40 enemies in any Trove Adventure World.

entries.name: Acquire Uncommon Trovian Ore
entries.description: Acquire 1600 Primordial Flame, Formicite Ore, or Infinium Ore in any Trovian Adventure World. (Cannot be acquired via Trading Post or the Marketplace)

entries.name: Acquire Cinnabar
entries.description: Acquire 700 Cinnabar ore. (Cannot be acquired via Trading Post or the Marketplace)

entries.name: Acquire Fire Gem, Air Gem, and Water Gem Boxes
entries.description: Acquire 20 Fire Gem, Air Gem, or Water Gem Boxes from Cursed Skylands, Igneous Islands, and Drowned Worlds.

entries.name: Defeat Dungeon Bosses
entries.description: Defeat 30 Dungeon Bosses in any Trove Adventure World.

entries.name: Find SALTWATER SAM in the LONG SHADE
entries.description:
RISING TIDE 1/13: Trovian! The denizens of the Depths have arisen! My crew and I have been exploring the LONG SHADE, and they are absolutely everywhere! When you're ready to help, come find us at our ship; recognizable as an OUTPOST on the Map [HK:Map].

Using the ATLAS [HK:Atlas], you can find the Long Shade Adventure World far to the left. With enough LIGHT and POWER RANK, you can enter and begin your search for SALTWATER SAM.

entries.name: Defeat Denizens from the DEPTHS
entries.description:
RISING TIDE 2/13: Have you seen them yet? Enemies from THE DEPTHS have poured over all of the Biomes here in the Long Shade. My crew is working with Qubesly to study and respond-to this threat, and we need your help!

First things first: we need to hit them back! Find DEPTHS creatures all throughout the Long Shade and take them out!

entries.name: Speak with FRESHWATER FRAN
entries.description:
RISING TIDE 3/13: Nice work! They aren't so tough, are they? While I'm focusing on the battle strategy, Freshwater Fran and Qubesly have been working together to try to figure out the bigger picture. She mentioned she could used some help.

Speak with her to see what she needs, she's here on my ship!

entries.name: Collect DEPTHS HARVESTS
entries.description:
RISING TIDE 4/13: Why hello! Sam said you might be able to help me. It's not just the violence visiting our lands up from the Depths, but also their flora! Sam says it's not important, but I'm convinced there's more to the story here than meets the eye.

You can help me research the root cause of this Depths incursion by collecting Depths-specific harvests, found here in the Long Shade.
Each biome has its own new type of fauna to be harvested.

entries.name: Defeat 5-STAR DEPTHS Dungeons
entries.description:
RISING TIDE 5/13: Did you and Fran get your science done? Good, because we've got a big problem! We've come across large, 5-star dungeons filled with Depths all over the Long Shade!

You know what to do, Trovian: destroy!

entries.name: Speak with FRESHWATER FRAN
entries.description: RISING TIDE 6/13: Fran says she has a lead on what is causing this mess. Speak with her to learn what we need to do next.

entries.name: Obtain a Depth Stepper for THE DEPTHS
entries.description:
RISING TIDE 7/13: Hello, again! I'm glad you're back. I have a lead on who we might be able to speak to within the Depths faction: The Herald of the Deep Kraken!

He resides in THE DEPTHS, a Delve biome. You need a Depth Stepper: The Depths to find him. Mr. Thommas Tortoise sells them, but Sam says his Depths Workbench is also capable of making them.

entries.name: Find the HERALD of the DEEP KRAKEN
entries.description: RISING TIDE 8/13: Now that you've got the Depth Stepper, you can make our connection with the real decision-makers for the Depths. The Herald of the Deep Kraken can be found in The Depths Delves. He can be found along-side the Runic Depths Vault. Go make an introduction!

entries.name: Give Tribute to the Herald
entries.description:
RISING TIDE 9/13: A tribute? Of course... Well, I guess we'll have to play the game.

As for obtaining those fish, Murkwater Mark here on the ship may be able to help, he's been fishing non-stop since we got here!

Using a Depth Stepper: The Depths, find the Herald of the Deep Kraken, and give the Tribute he demands:
- 1 x Abyssal Squid
- 1 x Krakenspawn
- 1 x Pyric Jellyfish
- 1 x Zephyr Manta

entries.name: Destroy KRAKEN EGGS in the LONG SHADE
entries.description:
RISING TIDE 10/13: Hello, again, Trovian. Great work with the Tribute, but attacks from the Depths continue unabated. Fran is working on theory, but you and I have a new problem to deal with. Kraken eggs have been popping up in Dungeons in the Long Shade--this is a clear escalation of the invasion, and we need them destroyed A.S.A.P.!

You may want to use some Zephyr Runes while doing this, just to stay safe.

entries.name: Obtain a Depth Stepper for the DEEP KRAKEN
entries.description: RISING TIDE 11/13: Your efforts are appreciated. Now, we need to stop this issue at its source. That's right, it's time to defeat the DEEP KRAKEN. It lives in the deepest Depths of the Delves. Reports say the Herald of the Deep Kraken is somehow linked to obtaining a Depth Stepper, but I don't have any information beyond that!

entries.name: Defeat the DEEP KRAKEN
entries.description: RISING TIDE 12/13: Place and use the Depth Stepper: Deep Kraken, then enter the Delve and make your way to the Deep Kraken... and destroy it.

entries.name: Return to Saltwater Sam in the LONG SHADE
entries.description: RISING TIDE 13/13: Amazing! It was that easy for you?! Please, return to the LONG SHADE and find my ship so I can give you your reward!

entries.name: Speak with FRESHWATER FRAN
entries.description: A FRANTASTIC PLAN 1/5: Fran's work continues, she'll want to update you as soon as you're free to chat with her.

entries.name: Collect LICHENSTONE
entries.description:
A FRANTASTIC PLAN 2/5: Despite your defeat of the Deep Kraken, the underlying causes for the invasion are unsolved. It turns out that for years, Trovians have over-fished water creatures across Trove, leaving the denizens of the Depths dangerously under-fed.

While I don't think there's anything I could say to Mark to get him to put down his pole, you and I can still make a difference... But we'll need some Lichenstone to get started!

entries.name: Craft Sea Lichen Spores
entries.description:
A FRANTASTIC PLAN 3/5: We need to help repopulate the Waters of Trove with life. Many lower-level fish feed on Sealichen, which once only occupied the deepest depths. Now, with the Depths denizens rising, this 'fish food' has started popping up in shallow waters, as well.

After crafting Lichenstone Sea Spores at Sam's Depths Workbench here on the ship, throw some into any body of water to help revitalize the Water ecosystem the denizens of the Depths rely upon.

entries.name: Throw Sea Lichen Spores into WATER FISH POOLS
entries.description:
A FRANTASTIC PLAN 4/5: After crafting Sea Lichen Spores, throw some into a POOL of FISH in LONG SHADE WATER to help revitalize the ecosystem upon which the denizens of the Depths rely. You can craft additional spores each day to further our work.

Thank you, Trovian, for doing the right thing!

entries.name: Return to FRAN
entries.description:
A FRANTASTIC PLAN 5/5: It's a great first step, Trovian! You've given me hope that we can tackle this problem.
Please return to me for a little reward, and keep up the good work!

entries.name: Defeat 100 Enemies
entries.description:
Be brave, be bold.
Defeat enemies all across Trove!

entries.name: Complete a Delve
entries.description:
Find a way through the darkness!
Go into the depths, and complete a Delve.
entries.summary: Go into the depths, and complete a Delve.

entries.name: Complete a 3-Star Dungeons
entries.description:
Show how you endure!
Go forth and defeat Dungeons.

entries.name: Duke
entries.description: Pet the puppy.

entries.name: Gnasher
entries.description: Pet the puppy.

entries.name: Butter
entries.description: Pet the puppy.

entries.name: Post Cowboy Conquest Posters
entries.description:
Dinoboy Daily Adventure: Grrooooooowohhhhh!

It would seem that the creature wants you to place Cowboy Conquest Posters in the Jurassic Jungle. It might be best to do what a large lizard wants before it gets angry.

Go to the Jurassic Jungle and throw Cowboy Conquest Posters onto the Poster Stumps you see there.

entries.name: Post Dino Dominance Posters
entries.description:
Cowasaur Daily Adventure: Just. Imagine. Scales. Not. Metal. Shade. The. Jungle. Must. Be. A. Paradise

Go to the Desert Frontier and throw Dino Dominance Posters onto the Poster Stumps you see there.
entries.summary: A. Jungle. That. Protects. You. From. The. Sun. How. Nice. Would. That. Be?....

entries.name: Defeat Dungeons in the Jurassic Jungle
entries.description:
Cowasaur Daily Adventure: Click click clack, clack click crunch.

It would seem that this crustacean has survived being poached in an adventure in the Jurassic Jungle. You should go and find some of the dungeons where the enemies of the Jurassic Jungle have made home.

entries.name: Defeat Enemies of the Jurassic Jungle
entries.description: Cowasaur Daily Adventure: Huffaw, how could anyone be an enemy of such a majestic creature. Dinosaurs are something to behold. You know what isn't, the criminals that would poach them or the crazed predators that hunt them. How about you go into the Jurassic Jungle and clear out a safe place for the more peaceful dinos?
entries.summary: The law can be quite, prickly.

entries.name: Defeat Dungeons in the Desert Frontier
entries.description:
Dinoboy Daily Adventure: Neeerrrr auhhhhh.

The triceratop hands you a map of enemy locations in the Desert Frontier. You should head there immediately and protect the cowboys there from the villians by defeating their dungeon homes.

entries.name: Defeat Enemies of the Desert Frontier
entries.description:
Dinoboy Daily Adventure: Scrrriii Yrrrllllll.

The quite armed but still reformed predator seems to have an itchy trigger finger. It would seem it wants you to defeat the enemies of the Desert Frontier. How wise would it be to ignore the orders of an armed reformed predator?

entries.name: Defeat Sunfest Cake Enemies
entries.description:
The cakes of candoria have risen up, put them in their place.

Defeat Sunfest cake enemies in Candoria and Cake Dungeons.
entries.summary: Cakes shouldn't be fighting, they should be eaten!

entries.name: Defeat Sunfest Cake Dungeons
entries.description:
Cakes too big to be eaten, what a waste of resources.

Defeat Sunfest Cake dungeons found all over Trove.
entries.summary: Baking cakes too large should be illegal!

entries.name: Defeat Sunfest Delves
entries.description:
That Chuck Pinzo scam artist's clones still roam the Delves. Get in there, find him, and defeat him or anything else in your way.

Defeat a Sunfest Delve. Gateways can be purchased from any of the House Quartermasters in the Events area of the Hub.
entries.summary: Pinzo remains a problem in the Delves....

entries.name: Defeat Sunfest Cake Dungeons
entries.description: Clear out the Cake Dungeons in ADVENTURE WORLDS so it's safe for House Panatea to mine the Fluxyattium needed to repair the Radiant Standards!
entries.summary: Clear the dungeons so we can extract Fluxyattium!

entries.name: Bring Somber Souls to the House Carys Sunfest Bench
entries.description: Collect Somber Souls across Trove and bring them to the House Carys Crafting Bench. They use the souls as a catalyst to refine the light energy needed to repair the Radiant Standards.
entries.summary: Bring Somber Souls to the House Carys Sunfest Bench to refine into light!

entries.name: Defeat Pinata Invaders
entries.description:
House Tysorion needs your help hunting down the Pinata Invaders that sometimes fall from the sky, or emerge after completing Dungeons. With your help, we can finally repair the Radiant Standards.

Defeat Dungeons across Trove and slay the Pinata Invaders that emerge from them.
entries.summary: Defeat Pinata Invaders that emerge after Dungeons.

entries.name: Your homework is due tomorrow!
entries.description:
Trovian! Check your claims, you should have gotten 5 assignments. Please do your utmost best to complete them before tomorrow! Any unfinished assignments will expire, and your study score will be reduced.

Go find a way to deal with all 5 assignments before time runs out!

rewards.name: Helmet style Unlocker: Top of the Class

entries.name: Talk to Bubs to learn about Building
entries.description: Side Quest: Building Expertise - Talk to Bubs in the Trove Hub to learn about building in Trove. You can find Bubs on the roof of the Crafting Corner.

entries.name: Place 20 Blocks
entries.description:
Qubesly says you're ready to learn about building. Well, I'll be the judge of that.

Find a good place and lay down 20 blocks.  Anywhere will do, but maybe you'd like to spruce up your Cornerstone?

entries.name: Open a Builder's Crafting Bench
entries.description:
You sure did place those blocks. Great.

Next up, Builder's Crafting bench. You may have one of those handy in your cornerstone or in your Club. If you don't already have one, no problem.

You can craft a Builder's Crafting Bench from your Novice Crafting Bench and then place it your Cornerstone or Club World. Once you have the bench placed, get close, and press [HK:Loot] to open it.

entries.name: Open a Highlands Workbench
entries.description: Alright, this is just like building TREA furniture, we are onto the next step... Did I not tell you Qubesly gave me these steps?\n\nAnyway, Check to see if you have a Highlands Workbench. If not, you can find it in the Blocks and Decorative section of your Builder's Crafting Bench. Put down your new Highlands Workbench somewhere convenient in your Cornerstone or Club World, then press [HK:Loot] to open it.

entries.name: Craft a Decoration at the Highlands Workbench
entries.description:
Oh look at that, it says here, 'There is a crafting bench specific to each biome, each filled with unique Decorations for your Cornerstone and Club World'. I wonder if Qubesly wrote this himself.

Anyway, just LOOK at all these decorations! Any one of these would make your Cornerstone look so much better, no offense. Pick something that suits your style and Craft it. Personally, I think a bookshelf would look nice, but whatever floats your boat.

entries.name: Place the Highlands Decoration
entries.description:
Honestly, I was a bit suspect when Qubesly asked for me to take you under my wing, but you've impressed me so far. What a lovely piece of furniture.

Now open your Crafting inventory and place that into your Cornerstone or Club World to really jazz up the place. Adding Decorations is a great way to make your space YOUR space, if you catch my drift.

entries.name: Collect a Fae Recipe Scroll
entries.description:
Alright enough of this, Qubesly says it's time to get your learn on.

Enter a Fae Wilds world and complete a Recipe Dungeon to gain a Fae Recipe. Recipe Dungeons are easy to find, they are marked by a scroll on top of the main structure as well as on the map, boom.

entries.name: Learn a new Fae Recipe
entries.description: Got it in one.\n\nInteract with the Recipe Scroll from your inventory to learn a new recipe.

entries.name: Open a Fun Factory Bench
entries.description:
According to the notes I have 'Once a recipe is learned you will always be able to craft that Decoration so long as you have the materials'. Of course, everyone knows that.

What's, next, what's next? Let me put on my reading glasses. Okay. Qubesly said its time for you to learn about Special Blocks and the Fun Factory. Now we are getting to the good stuff. Check your benches to see if you have a Fun Factory, and if not craft a Fun Factory from the Interactive section of your Builder's Crafting Bench, place it, and open it.

entries.name: Craft 3 Music Blocks
entries.description: Trovian, its about time to get funky up in here. The Fun Factory is where you can make music blocks, among other things. Craft a few up for me and get ready to rock out.

entries.name: Place 3 Music Blocks
entries.description: Time to face the music. Get it? little pun there for you. Place 3 Music Blocks in your Cornerstone or Club World and feel free to enjoy a small jam session.

entries.name: Craft a Vertical Launchpad
entries.description:
Killer tunes, really, I'm inspired.

In other exciting news, there are all sorts of fun blocks in the factory. There are blocks that shoot off fireworks, blocks that blow air upwards for your wings, and many more.

Craft a Vertical Launchpad at the Fun Factory and see what its all about.

entries.name: Place the Vertical Launchpad
entries.description: Place the Vertical Launchpad in your Cornerstone or Club World and step on it, it's actually a lot of fun. Oh and Qubesly also wanted me to say 'Don't worry friend, you can always pick it up again if you want to put it somewhere else instead.' So, I guess, keep that in mind.

entries.name: Craft and place 20 Mag Rail tracks
entries.description: Now we are getting into the real bread and butter of my craft. Magrails are the fastest way to get around, and honestly, they are really underrated in my humble opinion.\n\nMag Rails are craftable from the Fun Factory.

entries.name: Throw 10 Bombs
entries.description: Now that you know how to build, its time to learn about 'controlled' demolition. I hooked you up with 10 bombs, but you can make more at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench. Open your inventory and pull them onto your action bar. Activate and bombs away!

entries.name: Jump For Joy!
entries.description:
Trovian, you did it. You now know everything I do and are ready to build with the best. *Grumbles* Qubesly owes me for this.

Anyway, Qubesly asked me to give you this mount to remind you of your power to create and destroy. Jump 10 times and I'll hand it over. How high you say? I'm not sure what it matters but, I guess, give it your all.

entries.name: Talk to Saltwater Sam about Fishing
entries.description:
Side Quest 1/19: Talk to Saltwater Sam to learn about fishing in Trove. You can find Saltwater Sam in the Fishing Grotto under the Crafter's Corner.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

entries.name: Get a Fishing Pole
entries.description:
2/19: Ahoy Trovian. If you didn't know, fishing is the only thing a pirrot enjoys more than plundering. In fact, plundering is mostly just a way to be able to fish more! Don't squawk it until you try it. First you're going to need a fishing pole, lucky for you I've got one with your name on it!

Buy and equip the Basic Fishing Pole from Saltwater Sam or equip a Fishing pole you already have.

entries.name: Buy a Lure from Saltwater Sam
entries.description: 3/19: Now a fishing pole is just part of the recipe for a great fishing adventure. Next you'll need a Lure, otherwise all you're gonna catch is boots, and they ain't worth much. Lucky for you I sell those too.

entries.name: Use a Lure
entries.description: 4/19: Perfect. Now Lures are simple. Once you use them they'll last till you've caught enough fish or until they wear out. That's why I catch as many as I can as fast as I can so that I don't waste 'em. Hurry up and use the Lure so we can start fishing!

entries.name: Catch a Fish
entries.description:
5/19: Fishing is all about patience, which can make it hard on a lotta folks. But it really is easy. Just cast your line, wait for the bobber to start, well, bobbing, and reel the line in. It's probably easier to just try it out for yourself.

Just press [HK:Fish] while looking at some water, there should be some of that real close by. Wait for the bobber to start jumping up and down, and when it does press [HK:Fish] again to reel the fish in.

entries.name: Catch more Fish
entries.description: 6/19: Wonderful, we'll make a master Angler out of you yet! Now that you've got the hang of it, catch a few more!

entries.name: Talk to Murkwater Mark in the Hub
entries.description:
7/19: You're really getting the hang of it. So now that you've mastered the basics we can 'reel in' some help. Caw, get it, 'reel in', ka-caw that's a good one. Don't worry, the more you fish the more you'll like that kinda thing, it just comes with all the 'floundering' around, and it never goes 'trout' of style.

Anyway, it's about time you found out about the Pond of Power. It's the, honestly ominous looking statue fountain thingy sitting next to the large blue crab creature in the Fishing Grotto in the Hub. Don't worry they're not too pinchy, but they can get 'crabby' from time to time. Before we use the Pond of Power you'll need some Trophies of the Depths, so talk to Murkwater Mark so we can buy some.

entries.name: Buy a Trophy of the Depths
entries.description: 8/19: I gave you some Marks of the Angler, that's because I knew Mark would want them. They'll sell anything they can to get ahold of those marks, though I don't know why. Buy a Trophy of the Depths so we can unlock the secrets of the Depths.

entries.name: Upgrade a Depths of the Angler Bubble
entries.description:
9/19: Now that you have that, it's time to put it to good use. The Pond of Power lets us tap into the Depths of the Angler. Before you ask, I have no idea what is going on here. I just fished this thing up and Murkwater Mark showed up later. Atypical to normal Pirrot fashion, I'm just happy it wasn't too violent a meeting.

Interact with the Pond of Power and select the Bubble next to the starting yellow one. Use the Trophy of the Depths and upgrade it to obtain some power from the Depths.

entries.name: Fish for a Mark of the Angler
entries.description: 10/19: Alright, you look a little, tingly, do you feel tingly? Well I felt tingly after I did that, so I really just wanted to let you know the tingly feeling was normal. Regardless of tingles, now you have the Aura of the Angler. Now when you fish you should find Marks of the Angler from time to time. Go ahead and try it out.

entries.name: Upgrade more Bubbles
entries.description: 11/19: Awesome Trovian, you're a real 'shark' when it comes to fishing, ca-caw, I got a million of 'em.  Well now that you've got some more Marks of the Angler you can get more Trophies fo the Depths, so grab a few and upgrade some more Bubbles, if you want.

entries.name: Talk to Freshwater Fran
entries.description: 12/19: Easy as fishing. Well, you might have noticed that there's a new face in the Grotto. Freshwater Fran is at the helm of the ship and has new special orders for you to fill. Talk to her and buy one of them so we can get back to the real stuff, fishing!

entries.name: Buy a Special Order
entries.description: 13/19: The Aura of the Angler might give you a few Marks of the Angler, but Freshwater Fran's how I get most of mine. Buy one of her orders and we'll get to work.

entries.name: Use a Special Order
entries.description: 14/19: To start one is easy, open your inventory and find it, then use it to add the task to your Adventure log.

entries.name: Catch a fish from a Pool
entries.description:
15/19: Now, that should be tracked in the Adventures journal under 'Trovian Agency'. You can set it to show if you want, but you'll make progress either way. Fran's orders are always to go fishing in pools, which I haven't shown you yet. So let's get to it!

Pools can appear in water, plasma, chocolate, or even lava. I tend to stick to water, but to each their own. They appear as little circular gatherings of fish. Fishing from them is easy, just cast your line in them and reel in when the bobber moves. I'd suggest the Treasure Isles if you wanna find one fast.

entries.name: Complete a Special Order
entries.description:
16/19: Pool fishing is really my favorite. Now that you've figured out pools let's complete that order and get to the last bits I have to teach ya.

Remember to use another lure if yours runs out, you'll be 'trout' of luck and fishing up boots if you forget.

adventures.name: Catch Common Fish From Water Pools
Catch Common Fish From Lava Pools
Catch Common Fish From Chocolate Pools
Catch Common Fish From Plasma Pools
Catch Uncommon Fish From Water Pools
Catch Uncommon Fish From Lava Pools
Catch Uncommon Fish From Chocolate Pools
Catch Uncommon Fish From Plasma Pools
Catch A Rare Fish From Water Pools
Catch A Rare Fish From Lava Pools
Catch A Rare Fish From Chocolate Pools
Catch A Rare Fish From Plasma Pools

entries.name: Talk to Saltwater Sam
entries.description:
17/19: Now you should have gotten some Marks of the Angler from Fran, she's got a ton of 'em so don't worry about her running out. Head back and talk to me in the hub to get to the last thing I've got to show ya.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

entries.name: Unlock a Big Bubble
entries.description: 18/19: I've nearly taught you all there is to teach. The tadpole is nearly a frog so to speak. So I sent you the last thing that's really important about the Depths of the Angler, a Key to the Depths. You might have noticed that some of the bigger Bubbles aren't accessible in the Depths of the Angler. That's because you need a Key to the Depths to unlock access to them. Click on a Big Bubble and Unlock them to gain access to more power from the Depths.

entries.name: Catch some Fish
entries.description:
19/19: Well that's it Trovian. That's all I know, whatever's left you'll have to learn on your own by delving into the Depths of the Angler. If you manage to get deeper than me, then feel free to squawk on by and teach me a few things. For now though, let's just enjoy fishing together a little longer.

And if your inventory fills up too much while you're fishing, remember you can loot collect or compost the fish. If you're lucky enough to get a trophy, you can place it proudly for all to see, or just compost it as well. It's your prize, so I'm not going 'krill'-zy over it.

entries.name: Reach 50 Mastery
entries.description: Reach 50 Mastery to unlock access the Fluxion merchant.

entries.name: Interact with Fluxion
entries.description: Greetings all Trovians, Luxion has given me the task of asking all of you what you'd like access to from their hoard. I'll be with my voting box near Luxion's Landing in the hub on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Stop on by and you can either vote on what I bring the next week or purchase the winning items.I'd love to meet you all so please stop on by to say hello.

entries.name: Vote on an Offering
entries.description:
Hello Trovian. My name is Fluxion and I represent Luxion's interests in distributing portions of their hoard in trade for Dragon Coins. To ensure that both parties are happy I have devised an ingenious method of selecting what offerings I make available.

Each week on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday I will appear in the hub in this very location. I will either accept your votes for the offerings you wish to see me sell for flux or I will happily sell you the winning items from the previous vote for Dragon Coins. You get your offering, Luxion gets their Dragon Coins, and I get flux, everyone wins!

Voting really is fun, you should try it. If I'm not accepting votes when you stop by don't worry, I will be in just seven days.

entries.name: Earn Dragon Coins
entries.description:
Perfect, isn't voting fun? A very important question you might have is 'What happens when the thing I voted for doesn't win?' Well I've accounted for that in my genious design! Any votes you have made toward an offering will automatically be applied the next time you log in if it's up for vote again. No vote is ever wasted!

Now that you've voted you'll need to get some Dragon Coins so you can buy the offering when it becomes available later. You can gain Dragon Coins by participating in the hourly challenges or through the Store.

entries.name: Interact with Fluxion
entries.description: Wonderful. Trovian you really are adept at this. You can return to me the next time I'm in the hub and spend those Dragon Coins, vote on another set of offerings, or just say hi!

entries.name: Return to GUILLERMO ARMADA in the HUB
entries.description: Gearcrafting 01/05: To learn more about Gearcrafting, seek out GUILLERMO ARMADA, beneath the HUGE GEAR in the Character Corner.

entries.name: Get 'Pureforged' Gear by Opening a Gearcrafter's Vault
entries.description:
Gearcrafting 02/05: HELLO AGAIN, Trovian! Did you know not all 'Gearcrafting' gear is actually crafted? If you're Lucky!, Gearcrafter's Vaults can sometimes provide 'Pureforged' gear--with stats tailored to your CURRENT CLASS, POWER RANK, and GEARCRAFTING SKILL. Open some Vaults until you get gear as a result.

You can obtain Gearcrafter's Vaults from Dungeons in Adventure Worlds of Uber difficulty (4) or higher.

entries.name: Reach 250 Skill in Gearcrafting
entries.description:
Gearcrafting 03/05: Great, right? But enough of that, the time has come to hone your craft! The Gearcrafter's Terminus calls to you. But first... you must raise your skill in Gearcrafting to 250!

This is a long-term goal, so progress at your own pace - there's no need to rush. Once you reach the maximum skill level, you'll unlock access to the Gearcrafter's Terminus and the highest tier of gear. Trust me, it'll all be worth it!

entries.name: Interact with the Gearcrafter's Terminus
entries.description: Gearcrafting 04/05: Max-skill Gearcrafters can use the Terminus to further enhance their Gearcrafter's Vault acquisition! Check it out now.

entries.name: Get 'Pureforged' Gear from Gearcrafter's Vault
entries.description:
Gearcrafting 05/05: The First time you Unlock or Upgrade the nodes in the Gearcrafter's Terminus, you will receive Gearcrafter's Vaults & Gearcrafter's Vault Keys! Upgraded nodes enhance your loot or crafting. You can only have 6 upgraded nodes at once, but you can reset them for a cost.

That's basically it, Trovian! Get another piece of Pureforged gear from a Gearcrafter's Vault for your final reward!

entries.name: Reach Level 10 to Draw Gemsly to the Hub
entries.description: Main Quest: Gem Expertise - Gemsly is looking for strength. Reach level 10 to attract Gemsly to the Trove Hub.

entries.name: Gossip with Gemsly to Learn about Gems
entries.description: Main Quest: Gem Expertise - Talk to Gemsly in the Trove Hub to learn about how to find and strengthen Gems! You can find Gemsly in the courtyard in front of the Leaderboard Lounge.

adventures.name: Find Gem Boxes in Adventure Worlds

entries.name: Find Gem Boxes in Adventure Worlds
entries.description:
Hi Trovian, I'm Gemsly, Qubesly's cousin! Gems are my love and my curse and I would be honored if you let me teach you about them.

You can find Gem Boxes by completing dungeons in any Uber difficulty or higher Adventure world. Go find a few so I can teach you a bit about how Gems work.

entries.name: Open a Gem Box
entries.description: Nice work, those boxes look promising! Open a box up to see what kind of gems you've found!

entries.name: Use a Golden Gem Key
entries.description: That box was nice and all but let’s get a better gem. In your Claims [HK:Claims] you will find a Locked Water Gem Box and a Golden Gem Key. Use the Golden Gem Key on the Gem Box to get a guaranteed Stellar Water Gem!\n\nGolden Gem Keys can be used by clicking on the key icon inside the Gem Box window. The Locked Water Gem Box can only be opened with a Golden Gem Key.

entries.name: Open the Gems Tab on your Character Sheet
entries.description: Lets take a look at the Gems Tab on your Character Sheet. You can find your Gems Tab by opening your character sheet [HK:CharacterSheet] and selecting the second tab.

entries.name: Equip a Gem
entries.description: Now that you have a gem to work with, go ahead and equip it by dragging the Gem into the slot you would like to use it in on the Gems Tab.

entries.name: Buy a Gem Booster Box
entries.description:
Now that you have a Gem you're going to want to upgrade it. I gave you 500 Cubits which you can use to buy a Gem Booster Box from the Gems tab in the store. You can find the Cubits in your Claims.

The Store and Claims can both be opened from the Menu [HK:NavigationMenu].

entries.name: Upgrade your Gem
entries.description:
Upgrade your gem by right clicking it from your Inventory or left clicking from your Gems Tab to put the gem in the upgrade area. Once there, you can select different boosters to use or click 'Level Up' to try and upgrade your gem.

I've given you some Water Gem Dust already. You can earn more gem dust by loot collecting gems you don't want to use. You can find Gem Boosters by opening Gem Booster Boxes like the one you just bought.

entries.name: Get to Level 12
entries.description:
You can earn quick levels completing Adventures and conquering delves.

You can change the adventure you are tracking using the Adventures Menu [HK:ActivityTracker].

entries.name: Open the Gems Tab
entries.description:
I gave you a Stunburst gem, it's always been one of my favorites. Open your Gems Tab and decide if you want to equip it.  Keep in mind you can only equip one empowered gem of each name, so if you already have another Stunburst equipped you won't be able to equip this one.

You can find the Stunburst in your Claims which you can access via the Menu [HK:NavigationMenu].

entries.name: Go to a Drowned World
entries.description:
Head to the Drowned worlds for your next mission. Open the Atlas with [HK:Atlas]. Drowned worlds can be found off of the Candorian (Shade (5) difficulty) world.

You can enter a world as soon as you reach the required power rank, so make sure to equip your gems! You will earn more adventure experience if you are within the suggested level range for the world.

entries.name: Find Water Gem Boxes
entries.description:
Now we are getting somewhere. I want you to go pick up some water gem boxes to earn dust to upgrade those gems!

Water gem boxes can be earned by defeating mini bosses and dungeons in Drowned worlds. Start by opening the Atlas with [HK:Atlas]. Drowned worlds can be found off of the Candorian (Shade (5) difficulty) world.You can get around Drowned worlds faster using a boat.

entries.name: Get to level 13
entries.description:
You can earn quick levels from completing Adventures and conquering delves.

You can change the adventure you are tracking using the Adventures Menu [HK:ActivityTracker].

entries.name: Open the Gems Tab
entries.description:
Enjoy that Air Gem, it has a lot of potential! Open your Gems Tab and decide if you want to equip it.

You can find the Air Gem in your Claims which you can access via the Menu [HK:NavigationMenu].

entries.name: Find Air Gem Boxes
entries.description:
Pick up some air gem boxes to get dust to upgrade that new gem.

You can find air gem boxes in the Cursed Skylands worlds, which can be found off of the Jurassic Jungle (Twilight (7) difficulty) world in the Atlas. If you aren't strong enough for the Cursed Skylands make sure you have equipped and powered up your gems. If you are still having trouble try getting better equipment or playing with friends.

entries.name: Go to the Shadow Tower Entrance Portal
entries.description: You're getting really strong. I bet if you wanted to you could go take on the Shadow Tower at this point. Head there from the West side of the Atlas [HK:Atlas] and I'll tell you more once you get inside.

entries.name: Talk to the Shadowy Market
entries.description:
You look like you are in a hurry, so I worked out a deal with the Shadow Merchant inside the Shadow Tower Lobby. Talk to him and he will slip you a Lunar Soul, which can normally only be acquired from Delves. You can use these souls to buy Empowered Gem Boxes from him.

The Shadow Tower is also a great place to earn experience and find better equipment.

entries.name: Get to level 15
entries.description:
You can earn quick levels from completing Adventures and conquering delves.

You can change the adventure you are tracking using the Adventures Menu [HK:ActivityTracker].

entries.name: Open the Gems Tab
entries.description: I gave you a Spirit Surge gem, you can find it in your Claims. It's way better than any Stunburst. Go ahead, open your Gems Tab and equip it if you want.

entries.name: Complete Adventures
entries.description:
You're starting to look powerful. It's time to show off your strength by helping complete Adventures for folks in need!

You can find Trove Agents at Adventure Outposts in Adventure Worlds. If Club adventures are more your speed, you can find Clubs with active Adventure Heroes using the portals in the Club Corner of the Trove Hub. Remember, you don't need to be a member of a Club to access it's Adventure Heroes!

entries.name: Get to Level 17
entries.description:
You can earn quick levels from completing Adventures and conquering delves.

You can change the adventure you are tracking using the Adventures Menu [HK:ActivityTracker].

entries.name: Open the Gems Tab
entries.description:
It's time to heat things up with a small Fire Gem! Open your Gems Tab and decide if you want to equip it.

You can find the Fire Gem in your Claims which you can access via the Menu [HK:NavigationMenu].

entries.name: Get to Level 20
entries.description:
You can earn quick levels from completing Adventures, and conquering delves.

You can change the adventure you are tracking using the Adventures Menu [HK:ActivityTracker].

entries.name: Open the Gems Tab
entries.description: This latest empowered gem I gave you is Explosive (and Stellar)! Open up your Gems Tab and decide if you want to equip it!

entries.name: Find a Gem Forge
entries.description:
Upgrading Gems is great and all, but Gem Forges are where you can really control your Gems.

You can craft a Gem Forge at the Builder's Crafting Bench.

entries.name: Forge Your Gem
entries.description:
Modifying your gems using the Gem Forge is the way to make your gems truly perfect. I've given you a Builder's Rough Focus to get you started.

Start by dragging the gem you would like to improve into the Gem Forge. From there, click on the statistic you would like to modify and the focus you would like to modify it with. Finally, click on 'Improve Stat' to work the magic.

Make sure you claim the Focus I gave you!

entries.name: Reroll Your Gem
entries.description:
Looking great over there! You can also change the bonuses on your gem using the Gem Forge.

Start by dragging the gem you would like to improve into the Gem Forge. From there, click on the statistic you no longer want and a Contained Chaos Spark. Finally, click on 'Reroll Stat' to see what new statistic you get!

Make sure you claim the Spark I gave you.

entries.name: Equip a Powerful Ally
entries.description: Allies provide a small boost in power; try equipping me (Gemsly), or any other powerful ally! Allies can be equipped from the Character Sheet [HK:CharacterSheet]. Remember that [HK:BasicAbility] equips an ally and [HK:PrimaryAbility] equips an ally's style.

entries.name: Find Fire Gem Boxes
entries.description:
Now that you have a stellar gem, you're going to want to find more gems and dust to ensure your gem is the best it can be.

You can find fire gem boxes in the Igneous Island worlds, which can be found off of the Forbidden Spires (Nightfall (9) difficulty) world in the Atlas.

entries.name: Upgrade Your Gem
entries.description: Now that you have an empowered stellar gem, you're going to want to make sure that thing is as good as it gets, so take the time to attempt some upgrades on it. Remember, you get an "E" for effort and gems can't be cracked, so upgrade it with all you've got!

entries.name: Open the Ring Box
entries.description: I just gave you something really special; a ring box. I made it myself using ringcrafting just for you! Open it up and see what you think.

entries.name: Equip Your Ring
entries.description: I must really like you, I want to put a ring on it! Try that ring on for size and let me know how it makes you feel.

entries.name: Take on Moonless Dark (10) difficulty (or above)
entries.description: You are starting to seem pretty strong. Go clear out some more Dungeons for me in Moonless Dark (10) difficulty or harder worlds to prove yourself worthy of my dust.

entries.name: Equip a Subclass
entries.description:
Subclasses help further increase your Power Rank and can be equipped from the Character Sheet [HK:CharacterSheet].

Equip a Subclass by clicking on the '!' next to your class's abilities in the Character Sheet and then clicking switch next to the subclass you would like to equip.

A subclass can only be equipped if the class is unlocked and is not the currently active class. New classes can be unlocked at the Chaos Core Crafter, which can be crafted at the Novice Crafting Bench.

entries.name: More Power? More Dungeons
entries.description: Those last 30 Dungeons seemed fun. Take on another 30 to show me your real power! Remember, only Dungeons completed in Moonless Dark (10) difficulty or higher will count!

entries.name: Get a Shadow (Or Better!) Item
entries.description: Shadow items used to be very rare and the best of the best. These days Shadow items are a bit more common. You can rarely find Shadow items as drops from Uber difficulty worlds and higher. You also can find other players to trade with for Shadow items by utilizing the trade chat in the social menu.

entries.name: Complete an Pure Midnight (11) (or Higher!) Dungeon
entries.description: In order to get to Pure Midnight (11) you will need Power Rank 5000! If you are not quite there yet make sure you are utilizing all your sources of Power Rank: Gear, Class Level, Flasks, Emblems, Subclass Level, Mastery, Dragons, and Gems. Once you get to Pure Midnight complete a dungeon to show me what you've got!

entries.name: Open the Atlas
entries.description: It's now time to use your Class Gem key to unlock your class's full potential! Open the Atlas [HK:Atlas] and then go to Shores of the Everdark, located off of Pure Midnight (11).

entries.name: Go to the Shores of the Everdark
entries.description: It's now time to use your Class Gem key to unlock your class's full potential! Open the Atlas [HK:Atlas] and then go to Shores of the Everdark, located off of Pure Midnight (11).

entries.name: Complete a Colloseum Quest in Shores of the Everdark
entries.description: In Shores of the Everdark there are lots of giant colosseums filled with shadowy fiends just waiting to take you down. Turn the tables on them and come out victorious in one of these combat tests. Beware: the Colosseum is not for the faint of heart. You may need to bring friends with you to defeat these foes. You can teleport to other players by using the Rally Blade that is next to you when you first enter a new world.

entries.name: Use your Class Gem Key
entries.description: Now that you have come out on top, it's time to reap your rewards and use your Class Gem Key. Make sure you pick up the class gem that drops from the chest!

entries.name: Open the Gems Tab
entries.description: Class Gems are the best way to unlock the full power of your class. Open up your Gems Tab and decide if you want to equip this gem to enhance your abilities.

entries.name: Upgrade your Gems
entries.description: You are now a Gem Master and are ready to take on the challenges that await on the surface of Geode. Your new power is sure to bring more folks into the hub to both teach you and ask for your aide. Before you go, upgrade a gem once more, for old time's sake.

entries.name: Unequip a Lesser Gem
entries.description: Unequip a lesser gem you have equipped by dragging and dropping it from your Gems Tab back into your Inventory. Regemerators are required to unequip gems and can be purchased from the Store with Cubits.\n\nI gave you a Regemerator to use this time. You can find it in your Claims [HK:Claims].

entries.name: Equip your Gem Again
entries.description: Thanks for unequipping that gem for me. Go ahead and socket it again. There is more I want to show you.

entries.name: Reach Level 20 and 5 Loyalty to Draw Marakeet to the Hub
entries.description: Side Quest: Marketplace Expertise - Marakeet is a world renowned trader and will show up near the Marketplace bench if you reach level 20 Mastery and have at least 5 Loyalty. Loyalty grows with your (monetary) support for the game.

entries.name: Meet with Marakeet to learn about the Marketplace
entries.description:
Side Quest: Marketplace Expertise - Talk to Marakeet in the Trove Hub to learn about how to use the Marketplace to safely trade with other Trovians! You can find Marakeet standing near the Marketplace bench in the Character Corner.

Only Trovians with 5+ Loyalty may access the Marketplace.
Loyalty grows with your (monetary) support for the game.

entries.name: Buy from the Marketplace
entries.description:
SQUAWK! Looking to trade? Based on a pop up I saw yesterday, other Trovians in your area are looking to trade too.

Use this scale next to me or press [HK:Marketplace] to SEARCH for something worthy of your hard earned Flux and then BUY it from another player. I'm always keeping an eye on the price of Credit Pouches myself.

entries.name: Sell from the Marketplace
entries.description:
CHIRP CHIRP! Great work!

When you buy something off the Marketplace the purchase immediately shows up in your inventory and the Flux is removed. In rare cases where two Trovians buy the same item, any incorrectly removed Flux is returned when the slower Trovian next changes worlds.

Now its time to build your empire, navigate over to the SELL tab in the Marketplace next to me, and CREATE a listing to sell an item you are done with. After a minute your item will show up for other Trovians, who will have the option to buy it.

entries.name: More Sales
entries.description:
KAKAW! Now that you have made your first sale, you're on your way to financial independence.

The great thing about the Marketplace is you know exactly what you are getting for your Flux.

Make a few more sales and I'll bestow my little cousin upon you. They are great for, well, not much, but they are good at making a lot of noise.

entries.name: Speak with DISCIPLE DANIEL in the HUB
entries.description: Martial Arts 01/16: Well met, Trovian. I am an envoy for the Neon Punch Club, traveling Masters of the MARTIAL ARTS, visiting your Hub to teach our ways. Meet me if you'd like to learn!

entries.name: Inspect the ALTAR of MARTIAL ARTISTRY
entries.description: Martial Arts 02/16: The ALTAR of MARTIAL ARTISTRY is where we get our work done. We use KARMA to craft MANTRAS, SHOUTS, and STANCES--though they behave differently, they all go into your AUTO-USE equipment slot.

entries.name: Inspect the KARMAIC SHRINE
entries.description: Martial Arts 03/16: The KARMAIC SHRINE is where we get our inner-work done. POSITIVE KARMA comes by doing acts of service throughout Trove--like helping Geode Cave Critters, or pulling Unsightly Weeds. NEGATIVE KARMA? Well, as you know, the universe is full of violence and sufferng. Do you have any enemy trophies, Trovian?

entries.name: Inspect the Neon Punch COMPOSTER
entries.description: Martial Arts 04/16: Gardening is good for the mind, soul, and body. Martial Arts recognizes this connection. We have a COMPOSTER free to use here in the hub!

entries.name: Collect a SOUL TANGLE
entries.description: Martial Arts 05/16: Use the composter to recover a SOUL TANGLE from the trophy of a fallen enemy. Visit DISCIPLE DANIEL if you need the required INCENSE.

entries.name: Collect NEGATIVE KARMA
entries.description: Martial Arts 06/16: Use your Soul Tangle at the KARMAIC SHRINE to collect some NEGATIVE KARMA. It sounds scary, but trust me, that negative karma is already yours.

entries.name: Craft MANTRA of REGENERATION
entries.description: Martial Arts 07/16: Using your karma and the Altar of Martial Artistry, craft a MANTRA of REGENERATION. If you need more POSITIVE KARMA, try pulling Unsightly Weeds in the Fae Forest!

entries.name: Equip and Activate your Mantra
entries.description: Martial Arts 08/16: Equip your MANTRA of REGENERATION in your AUTO-USE slot. Then /SLEEP ('/sleep' in chat) until the Mantra activates (which takes 10 seconds), giving you an EFFECT visible in the EFFECT VIEWER, accessible from your Character Sheet [HK:CharacterSheet].

entries.name: Interact with the RELIC of PRESERVATION
entries.description: Martial Arts 09/16: Mantras can be re-used, unlike SHOUTS and STANCES which are consumed each use. You can consume a Mantra, however, at the RELIC of PRESERVATION, and turn it into a week-long LITANY effect. Check out the Relic of Preservation now.

entries.name: CONSUME your Mantra at the RELIC of PRESERVATION
entries.description: Martial Arts 10/16: I sell the Incense required for the Litany ritual. A LITANY will last until the end of the CURRENT WEEK, and you can perform the ritual up to 24 times each day--but it can get expensive. Apply a Litany now, and complete your path to enlightenment.

entries.name: Speak with Master Pun-Chi
entries.description: Martial Arts 11/16: Now, for your first Act of Service. Each day Master Pun-Chi will offer an Act of Service as inspiration for you to bring POSITIVE KARMA into the world. Speak with him today and we shall see lessons he has for today.

entries.name: Purchase and Use 'Act of Service: Removing Weeds'
entries.description: Martial Arts 12/16: Like all Grasshoppers, your first task will be weed removal. Very good for the local flora! Purchase 'Act of Service: Removing Weeds' from Master Pun-Chi.

entries.name: Remove 25 Unsightly Weeds
entries.description:
Martial Arts 13/16: It would appear you must start where we all did. UNSIGHTLY WEEDS can be found in the CURSED VALE, FAE FOREST, JURASSIC JUNGLE, and FORBIDDEN SPIRES. Removing them will make Trove more beautiful and perhaps bring a smile to the face of one that does not need suffer seeing them.

Accept the quest from the purchased item in your inventory.

entries.name: Return to Master Pun-Chi
entries.description: Martial Arts 14/16: Wonderful, can you feel the POSITIVE KARMA flow through you? It is a wonderful feeling. As you progress through your training in the Martial Arts Master Pun-Chi will offer more Acts of Service.

entries.name: Speak with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub
entries.description: Martial Arts 15/16: Some within our Club find Master Pun-Chi's tasks to be a bit too much. Their journey is longer. If you wish when you see them you may aid them, as that in itself is an Act of Service. One of our Overtasked Disciples has appeared in the hub. Speak with him and see what he offers.

entries.name: Purchase Fish Food
entries.description:
Martial Arts 16/16: There are many lessons that are hidden, keep an eye out as you progress through the Martial Arts and you may unlock them. For now you should keep things simple, purchase the FISH FOOD from the Overtasked Disciple. Then, when coming across a POOL in the wild, take a moment to feed the fishes and contemplate your lessons so far.

 I have taught you all I have to teach. Master Pun-Chi, and you yourself are now the teacher.

entries.name: Find MYSTENTA CULL in the HUB
entries.description: Mysticism 01/09: Trovian. Mistress MYSTENTA CULL invites you to learn the ways of MYSTICISM. Find her BELOW CRAFTER'S CORNER in the hub, where it smells of delicious fishies!

entries.name: View BUFFs at the ORB of MYSTICISM
entries.description: Mysticism 02/09: BUFFS are powerful effects which last until the CURRENT DAY resets. You can only have ONE (1) Buff active at a time. You can apply/replace Buffs at the ORB of MYSTICISM, open it up and view some now!

entries.name: View recipes at the ALCHEMYSTIC'S LAB
entries.description: Mysticism 03/09: POTIONS have just as much power as buffs, but they're portable! They usually last 4+ hours, which only counts down while you're 'online.' They're crafted at the ALCHEMYSTIC'S LAB. You won't have any recipes yet, but we'll get to that soon!

entries.name: Acquire WILD TROVIAN MANA
entries.description: Mysticism 04/09: Whether working with Buffs or Potions, one thing all Mysticists need is MANA. WILD TROVIAN MANA, specifically. THE ORB OF MYSTICISM will show you 3 'Manahunter' buffs each week, telling you which Adventure World Biomes currently contain Mana to be collected. Mistress Cull also stocks Mana each and every day.

entries.name: Craft a BUFF
entries.description: Mysticism 05/09: An active BUFF is required to learn the associated POTION recipe. With your MANA, you can now use the ORB of MYSTICISM to craft a BUFF.

entries.name: Craft ALCHEMYSTIC'S INSIGHT
entries.description: Mysticism 06/09: Beyond just an active BUFF, to learn a POTION RECIPE you must also Equip the food "ALCHEMYSTIC'S INSIGHT" in your Auto-Use slot. They only last a minute, so it's a good idea to craft a few!\n\n You can view active BUFFs by opening the EFFECTS viewer, the button for which is on the CHARACTER SHEET [HK:CharacterSheet].

entries.name: Learn a POTION RECIPE
entries.description: Mysticism 07/09: Learn a POTION RECIPE at the ALCHEMYSTIC'S LAB. To do this, have an active BUFF--for which you don't yet know the potion recipe--and Equip ALCHEMYSTIC'S INSIGHT in your Auto-Use slot.

entries.name: Craft a POTION
entries.description: Mysticism 08/09: Craft a POTION at the ALCHEMYSTIC'S LAB. Potions can be sold on & purchased from the Marketplace, but the buyer automatically consumes 1 Potion immediately upon purchase!

entries.name: Visit MY Shop!
entries.description: Mysticism 09/09: You're done, Trovian! That's Mysticism! Please visit my shop to show your appreciation! I'm Twobsly, by the way!

entries.name: Earn a Paragon Level
entries.description: Paragon Levels 1/6: After reaching level 30 with a class, experience gained no longer contributes towards normal levels. Instead, you'll get Paragon levels! Earn a Paragon level now!

entries.name: Earn a PRIME Paragon Level
entries.description: Paragon Levels 2/6: Each Prime Paragon Level (2, 3, 5, 7, and so on) will earn you a PRIMAL loop for your current class, used to craft rings with class hidden ability effects! Earn a Prime Paragon Level now!

entries.name: Craft a SIGNATORY Ringbox
entries.description: Paragon Levels 3/6: Using Trovian Loops, Primal Loops, other materials, and a Ringcrafting skill of 300, you can now craft a Signatory ringbox for a Crystal ring! Craft one by visiting a Ringcrafting bench, such as the one in the Paragon's Palace below the Club House

entries.name: Polish a Ring
entries.description: Paragon Levels 4/6: To Polish your new ring you'll need to visit a Ring Polisher, also in the Paragon's Palace beneath the Club House in the hub. Once there, you can spend a Primal Loop to enhance one of your class abilities!

entries.name: Visit the Paragon Provisioner
entries.description: Paragon Levels 5/6: Great work! By earning Paragon levels and crafting rings, you can enhance many different class abilities! If you're ever running low on Loops, the Celestial Paragon Provisioner provides resources to help. Visit them now at the Paragon's Palace.

entries.name: Visit the Paragon Workbench
entries.description: Paragon Levels 6/6: You can also craft new Mounts, Allies, and more! To see what you can craft, visit the Paragon Workbench in the Paragon's Palace in the Hub!

entries.name: Talk to the Celestial about the Star Chart
entries.description:
Side Quest 1/12: Talk to the Celestial to learn about the Star Chart. You can find the Celestial in the Observatory at the top of the Crafter's Corner.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

entries.name: Buy a Celestial Sphere
entries.description:
2/12: Hello Trovian. If you have come seeking the power of the stars, then you have arrived at the right place. The Constellations give great power to those willing to study their shape, and I can help you harness that power. To start, you will need to acquire a Celestial Sphere. Fortunately, I have some that I can sell to you.

Buy a Celestial Sphere from the Celestial or reset your Star Chart and reclaim them.

entries.name: Interact with the Grand Orrery
entries.description: 3/12: Excellent. Now your study of the Constellations may truly begin. With your newfound Celestial Sphere, go to the Grand Orrery so you may access the Star Chart.

entries.name: Upgrade a Minor Star
entries.description:
4/12: Before you lies a map of the Constellations of Gathering, Cubesly, and Combat, each granting unique powers. Now, upgrade a Minor Star, although which one you upgrade now and in the future is for you to decide.

While viewing the Star Chart, select a Minor Star next to the starting yellow one. Use a Celestial Sphere to upgrade it to obtain the power of a Constellation.

entries.name: Acquire Astral Echoes
entries.description: 5/12: Fantastic, I can already see you growing more powerful. However, I will not be selling all my Celestial Spheres for cheap, as they are limited. In exchange for future Celestial Spheres, I will ask for Astral Echoes. For now, finding any will prove to me you are capable. They can be found in dungeons, delves, or from my 2nd Cousin Starbert who stays on the roof. If you have trouble getting any, take a break from adventuring before trying again.

entries.name: Talk to the Celestial
entries.description:
6/12: Now that you have proven you can provide me with Astral Echoes, I would like you to come back and visit me in the hub for your next lesson.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

entries.name: Get a Constellation Key
entries.description:
7/12: Another important item for your growth through the Star Chart is the Constellation Key. Once again, I fortunately have some in stock, but not many. If you want more, you will have to find an entity even greater than myself that can provide them.

Buy a Constellation Key from the Celestial or from the Store.

entries.name: Interact with the Grand Orrery
entries.description: 8/12: Truly excellent. The power of the Constellations will be yours before too long. With the Constellation Key in hand, visit the Grand Orrery for your next step.

entries.name: Unlock a Major Star
entries.description:
9/12: You may have noticed that beyond the Minor Stars are Major Stars, which hold even more power and can even grant fragments of a dragon's egg. Now, unlock a Major Star, although once again the decision of which to unlock is yours.

While viewing the Star Chart, select a Major Star further beyond the starting point. Use Constellation Keys to unlock it to obtain further power from the Constellations.

entries.name: Reset the Star Chart
entries.description:
10/12: If you find yourself regretting the path you've charted thus far, fret not. With a Constellation Key, you can reset your Star Chart, returning the Celestial Spheres to you. For now, reset your Star Chart to demonstrate to me you know how.

With a Constellation Key, reset the Star Chart by selecting the starting yellow Star.

entries.name: Upgrade a Minor Star Again
entries.description:
11/12: I see the power of the Constellations has faded from you, but the potential to gain it again shines brightly as well. That, and the Celestial Spheres have returned so you can chart the stars all over again. For my final lesson, do just that. They can be the same stars as before or they can be different.

While viewing the Star Chart, select a Minor Star next to the starting yellow one. Use a Celestial Sphere to upgrade it to obtain the power of a Constellation.

entries.name: Acquire More Astral Echoes
entries.description: 12/12: With that, I have nothing more to teach you. Now, go out in the world and collect more Astral Echoes. I will be needing them for... reasons. Once you've done that, I will reward you with a Grand Orrery of your own. While I don't have anything more to teach you, be sure to visit often, as I will have plenty more to sell to you. I'm proud of you, my pupil.

entries.name: Interact with a Tadpole Tours Embarkation Station
entries.description:
Hey, Trovian! Tadpole Tours, here! Have you seen our Embarkation Stations? They pop up when you complete DUNGEONS in Adept+ Adventure Worlds! If YOU helped complete that dungeon (or were even just nearby!), then the Tadpole Tours Embarkation Station will let you interact with it!
See if you can find one and interact with it!

entries.name: Collect a Tiny Quest Reward!
entries.description:
Perfect! Every time you complete a Dungeon, one of these should show up! When it does, if you select the HAT-WEARING, EMPTY ALLY SLOT, you can ASSIGN AN ALLY from your Collections!

Once your ally is assigned, you can EMBARK on a Tiny Quest, administered by the Tadpole Tours Company (for a nominal fee, prices and participation may vary)!

In lower difficulty worlds, a 1-Star Tiny Quest should be over FAST! See if you can complete one and GET YOUR REWARD from the Tiny Quest UI [HK:TinyQuest].

entries.name: Visit Tadpole Tours in the Hub!
entries.description:
That's it! Simple, right? Every Tiny Quest you send your Allies on grants them a small amount of experience! As your Allies level up, the stats they provide slowly increase! 

However, Tiny Quests are not always that easy, sometimes you need a little help! Come visit me in the Hub to see what wares I sell to help your Allies as they Tiny Quest!

entries.name: Check the Tadpole Tours Kiosk
entries.description:
Aside from what I sell, the Tadpole Tours corporation has provided us a shiny new Kiosk! It has a more extensive catalog than what I can offer.

Check it out!

entries.name: Open a Tadpole Tours Frogpack
entries.description:
The best way for your Ally to successfully complete Tiny Quests is to BE PREPARED! How can they do that? By equipping themselves, of course! When sending an Ally on a Tiny Quest, you can equip them with a TINY ITEM. This will increase their level & stats, allowing them to complete more difficult Tiny Quests than they otherwise could alone! Among other places, you can get Tiny Items from TADPOLE TOURS FROGPACKS. 

Tadpole Tours Frogpacks can be bought and crafted, but are also awarded when comleting Tiny Quests!

Find one and open it to get a Tiny Item!

entries.name: INSTA-COMPLETE a Tiny Quest
entries.description:
That's the gist of it! Equip your allies for victory! The only thing easier would be if you didn't have to wait for the Tiny Quest to complete... say, speaking of that... Did you know that you can use Tadpole Tours INSTA-COMPLETE TOKENS to INSTANTLY finish any Tiny Quest you send your Allies on?

This can be done as you Embark when accepting the Tiny Quest, or performed at any time from the Tiny Quest UI [HK:TinyQuest].

Each Insta-Complete token counts for 2 minutes of Tiny Questing, but you must spend enough to FULLY COMPLETE the Tiny Quest.

entries.name: Open an Ally Equipment Cache
entries.description:
You've seen the Tiny Items from Frogpacks, but the REAL good stuff comes from ALLY EQUIPMENT CACHES. You can obtain these by doing 3-Star Tiny Quests, which are available after completing 3 Star Dungeons!.

CRAFT or BUY a SIMPLE TINY KEY and use it to complete a 3-Star Tiny Quest. Then open the Ally Equipment Cache you get!

Note that while 3-Star Tiny Quests take longer to complete than 1-Star Tiny Quests, your Allies will continue questing away even when you are offline!

entries.name: Open a Tiny Stellar Chest
entries.description:
Once your Allies are strong enough to start taking on Pure Midnight (11) Difficulty worlds, you'll begin coming across 5-Star Tiny Quests!

Note that 5-Star Tiny Quests take significantly longer to complete than their 1-Star and 3-Star Tiny Quests.

entries.name: Find a Tome to Draw Hobbes to the Hub
entries.description:
Side Quest: Tome Expertise - Hobbes is a dignified cat and will show up near the Runecrafting bench if you find a Tome.

Tomes are a special piece of equipment that are most commonly crafted through Runecrafting or purchased via the store.

entries.name: Chat with Hobbes to Learn about Tomes
entries.description: Side Quest: Tome Expertise - Talk to Hobbes in the Trove Hub to learn about how to use Tomes to earn rewards! You can find Hobbes lounging around the Runecrafting bench in the Crafter's Corner.

entries.name: Equip a Tome
entries.description:
Mrow? My, my look at you, you're growing up so fast. You look like you're finally ready to learn about Tomes.

*STRETCH*

Equip a tome and I'll teach you a thing or two about how to use it.

entries.name: Fully Charge your Tome
entries.description:
Prrr, Grrreat job! Tomes are pretty easy, little one, they charge up when you complete Dungeons or collect resources in the Geode Caves. When your Tome is fully charged, it will grant resources, a great deal if you ask me.

Standard Tomes can be repeatedly refilled, but Legendary Tomes can only be charged once a week. So, charge up your Tome, enjoy the results, and don't forget to give me belly rubs.

entries.name: Charge your Tome Again
entries.description:
Well done, well done! By collecting and swapping your active Tome, you can be sure to get the resources you need just by playing. Remember that Legendary Tomes can only be filled up once per week.

Repeat your scholarly adventuring and I'll give you the giant corn roll I've been using as a scratching post. It's about time for me to head back to my library anyway.

entries.name: Kill Heckbugs
entries.description: The Heckbug Hunter isn't convinced at the success of H.E.C.K.'s mission, and has tasked you with helping to cull the Heckbug population. Find Heckbugs in the Dragonfire Peaks and slay them!
entries.summary: Hunt and Kill 10 Heckbugs in the Dragonfire Peaks

entries.name: Help Geode Heckbugs
entries.description: H.E.C.K. Helper Hailey wants you to help travel to the Geode Caverns to help Feed, Heal, and Warm any Heckbugs growing up there! Make sure to bring Critter Treats, Curing Kits, and Comfort Blankets!
entries.summary: Help 15 Heckbugs in the Geode Caverns

entries.name: Help Dragonfire Heckbugs
entries.description: H.E.C.K. Heartwarmer Harold wants you to help travel to the Dragonfire Peaks to help Heckbugs fall in love! Make sure to bring some Amorous Heckbugs!
entries.summary: Help 15 Heckbugs find love in the Dragonfire Peaks

entries.name: Complete 5 Star Dungeons
entries.description: Marquitillo has been learning about an ancient, Duck-based civilization! Information about them, as well as their coins, have recently shown up in 5-Star dungeons across Trove! Help him study these ancient beings by completing 5-Star dungeons!
entries.summary: Complete 5-Star Dungeons to help Marquitillo collect Rubber Duckats!

entries.description:
Freshwater Fran wants you to catch a rare fish from the pools that spawn all over Trove.

Turtle''s caught will also count for this special order.

This order expires 3 days after accepting it.

entries.description:

Turtle''s caught will also count for this special order.

This order expires 3 days after accepting it.
