entries.name: Find Builder's Crates in the Caves
entries.description: I'm looking for the Builder's Boxes, Builder's Chests, or Builder's Vaults that can be found within the ore veins of Geode's Caves.

entries.name: Collect Organics from Geode Caves
entries.description:
Collect any organic materials from the caves such as Day Drop, Moonlit Moss, or Cogwine.

Prove your cave competency to me, Trovian. Organics acquired via Trading Post or the Marketplace won't count!

entries.name: Care for Cave Critters
entries.description: The critters need your help! Successfully feed, heal, or comfort critters in the Geode caves and I'll give you some Adventurine for your time.

entries.name: Mine Geode Topside Ore
entries.description: The Sunseekers need you to be as strong as can be if you're going to stand with us against Undertow. Gather up Veridium and Nitro-Glitterine and you can use it to craft or enhance Crystal equipment.

entries.name: Complete 5-Star Dungeons
entries.description: There is much to be done, Trovian. The strongholds of the Shadows must be destroyed. Seek out 5-Star Dungeons on the surface of Geode and reduce them to ruins!

entries.name: More Magical Items for Sunseeker Rowan
entries.description: Give Sunseeker Rowan even more magical items to help him complete the ship to Geode.\n\nUse any loot collector to give Rowan items. This Adventure will expire 7 days after being acquired.

entries.name: Even More Magical Items for Sunseeker Rowan
entries.description: Give Sunseeker Rowan even more magical items to help him complete the ship to Geode.\n\nUse any loot collector to give Rowan items. This Adventure will expire 7 days after being acquired.

entries.name: Even More Magical Items for Sunseeker Rowan
entries.description: Give Sunseeker Rowan even more magical items to help him complete the ship to Geode.\n\nUse any loot collector to give Rowan items. This Adventure will expire 7 days after being acquired.

entries.name: Reach Power Rank 5000 to Draw Hero to the Hub
entries.description: Main Quest: Geode Topside - Hero has been watching your progress. Reach Power Rank 5000 to attract Hero to the Trove Hub.

entries.name: Catch up with with Hero to Learn about Geode Topside
entries.description: Main Quest: Geode Topside - Talk to Hero in the Trove Hub to help explore the Geode Topside! You can find Hero near Qubesly on the balcony of the Leader board Lounge North of the Landing Pad.

entries.name: Visit a Geode Topside world
entries.description:
Trovian, long time no see. Last time we met I was saving you from Todstrom. Look how far you have come!

The Sunseekers have managed to set up base camps on the Geode Topside deep within Shadow territory. Your combat skills are sorely needed to turn the tides of battle in our favor! 

Open the Atlas with [HK:Atlas] and travel to a Geode Topside world.

entries.name: Mine Veridium
entries.description: Before you can fight the Shadows here on the Topside, you're going to need upgrades. That means you'll need some Veridium and Nitro-Glitterine. You mine the Veridium and I'll provide the Nitro-Glitterine!\n\nVeridium can be found all over the Geode Topside. Mine Veridium for fun and profit!

entries.name: Forge Crystal Gear
entries.description:
The Shadows here on Geode are not like those on your home planet. They are stronger, darker, and deadlier than their Trovian counterparts. Because of this, the Sunseeker technique imbues the essence of light directly into Crystal equipment. With 250+ Gearcrafting skill, use a Gearcrafter's Forge and craft a piece of Crystal equipment.

Crystal gear can be broken down into Forge Fragments and Cosmic Gem Dust.

entries.name: Equip Crystal Gear
entries.description: Equip your newly forged Crystal gear!

entries.name: Defeat Enemies on Geode Topside
entries.description: With your new Crystal gear equipped you are ready to take on the Shadows. Venture out into the Geodian Topside and defeat some enemies.\n\nDefeat Geode Topside enemies.

entries.name: Defeat Geode Dungeon Bosses
entries.description: Excellent! We'll make a Sunseeker of you yet. The Shadows have built strongholds on the Geode Topside much like the Dungeons on your home planet. Tearing these fortresses down is crucial in the fight to take back our home from these invaders.\n\nDefeat Dungeon bosses in Geode Topside worlds.

entries.name: Complete a 5-Star Dungeon
entries.description: The Shadows have built a new kind of stronghold on our surface. One that summons great numbers of their forces to attempt to overrun our shuttle outposts and keep us from advancing further into their territory. It will be especially important to keep these at bay.\n\nComplete a 5-Star Dungeon on Geode Topside worlds.

entries.name: Complete a Geode Topside Outpost Adventure
entries.description: Stationed at each Geode Topside landing pad are Sunseeker Taskmasters that offer Adventures to those who wish to go above and beyond for some extra rewards. If you have a moment we could use the extra assistance.\n\nComplete a Geode Topside Outpost Adventure.

entries.name: Apply a Pearl of Wisdom to a Crystal Item
entries.description: Pearls of Wisdom are considered as precious on Geode as they are on Trove. They can be used to enhance your Crystal gear and weapons so that you can continue to overpower the Shadows.\n\nApply a Pearl of Wisdom to a piece of Crystal Gear using an Enchanted Forge.

entries.name: Collect Forge Fragments
entries.description: Crystal gear and weapons are unlike the equipment you find on Trove. To upgrade, they require a special component called Forge Fragments. While occasionally you may find Forge Fragments strewn throughout the Topside, your best bet is to acquire them by Loot-Collecting Crystal gear.

entries.name: Increase a Crystal Item's Star Level
entries.description: It's time to enhance your Crystal gear, Trovian. I've given you some Crystalline Cores to start you off. Between those and the Forge Fragments you collected, all that's left is Topside ore. \n\nUpgrade a Crystal item using a Forge.

entries.name: Collect Cosmic Gem Boxes
entries.description: You'll need a greater boost in power if you want to take on some of the tougher Servants of Shadow. Cosmic Gem Boxes will contain gems, and materials needed to upgrade them.\n\nCollect Cosmic Gem Boxes from mini-bosses and dungeon bosses in Geode Topside worlds.

entries.name: Enhance a Cosmic Gem
entries.description: You're almost ready, Trovian, but my dark brethren do not play fair. I have one last thing to teach you.\n\nUse Cosmic Gem Dust acquired from Cosmic Gem Boxes to enhance your Cosmic Gems using the Gems Tab on the Character Sheet [HK:CharacterSheet].

entries.name: Talk to Amberine to Start the Geode Caves Expertise Quest
entries.description: Side Quest: Geode Cave Expertise - Talk to Amberine in the Trove Hub to start your adventure into the depths of the Geode caves and unlock better equipment for your discovery suit. You can find Amberine at the entrance to the Geodian Guild Hall.

entries.name: Go to Moonglow Grotto
entries.description:
It's time to explore the depths of Geode, Trovian! I'm Amberine.

The caves are too dangerous for most Geodians, but the Sunseekers have opened portals just for Trovians like you.

You can use either the portal down below in the Geodian Guild Hall or the Atlas to get to Geode. Once you land in Geode take an airavator down to the Mining Facility and use the purple portal to Moonglow Grotto.

entries.name: Use Your Climbing Claw
entries.description:
The main parts of your discovery suit are the GAS, or Geodian Acclimation System, and N-Charge. The GAS allows you to withstand the caves' atmosphere longer, while the N-Charge powers the rest of your modules.

My favorite module is the Climbing Claw! It can grapple onto higher ledges or knock back critters - without injury, of course. We Geodians would never harm a thing!

Use your Climbing Claw and latch onto a wall or ledge.

entries.name: Use Your Omni-Tool
entries.description:
For all your gathering needs, you've got the Omni-Tool.

It's short-range for now, but you can upgrade that later at the Module Forge.

Use your Omni-Tool.

entries.name: Help 3 Cave Critters
entries.description:
YOU THERE! If you MUST invade the home of the creatures who live in these caves, I insist you help them.

I had Amberine give you Critter Treats, Curing Kits, and Comfort Blankets to tend to the cave critters you find. They should already be equipped to your hotkey bar. If you run out, make more at our sanctuary's Crystallogy Center using materials from the caves.

Help 3 cave critters. Use Critter Treats on hungry critters, Curing Kits on injured critters, and Comfort Blankets on cold critters.

entries.name: Gather in Moonglow Grotto
entries.description:
Oof. Did Sunseeker Gabbro yell at you? Our Companion Master's frazzled after caring for all the creatures being hurt by Shadows... He doesn't mean anything by it.

Why don't you go gather some materials for us? That would get you in Gabbro's good graces for sure.

Use your Omni-Tool to gather 40 gleamstone, moonstone, day drops, or dream dew in Moonglow Grotto.

entries.name: Run out of GAS
entries.description:
Travel through the caves as far as you can!

Once your GAS (the red meter on your toolbar) runs out, one of our trained adventurers will come fetch you.

Explore the area until you run out of GAS. You can also return to the Geode Sanctuary at any time by pressing [HK:Homeworld].

entries.name: Craft Critter Treats
entries.description:
YOU are the Trovian come to save us? Hm.

I am Sunseeker Lazul. First, you will save more cave creatures - and save Gabbro some heartache. Then, we will see about saving us.

Come! Crystallogy awaits. Crystallogy fortifies. Crystallogy will make you bolder yet.

Craft 1 Critter Treat at the Crystallogy Workbench located to the west.

entries.name: Redeem Reliquary Token
entries.description: Nice! Lazul gave you a Reliquary Token. Redeem it at the Reliquary Research Lab - and don't be alarmed by Sunseeker Th'lan, if you see her. She's on our side. \n\nTake an airavator up one floor and head west to redeem your token with Reliquary Merchant Thundros.

entries.name: Go to Sunken Sunvault (or another Geode cave)
entries.description:
You are strong... Th'lan sees.

Carry the Reliquary! Remnants of Ancients lie inside. Down, deep, magic sleeps. Sunken Sunvault calls... Return the reliquary... return the Ancient to its home...

Take an airavator down to the Mining Facility and return to the Geode caves. Th'lan suggests you use the orange portal to go to Sunken Sunvault this time.

entries.name: Charge Your Reliquary
entries.description: Ancient power locked inside... Th'lan knows. Reliquary hungry for magic. Magic flows through caves... Feed reliquary. Let Th'lan break it open!\n\nEquip the Token Reliquary in your discovery suit loadout. Heal, feed, or comfort critters in the caves to charge your reliquary.

entries.name: Open Your Reliquary
entries.description:
The reliquary is ready... Th'lan hears. It hums. It sings. With gifts Ancients bring. Power from eons ago. It must be revealed.

Bring it to the revealer... Th'lan will crack it open!

Return to the sanctuary by running out of GAS or pressing [HK:Homeworld]. Take an airavator up one floor and place your reliquary into the revealer located on the west side of Sunseeker Square.

entries.name: Gather in Sunken Sunvault
entries.description:
You're allowed to touch the reliquaries!? Sunseeker Th'lan must like you. Hehe.

Would ya mind going back to Sunken Sunvault and gathering more materials? And don't forget to craft more critter treats before you go! It'd make Gabbro happy.

Gather 75 sun sap, day drops, gleamstone, or blazine from Sunken Sunvault. In exchange, I'll give you an Accelerite, which decreases the time it takes for reliquaries and companion eggs to open.

entries.name: Go to Verdant Veins
entries.description:
Sunseeker Th'lan needs resources from Verdant Veins!

Next time you're in the sanctuary, use the green portal on the bottom floor to go to Verdant Veins.

Also, Lazul noticed that you uh, might need help reaching high places, so she made you Prospecting Platforms. Use them to reach higher-up materials in the caves! If you run out, make more with Crystallogy.

entries.name: Gather in Verdant Veins
entries.description:
Twin stone... geminite... and greens from the deep... Wavy kelp... back and forth... Th'lan needs!

Gather these for Th'lan... and receive... the Ancients' gift...

Gather 75 cave kelp, geminite, gleamstone, or day drops from Verdant Veins.

entries.name: Check out the Module Forge
entries.description:
UPGRADE TIME

Want to increase your N-Charge capacity or power-up your Omni-Tool? With the right crafting materials, you can upgrade all of your equipment at the Module Forge!

See your available upgrades at the Module Forge, located near the portals on the bottom floor of the sanctuary.

entries.name: Upgrade Your GAS
entries.description:
If you want to travel deeper into the caves, you've got to upgrade your GAS!

So far you've mostly explored Tier 1 of the caves. This next GAS upgrade will allow you to withstand the intense atmosphere of Tier 2 - for a while, at least.

Upgrade your GAS capacity at the Module Forge.

entries.name: Use a Thumper
entries.description:
You earned a Thumper Core! Now you can make a Thumper at the Module Workbench, next to the Module Forge.

The Thumper reveals hidden crystals and shows you the full depth of ore veins!

Craft a Thumper and use it in the caves. As a reward, I picked up some reliquaries from Th'lan! Funny, she only let me have 'em once she found out they were for you. Hehe.

entries.name: Gather Plants in Moonglow Grotto
entries.description:
Our Companion Master - do you remember him? Sunseeker Gabbro? He's been really worried about the cave critters lately. The Shadows outside have them all scared...

He needs some plants to help the creatures under his care. Would you go get some for him?

Gather 35 pieces of dream dew, day drops, acrobat bark, and moonlit moss from Moonglow Grotto. Dream dew and day drops grow in Tier 1 and Tier 2. Acrobat bark and moonlit moss only grow in Tier 2.

entries.name: Help 25 Cave Critters
entries.description:
Be the light! I apologize for my rudeness the last time we spoke. Shadows have hurt quite a lot of Geodian creatures... and it, well, it's been difficult.

I am Sunseeker Gabbro. I wrote the book on Geodian creatures - several books, in fact! They're such fascinating creatures.

Could you go and soothe 25 creatures in the caves with Critter Treats, Comfort Blankets, and Curing Kits? I, and they, would be grateful.

entries.name: Mine Geminite
entries.description:
Gabbro told me to pass along his thanks!

Anyway, I wanted to tell you that I'm almost done with an invention that'll really knock your socks off! Go grab me some materials from Verdant Veins so I can finish it.

Mine 75 geminite from Verdant Veins.

entries.name: Craft Rocket Boots
entries.description: With those Thrusters I gave you, you can make Rocket Boots! You can outrun anything with these - even Sunseeker Rowan! Unless he's wearing them too. Hehe.\n\nCraft Rocket Boots at the Module Workbench in the Mining Facility.

entries.name: Mine Ores
entries.description:
The materials you've collected have helped us out so much. Now we might actually stand a chance against... you know.

The Sunseekers say that they've nearly depleted our ore supplies defending this place already. Would you mind getting more for us?

Mine 150 ore from caves of your choice.

entries.name: Gather Uncommon Plants
entries.description:
Hello again, young Trovian. The creatures under my care have bewildered my assistants by consuming every scrap of organic matter they could sink their little teeth into!

Unusual behavior, isn't it? Utterly fascinating! In the meantime, would you go and gather more plants for us?

Gather 20 moonlit moss, cogwine, acrobat bark, or cavebirds. These plants can only be found in Tier 2 of the caves.

entries.name: Mine Blazine
entries.description: Exciting news! I'm ready to put the finishing touch on my latest invention: the Barrier Generator. I just need a few more materials from Sunken Sunvault.\n\nWould you go to to Sunken Sunvault and mine 75 blazine for me?

entries.name: Use Barrier Generator
entries.description:
You can build the Barrier Generator now! The Barrier Generator shields you from environmental hazards in the caves and boosts your speed!

Sunseekers say that the deepest parts of the cave can be dangerous, so you'll definitely want to have this one in your back pocket.

Craft the Barrier Generator at the Module Workbench on the bottom floor of the Sanctuary and use it on your next adventure!

entries.name: Gather Cave Kelp and Cogwine
entries.description:
Amberine says you collect things well. You are useful. Do more of this.

We require 40 Cave kelp and cogwine at the Crystallogy Center. The depths of Verdant Veins flows with it.

Cave kelp grows in Tier 1 and Tier 2. Cogwine only grows in Tier 2.

entries.name: Gather Sun Sap and Cave Birds
entries.description: Blazing and chirping... blooming and flying... Th'lan needs. Bring them for Th'lan! Down dark... sunken deep... much power. Must be unlocked!\n\nGather 40 sun sap and cave birds in Sunken Sunvault. Sun Sap grows in Tier 1 and Tier 2. Cave Birds only grow in Tier 2.

entries.name: Gather Day Drops and Moonlit Moss
entries.description: Hehe. The other Sunseekers are all lining up to get your help next, now. But don't forget about me! I was your first fan. I get dibs.\n\nPlease gather 40 day drops and moonlit moss! They grow in all of the caves. In exchange, I'll tell ya how to make something awesome.

entries.name: Use Path Painter
entries.description: You can now craft the Path Painter! The Path Painter allows you to you to paint blocks in the caves and can keep track of where you've been. Stepping on the painted blocks will also give you and Trovians around you a speed boost.\n\nCraft a Path Painter at the Module Workbench and try it out when you are in the caves.

entries.name: Upgrade Your GAS
entries.description: That was the last new module I had for you! You are becoming a cave-diving pro. You've already traveled as far in as I've ever been! I think you might even be able to travel as far as the Sunseekers soon!\n\nUse the Module Forge on the bottom floor of the sanctuary to upgrade your GAS.

entries.name: Gather Cave Birds
entries.description:
AHA! Just the Trovian I was looking for. 

A once-buoyant little Howlug under my care has been ill lately. To cheer her up, I'd like to surround her with her favorite plants - cave birds! Twenty beautiful, bountiful cave birds will brighten her spirits in no time.

Gather 20 cave birds from Sunken Sunvault. Cave birds only grow in Tier 2 and beyond.

entries.name: Gather Acrobat Bark
entries.description:
The Cave Birds weren't enough! This sweet Howlug has lost nearly all her bounce. She was so bouncy before! It saddens me to see her this way. I've written it all down in my latest book if you care to read more.

In any case, I believe what'll really put some bounce in her step is some acrobat bark.

Gather 20 acrobat bark from the ceilings of Moonglow Grotto. Acrobat bark only grows in Tier 2 and beyond.

entries.name: Check out the Egg Incubator
entries.description:
What a day! It turns out this Howlug wasn't ill at all – only pregnant! They're quite skilled at hiding it, you see, even from me! And I've written thirty books on it!

The Howlug was so grateful for your assistance, she insisted that you have one of her eggs.

Come have a look at the Egg Incubator at the Companion Ranch to the east and I'll show you how to use it.

entries.name: Hatch Your Howlug
entries.description: Place place your egg inside the Egg Incubator and watch it hatch!\n\nI have a feeling this one will hatch quickly. It must be excited to meet its proud new caretaker!

entries.name: Bring Howlug into the Caves
entries.description:
Wow! You really have your own companion? Gabbro says it takes a LOT for cave creatures to trust you. I'm almost jealous.

Gabbro told me that these creatures help you out as you explore. You can even level them up at the Companion Trainer if you have Bond Crystallizer!

You should bring this Howlug with you into the caves and see what it can do.

entries.name: Upgrade Your GAS
entries.description:
Your howlug looks happy to be with you! Hehe. I can understand why.

Feel free to explore as you like.

Once you get enough resources for your next GAS upgrade, you'll be able to go into Tier 3! That's further than I've ever gone. I'm impressed!

One more thing, while I've still got you: Thank you for coming to Geode. I was skeptical when Rowan told us that you might be able to save us. But after meeting you... I've never been so happy to be wrong.

Gather materials to upgrade your GAS to explore Tier 3 and beyond.

entries.name: Mine Shapestone Ore
entries.description:
Greetings Trovian. I have been tasked by my master with obtaining crafting materials for my training, but my master asks too much. There is not enough time, and what he asks for is difficult to find. If you wouldn't mind helping me I would be very grateful.

Mine SHAPESTONE Ore to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.
entries.summary: If it's common why is it so hard to find.

entries.name: Mine Infinium Ore
entries.description:
Trovian, please help! Master Pun-chi has tasked me with finding INFINIUM ORE, but it's impossible. Even if I were to find it there's many many other tasks as well. Please help, you're my only hope!

Mine INFINIUM ORE to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.
entries.summary: Is it called Infinium because it takes infinity to find?

entries.name: Mine Primordial Flame
entries.description:
Tro... vian... it's so... hot. I'll never... find the ore... my master wants... please help.

Mine PRIMORDIAL FLAME to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.
entries.summary: It's so hot, why don't I ever get to go to cooler places?

entries.name: Mine Glacial Shards
entries.description:
H-H-Help m-m-me. T-T-Too c-c-cold t-t-to t-t-hink. M-M-Mine G-G-GLACIAL S-S-SHARDS p-p-please.

Mine GLACIAL SHARDS to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

entries.name: Mine Veridium
entries.description:
VERIDIUM. That's all I need to be done with this planet, but I can't find it. Maybe you will have better luck, mind helping me out?

Mine VERIDIUM to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.
entries.summary: You'd think you could find green in a sea of red.

entries.name: Mine Nitro-Glitterine
entries.description:
Master Pun-Chi says to go run we must first walk. Well I've been walking all over this desert and I'm no closer to done with his list. Could you please help me and collect NITRO-GLITTERINE?.
ITRO-GLITTERINE to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.
entries.summary: Shades of red, it's all just shades of red.

entries.name: Collect Ashfern Sporelings
entries.description:
Try as I might to avoid it, conflict is ever present here. I'd like to spend as little time here as possible. Would you mind collecting ASHFERN SPORELINGS for me so I can continue with my list for the master?

Collect ASHFERN SPORELINGS to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.
entries.summary: Everything down here is so scary.

entries.name: Collect Irradiant Powercells
entries.description:
Master sent me here to conquer my fear of heights. It's not working. Would you mind collecting IRRADIANT POWERCELLS for me so that I can get out of here. Why would anyone want to live so high up?

Collect IRRADIANT POWERCELLS to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.
entries.summary: I feel like every step I take I might fall.

entries.name: Collect Plasma
entries.description:
Living in the Neon City means your life runs on PLASMA, and we go through a lot of it. It's an exhausting task, mind giving me a hand?

Use the PLASMA SPONGE to collect PLASMA to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.
entries.summary: This is my least favorite task, it always leaves me so tired....

entries.name: Collect Moonlight Bulbs
entries.description:
I search and search and search, but MOONLIGHT BULBS are so hard to find. I have a huge list of things to find today, would you mind helping me out?

Collect MOONLIGHT BULBS all over Trove to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.
entries.summary: It's so hard to get them back to the hub while they are still usable.

entries.name: Purchase Pinzo's Products
entries.description:
A man truely worthy of pity. Only seeing the value in the material. Violence is not the way, it would be simpler to show him the fragility of wealth. Purchase all he has, let him see that wealth does not bring enlightment. Destroy whatever trinkets he gives you, they are always worthless.

For the good of all of Trove, buy what he's selling and destroy it. Rumors circulate that Chuck Pinzo has been hiding near powerful enemies on Trove and Geode.
entries.summary: Spend in a spree with your buddy Chucky P.!

entries.name: Help Chillio
entries.description:
One of my former students resides in the Permafrost. He was ever impatient and never took to my lessons. I have helped him as much as possible, but these days it is difficult to make the journey. Would you please keep an eye out in the Permafrost for my young friend. Trouble follows him as the sun chases the moon.

Find Chillio and help him in the Permafrost.

entries.name: Help Fabio Fae La Fearso
entries.description: Fabio Fae La Fearso can try your patience. He is a king, and expects you to give him respect he rarely earns. Still, we can not bear a grudge, lest a grudge be held against us. Seek him out and help him, perhaps a kind action might change his perspective.

entries.name: Seek the Scamster
entries.description: Of all the students I have taught, none was so full of NEGATIVE KARMA as Chuck Pinzo. He is selfish in all ways. I have heard his Patsy has been seen in the Sundered Uplands. Seek them out and see what he is up to.

entries.name: Finding a Hat
entries.description: I have enjoyed my time in the Hub. I have met all sorts of new friends. Saltwater Sam is an interesting fellow. He's quite sad due to dropping his hat while recently fishing. Apparently it happens frequently, perhaps you could lend a hand? He said he lost it in the TREASURE ISLES.

entries.name: Find Chillio's Body
entries.description:
Yo Trovian. As you can see I'm in a bit of trouble. Every so often the sun shines a bit too much and my head melts off my body. The worst part is my body doesn't seem to realize it. Could you do me a favor and find my body. The last time this happened I didn't get fixed till Snowfest!

Press [HK:Loot] to interact with Chillio's Body.

entries.name: Remove Unsightly Weeds
entries.description:
UNSIGHTLY WEEDS, everywhere I look instead of glorious fae fauna I see weeds. This is unacceptable. When I screamed for the gardner I was informed that I had fired the gardener. Given that, I must find a replacement. You seem capable.

As regeant of all of the Fae that I can see I conscript you to pull every UNSIGHTLY WEED you can see.

Find and pull weeds from the ground in the CURSED VALE, FAE FOREST, JURASSIC JUNGLE, and FORBIDDEN SPIRES.
entries.summary: Unisghtly, unwanted, and most importantly, unaccecptable.

entries.name: Return the Pirate Hat
entries.description:
There's a waterproof note inside the brim:

''Property of Saltwater Sam. Please return to me in the Fishing Area of the Hub if found.''

Saltwater Sam would probably appreciate the favor.
entries.summary: Truely a tragedy, a pirate hat lost at sea.

entries.name: Remove Unsightly Weeds
entries.description:
Balance. A master martial artist always seeks balance. Not only in form, but all things. UNSIGHTLY WEEDS have unbalanced the beauty of Trove. Today your task is to find them, remove them, and ponder how this achieves balance for you.

Remove UNSIGHTLY WEEDS in the CURSED VALE, FAE FOREST, JURASSIC JUNGLE, and FORBIDDEN SPIRES.

entries.name: Mine Primordial Flame
entries.description: How do you know the flame is hot? You reach and burn your hand. This is a lesson we must all remember. Seek Primordial Flame and take hold of the flame, control your pain, and learn.

entries.name: Mine Glacial Shards
entries.description: We can learn much from the Permafrost. It's biting cold reveals our weaknesses as surely as the flames of the Dragonfire Peaks. Regrettably, ice outside the Permafrost is ephemeral. Obtain Glacial Shards and ponder their permanence.

entries.name: Feed the Fish
entries.description:
Life is a circle. Destruction makes room for new growth. Many in Trove take from the waters, few return anything. Always remember to give back from which you take. Failing to do so might find you empty handed in the future.

Feed fish in pools all over Trove. You can buy Fish Food from the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub.

entries.name: Mine Nitro Glitterine
entries.description: The young always seek speed. They wish to move quickly, skip lessons, and they fail to see what is in front of them as a result. Seek Nitro-Glitterine on Geode, but remember to take your time. Remember it is the journey, not the destination that is important.

entries.name: Aid Cave Critters
entries.description:
Why do you seek strength? Is it to defend or destroy? Too often the threats of Trove and Geode push us toward violence. It is easy to forget those that can not defend themselves. The strongest warrior protects the weak. Seek out those in need in the Geodian Caves and aid them.

Help critters in the Geodian Caves.

entries.name: Go for a Walk
entries.description: Meditation is good, but sometimes the blood must be flowing to think properly upon a question. When the need arises, I find a healthy walk is best. Try it out, see how it feels.

entries.name: Build
entries.description: How long has it been since you created something? It is the greatest gift we can give to others. Talent matters not, only the effort. Give it a try, see what you can come up with.

items.name: Recipe: Cultivated Tentacle of Q'bthulhu Seed

entries.name: Bring Marquitos to Markos Ybarra
entries.description: So THAT is where he got off to! Do you mind returning him to me when you get a chance? I am in the hub on the weekends!

entries.name: Your... FISH ate your homework?!
entries.description: Well, that's an excuse I haven't heard before. Fine, I'll let you off the hook this time.\n\nSounds like quite the story though! Why don't you go share it with the Radiant Merchant in the Hub? He has a soft spot for peculiar tales, and something tells me he'll want to hear this one.

entries.name: A Cran-Tastic New Neighbor!
entries.description:
Interested in curiosities, Trovian? Cranny's carefully curated collection has the most wonderful curios you've ever seen!

His shop is tucked right next to the spawn point in the Hub. Drop by and visit!

entries.name: Warm Up: Jumping
entries.description: Today's warm up: Jump 50 times!

entries.name: Warm Up: Running
entries.description: Today's warm up: Walk or Run 300 steps!

entries.name: Warm Up: Place Blocks
entries.description: Today's warm up: Place 25 Blocks!

entries.name: Warm Up: Dodge
entries.description: Today's warm up: Dodge 10 times!

entries.name: Warm Up: Ultimate
entries.description: Today's warm up: Use an Ultimate Ability [HK:Ability2]!

entries.name: Warm Up: The Basics
entries.description: Today's warm up: Use your Basic Attack [HK:BasicAbility] 50 times!

entries.name: Warm Up: Destroy Blocks
entries.description: Today's warm up: Destroy 100 Blocks!

entries.name: CHALLENGE: 3 x 3
entries.description: FLEX your strength by defeating THREE 3-star dungeons within FIVE MINUTES!\nWARNING: If not completed within FIVE MINTUES this quest will self destruct!

entries.name: CHALLENGE: 100 in 100!
entries.description: After warming up, jump ONE HUNDRED times within ONE HUNDRED seconds!\nWARNING: If not completed within ONE HUNDRED SECONDS this quest will self destruct!

entries.name: CHALLENGE: BUILDER'S BRAWN
entries.description: After warming up, construct an ENTIRE CORNERSTONE without breaking for a nap.

entries.name: Feed Hungry Wolves
entries.description: Find hungry wolves in the Everdark and feed them.
entries.summary: No matter how far you fall, you can always rise again.

entries.name: Defeat 1 Star Dunegeons in the Fae Forest
entries.description: The wolves of the shadow are running rampant. Find them and purge them from the Fae Forest.

entries.name: Defeat an Alpha
entries.description: Find one of the Alphas in the Everdark and defeat them.
entries.summary: No matter how dark, the light shines.

entries.name: Defeat Inner Ring Enemies
entries.description: Defeat enemies in the biome ring closest to the Venture Capitol in the Trials of Luxion.

entries.name: Defeat Middle Ring Enemies
entries.description: Defeat enemies in the middle biome ring in the Trials of Luxion.

entries.name: Defeat Outer Ring Enemies
entries.description: Defeat enemies in the outer-most biome ring in the Trials of Luxion.

entries.name: Defeat Venturine Mercenaries
entries.description: Venturine Mercenaries periodically rain from the sky. Did Luxion hire them? I'm not sure, but I love to watch Trovians destroy them! ... orrrrr vice versa, whatever!

entries.name: Donate at Luxion's Long Shots
entries.description: How did I get so rich? Luxion's Long Shots, of course! Give it a shot, maybe you'll get lucky, like me!

entries.name: Craft a Charged Circuit
entries.description: The Resistors need resources! Craft a Charged Circuit at a Resistor Workbench in Neon City.

entries.name: Mine Primordial Flame
entries.description: The Resistors need resources! Mine Primordial Flame for their cause. Primordial Flame is an orange and black ore that can be found in Neon City and the Dragonfire Peaks. Primordial Flame ore can also rarely be found within Shapestone, Formicite, and Infinium ore veins.

entries.name: Defeat Enemies in Luminopolis
entries.description: Defeat Enemies of the Resistors in the Luminopolis region of Neon City.

entries.name: Defeat Dungeon Bosses in Neon City
entries.description: Defeat 3 Dungeon Bosses in Neon City to keep the Resistors strong.

entries.name: Defeat a Rampage Boss
entries.description: Protect Neon City and defeat a Rampage boss!

entries.name: Collect Plasmium in Neon City
entries.description: Collect 50 Plasmium from the robots in Neon City to utilize their power. (Cannot be acquired via Trading Post or the Marketplace)

entries.name: Catch Jade Neon Darters in Neon City
entries.description: Jade Neon Darters can only be fished up in Plasma. Must be fished up in a Neon City biome to count.

entries.name: Defeat Enemies in Luminopolis
entries.description: Defeat enemies of the Resistors in the Luminopolis region of Neon City.

entries.name: Complete Dungeons
entries.description: 1 Star, 3 Star, or even 5 Star dungeons, I don't care! I just want to see dungeons cleared of the evil that inhabits them.

entries.name: Gather Glacial Shards
entries.description: I can't stand to see so many Glacial Shards just waiting to be mined! Dig some up, please. Glacial Shards are a white and blue ore that can be found all over the Permafrost.

entries.name: Clear a Cursed Skull Pile
entries.description: These lands are cursed and I can't be free until all the cursed skulls have been taken care of. Please, knock one of them out for me Trovian, I beg of you.

entries.name: Mine Shapestone Ore
entries.description: Shapestone ore, its everywhere in this desert! Shapestone ore veins are pink in color and you can find them on or below the surface of Trove. Mine some up, I'll make it worth your while.

entries.name: Gather Faerie Dust or Enchanted Wood
entries.description: Faerie Dust and Enchanted Wood can be found all over the Fae Forest and they unleash magic into the world when collected. Please, gather them up and let the magic flow!

entries.name: Mine Formicite Ore
entries.description: Formicite Ore is so tasty when paired with gumdrops, you need to try it! Formicite Ore Veins are blue in color and you can find them on or below the surface of Trove. Mine some up and you won't regret it.

entries.name: Fight a T-Rex, you coward
entries.description: You look like a coward, kill one of the T-Rex roaming around the Jurassic Jungle to prove me wrong.

entries.name: Collect Bleached Bones
entries.description: Have you ever chewed on Bleached Bones? They are SUPER tasty! You should try them sometime! You can find them in Dragonfire Peaks and Cursed Vale.

entries.name: Find a Feather or Dragonscale
entries.description: Fiery Feathers and Blue Dragonscales are hidden all over these breathtaking Forbidden Spires. You may be able to scare one up by knocking out the guardians that patrol this place.

entries.name: Make a Luminopolis Donation
entries.description: The Resistors have set up Donation Stations at the Adventure Outposts across Luminopolis. Please, Trovian, donate to one of the Luminopolis Donation Stations to show the Resistors we have your support.

entries.name: Collect Air Gem Boxes
entries.description: Collect Air Gem Boxes from Cursed Skylands. Air Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

entries.name: Collect Fire Gem Boxes
entries.description: Collect Fire Gem Boxes from Igneous Islands. Fire Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

entries.name: Collect Water Gem Boxes
entries.description: Collect Water Gem Boxes from Drowned Worlds. Water Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

entries.name: Catch Water Fish
entries.description: Catch some beautiful water fish for me, Trovian. Only real fish will count, I don't need another boot weighing me down!

entries.name: Collect Ashfern Sporelings
entries.description: Our Ashfern Sporelings have spread across the Sundered Uplands, Trovian. As they cleanse the land of its corruption, they grow and thrive! Collect them to help us complete our lifecycle and heal this land!

entries.name: Open a Sunder-Ark Cache
entries.description: Have you seen the Sundered Ark-Caches? They show up when you complete a boss wave in a 5-star Dungeon, but you need a key to open them.

entries.name: Catch Lava Fish
entries.description: Catch some heated lava fish for me, Trovian. Only real fish will count, I don't need another boot weighing me down!

entries.name: Gone Delvin'
entries.description: Have you heard of Delves?! We've managed to open some gateways deep into a series of dangerous cave systems FILLED with bad guys! I wouldn't recommend going in there, but my boss said to give these rewards to any Trovian brave enough to even try to help push back this terrible wave of shadow corruption!

entries.name: Donate Inert Geodes
entries.description: We're studying the Inert Geodes found in the Delves. Use the Delve Workbench next to me to Donate some for a reward!
entries.summary: Donate Inert Geodes at the Delve Workbench in the Hub

entries.name: Defeat Delve Bosses
entries.description: Much of the corruption in Delves can be found within the Bosses who guard over the portals into the deeper Depths. If you can destroy 3 of these Bosses, we will reward you!

entries.name: Rescue Captured Geodians
entries.description: Many Geodians have been captured by the Bosses lording over all denizens of the Delves. Please find and rescue any Captured Geodians you can!
entries.summary: Find a Captured Geodian in a Delve

entries.name: Craft a Light Banner
entries.description: The Delve Workbench in the Trove Hub has been set up so you can craft Banners using the Standards rarely found in Pressurized Caches. Craft one for a reward!
entries.summary: Use the Delve Workbench in the Hub to craft a Light Banner

entries.name: Confusing Temporal Parabox
entries.description: The Delves are WEIRD, Trovian! The last time I opened a Pressure-Locked Delver's Cache I got my reward, but then it rematerialized right in front of my eyes! You should try!

entries.name: Corrupted Memories
entries.description: Trovian! The Bosses of the Delve caverns can spread corruption even to inanimate objects! If not consumed, these objects will Decay and their corruption will be released back into the Delve caverns, or–worse–Trove and Geode themselves!
entries.summary: Consume a Delve Memento from your Inventory

items.name: Memento: Ifera, Underlord of the Deep

entries.name: Shadowy Soul Vault (Depth: 25+)
entries.description: We've built special keys just for the mysterious Shadowy Soul Vaults found deep within the Delve caverns. You can craft one at the Delve Workbench next to me. I've heard the vaults only spawn if you go three floors deep.
entries.summary: Use a Delve Shadowkey on a Shadowy Soul Vault within Delves

entries.name: Errant Chicken
entries.description: Return the Chicken to its rightful location in the Tutorial world
entries.summary: Surely this Chicken belongs somewhere other than a Dungeon?!

entries.name: Earn a Battle Coin
entries.description: Yo, bro! You look like you're a battler! How about you hop into Battle Mode and show everyone what's up. If you can earn a coin at all I'll even throw in a bonus!
entries.summary: Prove your worth and earn a Battle Coin from Battle Mode.

entries.name: Warm Up: Running
entries.description: Today's warm up: Walk or Run 300 steps!

entries.name: Warm Up: Jumping
entries.description: Today's warm up: Jump 50 times!

entries.name: Warm Up: Place Blocks
entries.description: Today's warm up: Place 25 Blocks!

entries.name: Warm Up: Dodge
entries.description: Today's warm up: Dodge 10 times!

entries.name: Warm Up: Ultimate
entries.description: Today's warm up: Use an Ultimate Ability [HK:Ability2]!

entries.name: Warm Up: The Basics
entries.description: Today's warm up: Use your Basic Attack [HK:BasicAbility] 50 times!

entries.name: Warm Up: Destroy Blocks
entries.description: Today's warm up: Destroy 100 Blocks!

entries.name: Daily Exercise: 1 Star Dungeons
entries.description: Complete 20 1-Star Dungeons and bust open their chests to grow stronger!

entries.name: Daily Exercise: 3 Star Dungeons
entries.description: Complete 7 3-Star Dungeons and bust open their chests to grow stronger!

entries.name: Daily Exercise: Defeat Enemies
entries.description: Defeat 100 Enemies to grow stronger!

entries.name: Daily Exercise: Complete Delves
entries.description: Complete 3 Delves to grow stronger!

entries.name: Hunt Heckbugs
entries.description:
Everything. They took everything from me. I will have my revenge. Hunt them, fight them, and destroy them. Do this and I will sell you what I have collected in my battles.

Defeat Heckbugs in DRAGONFIRE PEAKS, then return to The Hunter in the events area of the Hub.
entries.summary: Rip, tear, destroy them. Until it is done.

entries.name: Find Promising Companion Eggs
entries.description:
Subterranean Scramble Daily 3/3: I didn't mean to run off but Diggsly just wasn't listening. I've uncovered something promising in these caves; Promising Eggs! Go find some Companion Eggs and see if you can uncover something special. The deeper you dive the more likley you are to find Promising Companion Eggs in Lairs.

If you see me again, I may want any Eggs instead, so keep an eye out!
entries.summary: Find Promising Companion Eggs in Geode Cave Lairs.

entries.name: Find Companion Eggs
entries.description:
Subterranean Scramble Daily 2/3: I didn't mean to run off but Diggsly just wasn't listening. I've uncovered something promising in these caves; Promising Eggs! Go find some Companion Eggs and see if you can uncover something special. The deeper you dive the more likley you are to find Promising Companion Eggs in Lairs.

If you see me again, I may want Promising Eggs instead, so keep an eye out!
entries.summary: Find Companion Eggs in Geode Cave Lairs.

entries.name: Mine Ore
entries.description: Subterranean Scramble Daily 1/3: I'm so upset Trovian, my Shadow was trying to tell me something and I didn't listen... and now hes just GONE. The only thing that can cheer me up at a time like this is mining. Go mine some ore to help remind me what its like to have fun again.
entries.summary: Mine ore to cheer Diggsly up.

entries.name: Work for the Rime Wardens
entries.description: Trove will freeze before we submit.

entries.name: Collect Smoldering Marks
entries.description:
The Smoldering Clutch thinks they’re so smart, put them in their place.

Smoldering Clutch enemies can be found in the SMOLDERING VAULTS the DRAGONFIRE PEAKS.
entries.summary: Smoldering Marks power the Frozen Anvil.

entries.name: Defeat Smoldering Clutch Bosses
entries.description: Those in charge are to blame for everything, they know what their sire did. Find them and destroy them.\n\nDefeat a Boss in the SMOLDERING VAULTS found in the DRAGONFIRE PEAKS.""
entries.summary: The leaders of the Smoldering Clutch are lazy and weak.

entries.name: Open a Smoldering Stash
entries.description:
Those clutch whelps keep their most treasured valuables in Smoldering Stashes. I recommend you find one and enrich yourself.

Smoldering Stashes can be found rarely in the SMOLDERING VAULTS in the DRAGONFIRE PEAKS.
entries.summary: If they cannot defend it, then take it.

entries.name: Work for the Smoldering Clutch
entries.description: These upstarts, they got no class.

entries.name: Collect Rime Crests
entries.description:
Hey, that Molten Anvil, it runs on those Rime Crests. You should go collect some and maybe it’ll spark for ya.

Rime Warden enemies can be found in the FROZEN VAULTS the PERMAFROST.
entries.summary: Go the Frozen Vaults, see what happens, eh?

entries.name: Defeat Rime Warden Bosses
entries.description:
No hard feeling about what ya did earlier, we get it. How about you make a little better and show the Rime Warden bosses who the real boss is.

Defeat a Boss in the FROZEN VAULTS found in the PERMAFROST.
entries.summary: When ya get comfortable, that’s when accidents happen.

entries.name: Open a Rimecovered Stash
entries.description:
While you’re in the Frozen Vaults keep an eye out for any Rimecovered Stashes. The Smoldering Clutch. It’s mostly just Rime Crests, but every once in a while you might find something interesting.

Rimecovered Stashes can be found rarely in the FROZEN VAULTS in the PERMAFROST.
entries.summary: Make sure if ya find a Rimecovered Stash you don’t open it. No matter what!

entries.name: Deliver food to CLOUD LAYER denizens
entries.description: Denizens of the CLOUD LAYER are vacationing all across Trove adventure worlds, find one and deliver some delicious food to them!
entries.summary: Deliver JUICY HAMBURGERS or ICE CREAM & WAFFLES to vacationing Sundered Uplands citizens from the Cloud Layer–vacationing all around Trove adventure worlds.

entries.name: Deliver food to ASHEN WASTES denizens
entries.description: Denizens of the ASHEN WASTES are exploring all across Trove adventure worlds, find one and deliver some healthy food to them!
entries.summary: Deliver HEALTHFUL BROCCOLI or OATMEAL & FRUIT to intrepid Sundered Uplands citizens from the Ashen Wastes–exploring all of Trove adventure worlds.

entries.name: Deliver food to MEDIEVAL HIGHLANDS denizens
entries.description: Denizens of the Medieval Highlands are vacationing all across Trove adventure worlds, find one and deliver some delicious food to them!
entries.summary: Deliver VIBRANT SALAD or HEALTHY GREENS to Highlands citizens all around Trove adventure worlds.

entries.name: Deliver food to CANDORIA denizens
entries.description: Denizens of Candoria are exploring all across Trove adventure worlds, find one and deliver some junk food to them!
entries.summary: Deliver JUICY BURGERS or JUICY HOTDOGS Candorian citizens vacationing all around Trove adventure worlds.

entries.name: Harvest ENCHANTED Purp'lils
entries.description:
The Healthy Faction has created a magically modified Grape that tastes so good, and grows much faster than normal grapes! They only sprout out under the open sky, so plant them outdoors on your CORNERSTONE.

Enchanted Purp'lil seeds are obtained from the Medieval Highlands Delegate in the Hub.
entries.summary: Plant Enchanted Purp'lil Seeds under the open sky and harvest them.

entries.name: Collect ROCK CANDY in the Confectious Caverns
entries.description:
Break the creatures lurking in the CONFECTIOUS CAVERNS and take the ROCK CANDY crystallizing inside them.

Delve into the Confectious Caverns, break them open, and harvest it!
entries.summary: Break Confectious Caverns Creatures for ROCK CANDY

entries.name: Collect 3 Pumpkins
entries.description: Mmm, pumpkin pie is the best! Plus you can carve jack-o-lanterns while it bakes.\n\nPumpkins can be found growing in large patches in Cursed Vale during Shadow's Eve. They can also be grown and harvested through the Gardening profession. (Cannot be acquired via Trading Post or the Marketplace)

entries.name: Complete 3-Star Dungeons
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve Daily Adventure: I need your help searching for hoarded candy. I know they're hiding it from me!

Complete 3-Star Dungeons in any biome.

rewards.name: Order of the Moon's Treasure Box

entries.name: Earn a Bomber Royale Coin
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve Daily Adventure: My friends prefer treats but everyone knows TRICKS are the best part of the season. Let's go cause some havoc!

Finish in the top 10 players in Bomber Royale.

entries.name: Lunar Condensate
entries.description: Greetings, Trovian, I am Plumetheus. My twisted cousins have been holding back dark secrets from Trovians for too long. Dark, purple secrets. Don't tell them I told you, but the secret can be found in the Lunar Condensate.

entries.name: Kill Wolves and Werewolves
entries.description: Shadow's Eve Daily Adventure: Tarnations partner! Wolves is overrunnin' thangs 'n I've 'ad it! Go get me wolf pelts an' I'll pay ya. I've been hard at work and they're only stalkin' Cursed Vale this year. Get out there and get ta' gettin' rid of 'em.

entries.name: Collect Lunar Condensate
entries.description:
Lunar Condensate is the residue created when the shadow and Lunar light interact. Collecting all that we can limits the shadows corruption. If you can collect it the Quartermaster will happily reward you for turning it in.

Lunar Condensate can be found by defeating the Werewolves, wolves, owls, crows, and some 1-Star Dungeons in the Medieval Highlands, Cursed Vale, and Desert Frontier.

entries.name: Collect Q'rsebane
entries.description: Shadow's Eve Daily Adventure: The battle against the Q'rsed is never over. Q'rsebane is a vital resource in that battle, but collecting it can be dangerous. Q'rsebane is a purple flower that grows above ground in the Cursed Vale. Please go and collect as much as you can.

entries.name: Collect Vials of Q'rsed Essence
entries.description: Shadow's Eve Daily Adventure: To defeat an enemy you must know it. To know our enemy we must study them. Go and defeat wolves and werewolves in the Cursed Vale. They may sometimes drop a Vial of Q'rsed Essence. Go collect it, then check the Shadowy Station for how it can be used.

entries.name: Defeat Pumpkin Dungeons
entries.description: Shadow's Eve Daily Adventure: They're spooking up everywhere, from the Permafrost to the Dragonfire Peaks and everywhere in between on Trove. Go find some of these Pumpkin Dungeons and scare them off! Make sure to clear out some of those Pumpkin Patches too!

entries.name: Help Contain Bad Souls
entries.description: Bad Souls are everywhere, and in increasing amounts! Collect Bad Soul Essence from them, then trade them in at Wolfsly!
entries.summary: Trade Bad Soul Essence to Wolfsly

entries.name: Recover Lost Memories
entries.description: Find the Wolves Lost Hunters once faced in life, and recover Hunter Memories to help Lost Souls in the Cursed Vale move on!
entries.summary: Recover Hunter Memories to help a Lost Soul!

entries.name: Repair the Instrument
entries.description: Search Pumpkin Dungeons for Instrument Fragments to help Lost Souls in the Forbidden Spires express themselves!
entries.summary: Recover and repair a broken instrument to help a Lost Soul!

entries.name: Rebind the Lost Book
entries.description: Search Dungeons across Trove for Lost Pages, and use those pages to help a Lost Soul in the CURSED VALE finally finish that novel...
entries.summary: Re-bind lost book pages to help a Lost Soul!

entries.name: Gather Ghostly Light
entries.description: Lost Souls leave a little of their light behind when someone helps them on their way. Help the souls out in the Adventure Worlds and gather what they leave you.
entries.summary: Gather Ghostly Light from Lost Souls

entries.name: Help Contain Bad Souls
entries.description: Bad Souls are invading every Adventure World, and they gather thickest in the Dragonfire Peaks, the Frozen Tundra, and the Fae Wilds. Put them down and collect the Bad Soul Essence they leave behind.

entries.name: Arm the Lost Souls
entries.description: A soul crossing over carries nothing to defend itself with. Seek them out in the Adventure Worlds, give them Soul Gear, and stand with them when the dark creatures answer.
entries.summary: Give Soul Gear to Lost Souls

entries.name: Collect Subzero Snowflakes
entries.description: Snowfest Daily Adventure: Can you get me some of those Subzero Snowflakes? I've heard the mimics from the Present or Tree dungeons you can find in Adventure Words have them. I use them to stay cool!

entries.name: Make a Donation
entries.description: Snowfest Daily Adventure: My best friend is in the Delver's Guild and she's studying the interactions between the Subzero Snowflakes and Subzero Shadowflakes. Use the Snowfest Table and Donate some for the cause, Trovian!

entries.name: Collect Subzero Shadowflakes
entries.description: Snowfest Daily Adventure: Diggsly gave the call to collect as many Subzero Shadowflakes as we can! You can get them by completing Delves during Snowfest. Pretty simple, eh? Lucky for us, Diggsly pays well!

entries.name: Earn a Dragon Coin
entries.description: Such a nice time of year. You should spend some time with other Trovians. Challenges are held every hour, and they even have rewards, so it's win-win. Either way, go out there and earn a Dragon Coin.
entries.summary: Play with others and earn a Dragon Coin.

entries.name: Get in the Snowball Fight
entries.description:
Snow-time is short. Snow-time is best. You don't think so? Try getting in a snowball fight and see if you still think not.

Enter a Snowball fight with the portal near the Events area of the hub and participate.

entries.name: Make a Snowfest Donation
entries.description: Trovian! Snowfest is all about giving, so why not give? Donate at the Snowfest Donation Station and share in the giving!
entries.summary: Donations are what make Snowfest so great!

entries.name: Complete a Present Dungeon
entries.description: Hey Trovian, Snowfest is a good time of year for someone who knows what's up. Do you? Let me school ya' a bit. Each year Present Dungeons pop up all over Trove, all full of fun stuff. If you're someone with skills you can clean 'em out and make a nice little profit. So how 'bout it? Easy jobs are the best jobs.
entries.summary: Seek out a Present Dungeon and clear it out.

entries.name: Complete a Snowfest Tree Dungeon
entries.description: Each year Snowfest Trees appear all over Trove, each year Trovians are sent to clear them out. This year is no different hero. Find the Trees and clear them out.
entries.summary: Seek out a Snowfest Tree Dungeon and defeat the enemies at the top.

entries.name: Snowfest Gift
entries.description: Reach mastery level 10 to see what you got!

entries.name: Snowfest Gift
entries.description: Reach mastery level 10 to see what you got!

entries.name: Snowfest Gift
entries.description: Reach mastery level 10 to see what you got!

entries.name: Save Some Horned Rumpfus
entries.description: Hello Trovian. I have made my way from the Permafrost to make a request. Some of my brethren are a little agitated. They're the kind of angry that only Saged Snowballs can cure. Could you do me a favor and go to the Permafrost and throw some Saged Snowballs at the angry Krampus, otherwise they're vibes will ruin Snowfest for the others there.

entries.name: Highlands Snowvaders
entries.description: Defeat Snowvaders in the Medieval Highlands
entries.summary: Snowvaders are invading the Medieval Highlands. Please spend some time destroying them!

entries.name: Cursed Vale Snowvaders
entries.description: Defeat Snowvaders in the Cursed Vale
entries.summary: Snowvaders are all over the Cursed Vale. Remove them.

entries.name: Fae Forest Snowvaders
entries.description: Defeat Snowvaders in the Fae Forest
entries.summary: Snowvaders have invaded our lands! Please help!

entries.name: Candoria Snowvaders
entries.description: Defeat Snowvaders in Candoria
entries.summary: Snowvaders march on Candoria. You must aid us.

entries.name: Neon City Snowvaders
entries.description: Defeat Snowvaders in Neon City

entries.name: Forbidden Spires Snowvaders
entries.description: Defeat Snowvaders in the Forbidden Spires
entries.summary: Trovian, help protect the Forbidden Spires, stop the Snowvaders!

entries.name: Place Elysian Offensive Standards in Trove and Geode
entries.description: It would seem the dinosaur holding guns wants you to place Elysian Offensive Standards all over TROVE and GEODE. Might be wise not to anger the dinosaur that is again, holding guns.

entries.name: Place Elysian Offensive Standards in the Everdark
entries.description: Many on Trove believe the denizens of the Everdark to be beyond the reach of the Light. The cowboys and dinosaurs of Trove know that there’s always a common ground. Place Elysian Offensive Standards in the Everdark and let Elysia’s light shine, perhaps we’ll draw some to our cause.
entries.summary: Bring Elysian light to the sunless dark.

entries.name: Defeat Obelisk Dungeons in the Everdark
entries.description: Our court is the most important member of this council. So, we have been tasked with the most important task. Find and defeat the masters of these obelisks and show them the fury of the fae.

entries.name: Defeat the Alpha Invaders
entries.description: Q’bthulhu has twisted the q’rse from the wolves’ den and crafted his abominations, Alphas. Draw them out and defeat them.

entries.name: Defeat enemies in the Everdark
entries.description: The Fae believes the obelisks are the targets, but they can’t even be destroyed! It’s Q’bthulhu’s forces that are the targets. Keep your eyes on the ball and do what actually matters.
entries.summary: The endless dead against the endless darkness.

entries.name: Fish in the Everdark
entries.description: Howdy again! You wouldn’t believe how hungry these Elysian Offensive warriors are getting while fighting the Shadow. We’ve heard that you can even fish the Everdark. I guess fish just don’t care about this kind of stuff. How about you fish a few?
entries.summary: Fish in the Everdark are so, oddly normal.

entries.name: Collect Carys Flux
entries.description: Awarded for completing a House Carys daily Sunfest adventure!

entries.name: Collect Panatea Flux
entries.description: Awarded for completing a House Panatea daily Sunfest adventure!

entries.name: Collect Tysorion Flux
entries.description: Awarded for completing a House Tysorion daily Sunfest adventure!

entries.name: Grab a bite?
entries.description: It looks so tasty.

entries.name: Fireworks!
entries.description: Handle with care.

entries.name: Be the light!
entries.description: Fight the shadows.

entries.name: Fireworks for Th'lan
entries.description: The Geode Hub can be reached using the Atlas [HK:Atlas]. Th'lan can be found in the RELIQUARY RESEARCH CENTER.
entries.summary: Deliver some Sunfest Fireworks to Th'lan in the Geode Hub.

entries.name: Radiant Donation for House Carys
entries.description: Donate Radiant Shards to a House Carys Quartermaster. When facing directly EAST after entering the Hub, three high-rise buildings can be seen. House Carys Quartermasters can be found within the CENTER building."
entries.summary: Donate Radiant Shards to a House Carys Quartermaster.

entries.name: Cake for Rokatan
entries.description: Give Sunfest Cake! to Rokatan. Rokatan can be found in the Delve building, directly WEST of the Hub center.
entries.summary: Give Sunfest Cake! to a Rokatan.

entries.name: Deliver Mushroom Chunks
entries.description: While establishing Trade routes in completed Dungeons, your Allies have learned of a Mushroom Festival nearby! "Bring Mushrooms" the flyer says.

entries.name: Deliver Bleached Bones
entries.description: A local (friendly) necromancer is running low on calcium and needs a boost!

entries.name: Deliver Enchanted Wood
entries.description: "You can't make an enchanted fire without some Enchanted Wood!" is what the note says...

entries.name: Deliver Wild Cupacakes
entries.description: The world famous Cupcake Tamer--Flan de Azuceroa--is putting on a show. Tadpole Tours will have your Allies selling cupcakes at the venue!

entries.name: Deliver Robot Parts
entries.description: Robot Part deliveries keeps the Neon City running 24/7!

entries.name: Deliver Meteorite Fragments
entries.description: There's a Mildly Pertured Scientist doing experiments on organic matter found on Meteorites. Tadpole Tours would like to help his research to see what develops!.

entries.name: Deliver Primordial Flame
entries.description: Tadpole Tours Team Building Handbook suggests occasional hot-coal-walking to help build bonds between Allies. This storage facility needs some more Primordial Ore for just this purpose!

entries.name: Deliver Cinnabar
entries.description: There's a monster here that eats Cinnabar! Another exciting destination brought to you by Tadpole Tours!

entries.name: Deliver Emberslag Ore
entries.description: There's a "Sundered Uplands" museum in the area and it could use some Emberslag Ore for a new exhibit!

entries.name: Deliver Emberslag Ore
entries.description: There's a "Sundered Uplands" museum in the area and it could use some Emberslag Ore for a new exhibit!

entries.name: Mine Shapestone
entries.description: Have your Ally mine Shapestone!

entries.name: Mine the X!
entries.description: The material that makes up the X above completed dungeons is valuable to Qubesly's cousin's friend's sister's nephew! The allies are going to collect some!

entries.name: Fungus Lich!
entries.description: This once-friendly Fungus got a little too curious about the dark arts. Alas, the Allies must end his tale.

entries.name: Ice Drake!
entries.description: The Allies are ready! A ferocious ICE DRAKE has been terrorizing the region, and must be dealt with!

entries.name: Kitastra!
entries.description: Catastra's progeny assaults this land! Only a Tadpole Tours Tiny Quest can set things right!

entries.name: Tirzzid!
entries.description: The evil king Tirzzid haunts the halls of this fallen dungeon. Can the Allies stop him?!

entries.name: Cornelious!
entries.description: The reign of Cornelious, the Czar of Azucar, has come to its end. And the Allies are the A-Team, assembled for the assignment!

entries.name: Midnight Kami!
entries.description: The Allies can make sure the Midnight Kami never rides again, saving the denizens of the Neon City!

entries.name: Terror-Rex!
entries.description: It's time to depose the King of the Jurassic Jungle! Or at least this tiny section of it.

entries.name: Dragonocles!
entries.description: This fearsome Dragon has the strength of roughly 3 Trovians!!!

entries.name: Jade Dragon!
entries.description: Revealing itself after all these years, ready to answer the Allies' challenge!

entries.name: Ashen Abomination!
entries.description: Only the Allies can stop its march of corruption!

entries.name: Lord of Flame!
entries.description: The (tiny) Lord of Flame has planted his flag and claimed this land. Only the Allies can stop him, and restore peace & order!

entries.name: Defeat the Fire Salamander
entries.description: At all scales, power coalseces around the forces of Evil, and Good. Here, the Tiny forces of Evil have found a champion that must be challenged in Tiny Quest combat!

entries.name: Necrotic Terror
entries.description: This cyclopic beast prowls the land, tempting fate and terrorizing the locals.

entries.name: Alpha Packleader
entries.description: Wolf packs have gotten out of hand! The Allies can put a stop to this threat!

entries.name: Festering Crowfather
entries.description: An undead malaise has settled in, and only the Allies can root it out by defeating the source: the Festering Crowfather!

entries.name: Gorehorn the Horrible
entries.description: Gorehorn's rampage of terror must end!

entries.name: Mysterious Egg
entries.description: The Allies are uncertain whether or not they should hatch this egg. But they're convince they CAN do it!

entries.name: Fallen Acolyte
entries.description: Never meet your Heroes... unless they become evil.

entries.name: Calcium Creep
entries.description: He's even more evil than he looks!

entries.name: Aquatic Mangler
entries.description: The time has come to evict this antagonist!

entries.name: Orange Recluse
entries.description: This poisonous pest is plauging this place! Destroy it!

entries.name: Roknog the Razer
entries.description: This cruel beast's time has come! Rally the Allies to bring him down!

entries.name: Defeat the Tiny Terror
entries.description: Have your Ally or Allies defeat the TINY TERROR, menacing the denizens of this Tiny land!

entries.name: Play Date: Grind XP
entries.description: Let your Allies spend some time grinding experience together!

entries.name: Restore Dungeon
entries.description: Capturing dungeons can be messy! Luckily, your Allies can help clean debris and repair damage!

entries.name: Portal Patrol
entries.description: The portals in this region are behaving oddly! Our crack team of Ally Portal Analysts can figure out what's going on!

entries.name: A Wild Garx
entries.description:
Legend has it this dungeon contains a wild Garx, ready to give your allies the ultimate TEST OF STRENGTH! 
WARNING: DO NOT HARM THE GARX. They are a protected species!

entries.name: Dabble in the Dark Arts
entries.description: Also the Light Arts, the Gray Arts, the Rainbow Arts, and any other arts that might get you ahead on your Mysticism assignment.

entries.name: Pie Eating Contest
entries.description: Allies generally have very little space in their stomachs.

entries.name: Longest Scream?
entries.description: Some kind of longest scream contest? How is this earning experience again?!

entries.name: Toxicity Cleanse
entries.description: There is some kind of toxic buildup in this Dungeon! It needs a deep scrub!

entries.name: Keep the Lights On
entries.description: Batteries are running low, but the Allies can help refill them! Hop on the Hamster Wheel and help generate some juice!

entries.name: Well Rescue!
entries.description: A small child has fallen into a well and needs to be rescued!

entries.name: Bullseye Tournament
entries.description: Darts? Archery? Water-Gun into the Clown's Mouth? It's all here!

entries.name: Circum-Cuboid Race!
entries.description: A race around the Cube?! This should be fun!

entries.name: Long Jump
entries.description: This is the perfect spot for a good, old-fashioned Long Jump competition!

entries.name: Treasure Hunt!
entries.description: Sometimes you just need to hunt for treasure!

entries.name: Dungeon Demolition
entries.description: Qubesly says this place has been re-zoned and needs to be demolished A.S.A.P.! Let's git 'er done!

entries.name: Gaming Competition
entries.description: Hopefully your Ally's got the thumbs for it!

entries.name: Long Hike
entries.description: Qubesly says he doesn't want to hear "Are we there yet?" ever again.

entries.name: Museum Tour: Highlands
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to the Medieval Highlands!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Permafrost
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to Permafrost!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Cursed Vale
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to the Cursed Vale!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Desert Frontier
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to the Desert Frontier!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Fae Forest
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to the Fae Forest!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Candoria
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to Candoria!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Neon City
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to Neon City!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Jurassic Jungle
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to the Jurassic Jungle!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Dragonfire Peaks
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to the Dragonfire Peaks!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Spires
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to the Forbidden Spires!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Uplands
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to the Sundered Uplands!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Lost Isles
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to the Lost Isles!

entries.name: Museum Tour: Geode
entries.description: There's a local ally-sized Museum here dedicated to Geode!

entries.name: Sky-Writers!
entries.description: Tadpole Tours has rented a plane, and the Allies want to write 'WE <3 QUBESLY' in the air!

entries.name: Sunken Treasure
entries.description:
Tadpole Tours has a lead on some SUNKEN PIRATE TREASURE!

Why do Pirates always have to go and put their treasure in obnoxiously-hard-to-reach places, anyway?

entries.name: Gather 3 Allies
entries.description: Arrange for 3 allies to stay still in one spot for a few seconds. This may take a while.

entries.name: Meditate on Solitude
entries.description: Sometimes your Allies just need to clear their head, and this spot is perfect!

entries.name: The Stacks
entries.description: The Allies want to search for ancient recipes, and what better spot than the ruins of a Recipe Dungeon?

entries.name: ALLY ASCENSION!
entries.description: The Legends were true! A single Ally can ASCEND almost instantly!

entries.name: ALLY ASCENSION!
entries.description: The Legends were true! A single Ally can ASCEND almost instantly!

entries.name: Complete 15 Dungeons
entries.description:
I'm not one to turn down a free meal, and the rays of rainbow you've managed to collect are perfect. Friendsgiving is the perfect time to help out other Trovians, so how about you head into Trove and clear out some of the enemies of Trove to make things easier on everyone. 

Complete 1 Star Dungeons.
entries.summary: I'm not sure why I'm over here, I'm not a Qubesly....

entries.name: Complete Three Star Dungeons
entries.description:
While we're here meeting sadly the enemies of Trove entrench in their strongholds. Find the enemies of Trove and defeat them!

Find and complete 3 Star Dungeons.

entries.name: Earn a Blast Coin
entries.description:
I don't know what it is, but I just wanna rip and tear through the Shadow. Don't you? Well you gotta have an outlet, try Bomber Royale... it has worked for me... for now.

Enter Bomber Royale and earn a Blast Coin.

entries.name: Defeat the Turkeytopia Delve Bosses
entries.description:
HWRAWR! That's dinosaur for 'Happy Friendsgiving!' As fun as this all is, the Turkeytopia Delve has returned. Why don't you hop in there and dino-kick them out of there!

Enter the Turkeytopia and defeat any of the bosses there.

entries.name: Kill Enemy Turkeys
entries.description:
Shadow Gobblers. Every year it's Shadow Gobblers. You can find most of them in Dragonfire Peaks, but if you wait long enough, they'll find you.

Defeat Shadow Gobblers in the Dragonfire Peaks.
entries.summary: So many turkeys, so little time.

entries.name: Collect Organics from Geode Caves
entries.description:
This gathering is wonderful. Thank you for inviting me and putting it together. That said it's never a bad idea to stock up on ingredients. Head into the geode caves and grab some.

Enter the Geode Caves and collect Organic crafting goods there.
