entries.description: Snowfest 2023 3/12: Each year the enemies of Trove go around stealing gifts from others. The Gift Giver's Standard allows you to take them back. Run around defeating enemies in Trove and see if you can claim any of the gifts back.

entries.name: Clear Present Dungeons
entries.description:
Snowfest 2023 4/12: I hope you got what you wanted and if you didn't, there's always more tomorrow!

Of course, as always, the Present dungeons have returned to Trove. Don't be fooled when you defeat their leader, they like to keep their 'treasure' in mimics. Be on guard and clear a few out.

entries.name: Clear Tree Dungeons
entries.description: Snowfest 2023 5/12: We can't forget to deal with the Tree dungeons as well. They are much bigger and a much bigger threat. They can pop up anywhere in Trove, so find a few and give 'em what for.

entries.name: Complete a Snowfest Daily
entries.description: Snowfest 2023 6/12: Trovian you rock. It worked! Chillio and all of the others have finally made it to the Hub! We're all hanging out in the Event's area talking about all the good we can do all over trove. Meet with us and help us spread the Snowfest cheer.

entries.name: Craft Saged Snowballs
entries.description: Snowfest 2023 7/12: Oh my. Trovian, the yetis in the Permafrost have turned to Horned Rumpfus again. You'll need Saged Snowballs to change them back. You can craft them at the Snowfest Table.

entries.name: Use Saged Snowballs
entries.description: Snowfest 2023 8/12: Saged Snowballs are special snowballs. They will calm down the Horned Rumpfus and help them revert back to yetis. The best part, they're very easy to use, just throw one and give it a try.

entries.name: Save Horned Rumpfus
entries.description: Snowfest 2023 9/12: Told ya, super easy. Now you can head to the Permafrost, find some Horned Rumpfus, and toss a Saged Snowball at them to turn them back into yetis.

entries.name: Use Warm Fuzzy Feeling
entries.description: Snowfest 2023 10/12: The best part of Snowfest is sharing the happiness with others. You might not have noticed, but Horned Rumpfus give you Warm Fuzzy Feelings when you turn them back into yetis. Use one and see if you can feel the love.

entries.name: Donate at the Donation Station
entries.description:
Snowfest 2023 11/12:  Thank you Trovian. The best part of Snowfest is giving back. The donation station is back and ready to send whatever you donate to those in need.

Use the Donation Station sitting next to the Snowfest Table in the Events area of the Hub to donate to the needy in Trove.

entries.name: Open the Leaderboards
entries.description:
Snowfest 2023 12/12: Wonderful! Now it’s time for the surprise! This year we’ve been tracking all the Snowfest fun you’ve been having!

Each time you unwrap a gift, complete a Snowfest Daily, use a Warm Fuzzy Feeling, or donate to the Donation Station increases your standing on the Snowfest Sharing Daily Leaderboard. 

Each day the top of the Leaderboard will get a special prize! Don’t worry though, you’ll always get something for taking part, because that’s what Snowfest is really about!

Open the Leaderboards to check it out.

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Speak to Garx
entries.description: Renewus 2024 1/7: Happy new year Trovian, and what a new year it is! The Heavyweight Champion of Trove Wrestling Entertainment is in the hub. You definitely shouldn't miss the opportunity to see what he's up to, and maybe get an autograph.

entries.name: Craft a Trove Fitness Unlimited Membership
entries.description:
Renewus 2024 2/7: Hello Trovian. How are you, do you feel weak? You look kind of weak, what you need is the proper training regimen. Lucky for you I'm here, and I've brought with me my signature Championship Training Weights. I can only offer it to official members of Trove Fitness Unlimited. And what luck, the Radiant Dayspring just happens to be selling membership. Shatter you limits with Trove Fitness Unlimited.

Craft the Trove Fitness Unlimited Membership at the Radiant Dayspring.

entries.name: Jump Around
entries.description:
Renewus 2024 3/7: Step one is complete. Can you feel the energy, the electricity in the air? I sense a challenger in you, can you?

Let's get started with a light warm up, just do whatever comes natural and get moving.

entries.name: Craft the Championship Training Weights
entries.description:
Renewus 2024 4/7: Step two of your journey is to purchase my all in one Championship Training Weights. And don't worry about the expense, it's just another obstacle on your fitness journey to greatness. You can craft it at the Radiant Dayspring, but you won't be able to see it unless you equip the Trove Fitness Unlimited Membership ally. It is members only afterall.

Equip the Trove Fitness Unlimited Membership ally and craft the Championship Training Weights at the Radiant Dayspring.

entries.name: Complete a Training Regimen
entries.description:
Renewus 2024 5/7: You can put that in your Cornerstone. You'll see one of the Training Regimen if you use the Championship Training Weights. They change each day, complete a workout every day and you'll be throwing enemies around like me in no time!

Craft a Training Regimen at the Championship Training Weights and complete the quest it gives.

entries.name: Defeat Enemies
entries.description: Renewus 2024 6/7: Well done. I can already see improvement. Let's test it out, a challenger can't fight the champion without proving themselves. If there's one thing, and, I, mean, ONE THING, I hate it's a bully. Find some chumps looking to start a fight and teach them a thing or two about being a bully.

entries.name: Hit the Renewus Orb
entries.description:
Renewus 2024 7/7: Victory, but of course you won. How could you lose now that you're on my training regimen? Now there's no point in putting in all this hardwork if you're not going to enjoy it. Kick your feet up, maybe hit that Renewus Orb that keeps dropping in the Hub.

Don't forget to keep training. Laziness is the enemy of success. Attack your goals and maybe one day even YOU can challenge the Champ.

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Meet Patrolsly in the Hub
entries.description:
Sunfest 2024 1/10: Hello Trovian, Sunfest is back! I'm in the hub in the Events Area in case that Pinzo buffoon makes another move. Come on by and check out what the Dragon Houses are up to this year.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

entries.name: Check out a House Vendor
entries.description:
Sunfest 2024 2/10: Each year the Dragon Houses celebrate Sunfest in the hub with all the other Trovians. Each of their Quartermasters offer rewards to Trovians that participate in the festivities. Go ahead and talk to any of them to see what they have this year.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

entries.name: Defeat the Pinzobomination Leader
entries.description:
Sunfest 2024 5/10: It looks like his Pinzo Printer has been malfunctioning, but I can't reach it because his forces are too powerful. Their leader is currently in the Fluxtuating Fissures delves, but it's not the man himself. It's... well you'll know it when you see it. I heard the house merchants talking about a new Gateway they found, and I think that might be your way in. Go check in with them for help.

Fight the leader of the Pinzobominations. The Gateway can be purchased from any of the Quartermasters in the Events area of the Hub.

entries.name: Defeat Sunfest Cake Enemies
entries.description:
Sunfest 2024 6/10: You made it back! While you were out I retrieved the Pinzo Printer, and it looks as messed up as the clones it's making. I had to go a long, long, long way away to get it, but it's here now for us to fix. It looks like it needs to be fed an extravagant cake, so you're going to need to get some ingredients from the cakes of Candoria. I'll give you the recipes once you've cleared out enough of them.

Defeat Sunfest cake enemies in Candoria and Cake Dungeons.

entries.name: Bake an Unnecessarily Expensive Cake at the Sunfest Oven
Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Speak with High Priest Lunavic
entries.description: Lunar Plunge 2/10: The Wolves of Chaos & Shadow are back! To fight them, we need to ... well, I'm not sure. Actually, our friend High Priest Lunavic will explain... go talk to him!

entries.name: Defeat a Chaos Wolf
entries.description: Lunar Plunge 3/10: Qubesly states the Chaos Wolves have returned to the Cursed Vale. We've much work to do, but first, I need you to confirm Qubesly's claim. Head to the CURSED VALE and defeat a CHAOS WOLF, which he says are roaming free there.

entries.name: Return to High Priest Lunavic
entries.description: Lunar Plunge 4/10: Return to High Priest Lunavic with the news of the Chaos Wolves in the Cursed Vale.

entries.name: Equip a Lunar Plunge Banner
entries.description: Lunar Plunge 5/10: Thank you for checking, Trovian. These fearsome Chaos Wolves are both in the Cursed Vale AND in the Shores of the Everdark! Please, speak with QUARTERMASTER TAURI, an Acolyte of the Sun here in the tent. Craft and Equip one of her Lunar Plunge banners–they will be necessary for what comes next.

entries.name: Defeat a Shadow Wolf
entries.description: Lunar Plunge 6/10: Excellent! These banners will allow you and our Acolytes to lure out the Shadow Wolves from hiding. They hunt magic... and, so, with a banner equipped, go into an Adventure World and get your MAGIC FIND to trigger. That should bring them running... for your blood...

entries.name: Collect Lunar Armor Fragments from Shadow Wolves
entries.description: Lunar Plunge 7/10: Great! Now just collect enough Lunar Armor Fragments from these Shadow Wolves so we can fully equip this year's new Acolytes.

entries.name: Craft Acolyte Armor
entries.description: Lunar Plunge 8/10: That should be enough. Return to the HUB and see QUARTERMASTER TAURI, who will help transform those Armor Fragments into something our Lunar Acolytes can use–allowing them to join you in your defense of Trove!

entries.name: Defeat Alphas in the Everdark
entries.description: Lunar Plunge 9/10: Thank you, Trovian! Our Acolytes now stand a chance when facing off against the Chaos & Shadow Wolves. But the Alphas in the SHORES of the EVERDARK remain a problem. Help us defeat this Shadowy, Chaotic menace once and for all by taking out the leaders of the invasion.

entries.name: Return to High Priest Lunavic
entries.description: Lunar Plunge 10/10: Good work! Return to me in the HUB for your reward, Trovian!

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Meet with Qubesly in the Hub
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 1/11: Trovian, I've got a conundrum on my hands. Delegates from the Sundered Uplands have come to the hub, but I can't figure out why they're here. Can you come help?

entries.name: Meet the Sundered Uplands delegates
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 2/11: As perhaps you can see, two delegates from the Sundered Uplands are visiting for the first time. They're being mostly cordial to each other, but I won't say I'm not a little worried... Go introduce yourself to them!

entries.name: Speak with Fungi Scrollpeddler in Sundered Uplands
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 3/11: Gave you the brush off? Me too. Maybe we should confer with the Fungi faction? Travel to the SUNDERED UPLANDS biome and ask a FUNGI SCROLLPEDDLER what is going on, please.

entries.name: Buy a JUICY BURGER and HEALTHFUL BROCCOLI
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 4/11: Well, according to our Fungi friends, this is some kind of election? And the delegates are known to accept food for their favor? Well, 'when in Uplands,' as they say... According to the Scrollpeddler, FUNGI THINGSHAPERS in Cloud Layer and Ashen Wastes outposts in the SUNDERED UPLANDS biome will sell the delegates' favorite foods. You should buy some of each!

entries.name: CHOOSE a delegate to give FOOD to
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 5/11: Now that you've got their favorite foods, you'll have to pick a delegate in the HUB whose favor you'd like. Our Fungi friends say that you can only donate to ONE delegate per day, so choose wisely!

entries.name: Equip an UP vs. DOWN banner
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 6/11: Are you ready to signal your temporary loyalty? When you donate food, the Delegate will help you craft a banner. From what the Fungi tell me, this Loyalty banner proves you're on their side.

entries.name: Complete a Delegate Assistant's Task
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 7/11: With that banner equipped, you should be able to accept and complete a task benefitting the Delegate by-way-of their assistant.

adventures.name: Deliver food to MEDIEVAL HIGHLANDS denizens

entries.name: Speak with FUNGI RECIPETAKER
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 8/11: A ballot? Now we're getting somewhere... Speak with another friend–the FUNGI RECIPETAKER–in Cloud Layer outposts in SUNDERED UPLANDS biome to get us more information.

entries.name: Interact with an UPLANDS BALLOT BOX
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 9/11: So Cloud Layer denizens vote UP... and Ashen Wastes denizens vote DOWN? Always? ... I guess it's that simple. Might as well ROCK THE VOTE at one of the Uplands Ballot Boxes here in the HUB.

entries.name: Vote at an UPLANDS BALLOT BOX
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 10/11: Well... I guess we just... collect more 'ballots'? By delivering food to citizens?... You know, I'm starting to think this might be some kind of census, not an election...

entries.name: Return to QUBESLY
entries.description: UP vs. DOWN 11/11: Great work, Trovian! The Delegates are both pleased with the vote turnout. They don't care about anything except rocking THEIR vote ...and delivering food. Return to me for your reward, and to see what the delegates helped me to engineer, thanks to the good will you generated!

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Talk to... a cat? In the Hub
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2024 1/10: Awooooo to you, Trovian! Shadow's Eve is here again! I don't have anything for you this year, but it looks like this talking cat does.

Come to the Events area of the Hub and talk to her to figure out what it wants.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

entries.name: Collect Some Pumpkins
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2024 2/10: Hello, Trovian. It looks like Wolfsly passed on my message. That's good, because I need you to do something fur me. Fur now though, I need some pumpkins. Why, you ask? I'll answer that when you're back.

Pumpkin Patches appear in the Cursed Vale during Shadow's Eve each year. They're big pumpkins, so you'll know it when you see one. Find one and collect some of the pumpkins.

entries.name: Complete Pumpkin Patch or Pumpkin Dungeons
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2024 3/10: Are those pumpkins I smell? You got quite a feast-I mean, you've done well, Trovian. Now, clear out some Pumpkin Patches or Pumpkin Dungeons for me. I know I said I'd tell you why I need pumpkins, but that can wait until after this.

Return to the Pumpkin Patches in the Cursed Vale or find the Pumpkin Dungeons scattered across Trove and clear them out.

entries.name: Collect some Q'rsebane
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2024 4/10: Oh, you're done. Well in good time too, I just finished eating. I magicked some of those pumpkins you gathered over to me, and now I can tell my story with a full stomach, and besides I owe you an explanation. I'm a witch that's been cursed to take the form of my familiar, and I want help undoing the curse to turn myself back. Since you've already come this far, could you go an collect some Q'rsebane for me?

Q'rsebane is a purple flower that grows in the Cursed Vale during Shadow's Eve. It has some weird, spooky aura, you can't miss it.

entries.name: Clear out Wolves and Werewolves
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2024 5/10: Now that that's done, I'll need to ensure my safety to get everything ready. Shadow's Eve is a dangerous time for cats, so if you could clear out some of those nasty Wolves and Werewolves that would be pawsitively delightful.

The wolves should only be in the Cursed Vale thanks to a certain someone's diligence, so look there for them. Try not to get bitten just yet.

entries.name: Craft a Delve Gateway: Wolves’ Den
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2024 6/10: I hope you've gotten used to being around wolves, Trovian, because now it's time for you to visit their den. Yes, you'll need to get cursed to help me cure my curse. I don't know why, it just works that way. Don't worry, you'll be fine. To get cursed you'll need to craft a Delve Gateway: Wolves’ Den.

Craft one at the Shadowy Station in the Events area of the hub.

entries.name: Defeat a Wolves’ Den Boss
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2024 7/10: Now go place that down and defeat one of the bosses of the Wolves' Den. Be sure to get cursed while you fight it. Why am I not doing this myself? I mean, it's dangerous fur a cat like me, and honestly this spot I'm in is really nice and I don't want to leave it. Maybe that's the cat speaking.

entries.name: Cure the Curse by Crafting Elsphodel's Blessing
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2024 8/10: They say misery loves company, and to be honest seeing you cursed has helped me understand that. Let's not keep you like that for too long though. Go craft Elshpodel's Blessing at the Shadowy Station to get rid of that curse for us.

entries.name: Return to the Witch
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2024 9/10: It actually worked! I owe you a lot Trovian, so meet me in the hub once more so I can give you a reward. I'm not the type of person to leave a debt unpaid, you know. Happy Shadow's Eve!

entries.name: Complete Shadow's Eve Dailies
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2024 10/10: Sounds like you've done something good for that cat-now-person! Good timing too, some friends have made their way back to continue the Shadow's Eve fun. They should have a lot for you to do, so you can enjoy Shadow's Eve to the fullest! Awoooooooooo!

 Complete some of the daily tasks for Shadow's Eve.

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Meet with Chefsly
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 1/14: Hello Trovian! Friendsgiving is here, our friends are coming soon but I haven't made half of the dishes yet! If we want Friendsgiving to be a success, we'll need to get cooking fast.

Come to the Event's area of the Hub and speak with me so we can make sure this Friendsgiving goes without a hitch.

entries.name: Craft Trovian Bouillon
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 2/14: The first and most important ingredient when cooking for Friendsgiving is Trovian Bouillon. I sent the recipe to your claims if you don’t already know it and you can buy the materials from my sous-chef and prepare it at the Friendsgiving Oven.

Use the Friendsgiving Oven to make Trovian Bouillon.

entries.name: Clear 3 Star Dungeons for Garx
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 3/14: Now that you have that, we need to cook our first meal, or at least the first one while you're here to help with. First on the docket is Garx, who likes Lasagna. He's a strong man who likes his food just as strong, so clear some 3 star dungeons for the most powerful ingredients you can find in Trove, within reason of course. I've also sent some recipes for some old favorites to your claims, plus a few new extras, but you can worry about that later.

Clear 3 Star Dungeons all across Trove.

entries.name: Cook Garx's Favorite Dish
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 4/14: Good job Trovian! Now get back here, you need to make the Lasagna for Garx as soon as possible. I've sent you the recipe, so get it made.

Cook Mighty Lasagna for Garx. Again, if you need any materials you couldn't find you can buy some from my sous-chef. Don't feel shy, the clock's ticking.

entries.name: Clear Dungeons in the Sundered Uplands for the Cloud Layer and Ashen Wastes Delegates
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 5/14: That looks perfect! I'll get it on the table, you head out to the Sundered Uplands because now we're making Burgers and Broccoli for the Cloud Layer and Ashen Wastes Delegates from the Sundered Uplands. I promised them Burgers and Broccoli, and they made peace for just enough time to come by this year, so we need to make sure it gets done. Chop chop!

Clear Dungeons in the Sundered Uplands.

entries.name: Cook the Delegates' Favorite Dish
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 6/14: Excellent work Trovian! Let's get this dish cooked pronto. You have no idea how hard it was getting those two to eat at the same table, so we better make it worth their while. Once again I've sent you the recipe.

Cook Burgers and Broccoli for the Sundered Uplands Delegates. As always, my sous-chef is selling materials should you need them.

entries.name: Clear Dungeons in the Treasure Isles for Saltwater Sam's Crew
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 7/14: You're making good time Trovian! There may be hope for Friendsgiving yet. I'll get this plated, and you head off to the Treasure Isles because Saltwater Sam's Crew is all coming, and they want Kraken Soup. I guess if you spend all your time at sea you get a taste for what lives within it. Now's not the time for poetry though. Now's the time for cooking.

Clear Dungeons in the Treasure Isles.

entries.name: Cook Saltwater Sam's Crew's Favorite Dish
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 8/14: Perfect. Sam's got a pretty big crew, so we'll need to be sure this gets made quickly or we'll have four hungry guests arriving soon. I've sent you the recipe, so make us some Kraken Soup! Yes us, I'll be having some too. It's just so good.

Cook Kraken Soup for Saltwater Sam's Crew. My sous-chef has ingredients for sale if you need them, you know the drill.

entries.name: Clear Dungeons in the Cursed Vale for the Witch
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 9/14: We're in the home stretch Trovian! Just one more meal, and it's for the Witch this time. Seems she's taken to staying in her cat form all year round, and when she's like that she can't resist some good Tuna. Go to the Cursed Vale and get some for her.

Clear Dungeons in the Cursed Vale.

entries.name: Cook the Witch's Favorite Dish
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 10/14: This is the last one! I've sent you the recipe, so let's not waste time and get this done! And before you ask, no I don't know why you can find Tuna in Cursed Vale Dungeons. I try not to ask questions at times like this.

Cook Canned Tuna for the Witch. Sous-chef, ingredients, you get the picture.

entries.name: Grab a bite of the food
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 11/14: Youv'e saved Friendsgiving Trovian! I can't thank you enough. For now, grab a bite from something before our guests arrive. You've earned it.

Press [HK:Loot] to grab a bit of food while looking at one of the main dishes at the table.

entries.name: Craft a Turkeytopia Gateway
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 12/14: Our guests have arrived, and they seem pleased! You really saved Friendsgiving. Well, my Friendsgiving anyway. There seems to be activity going on in Turkeytopia, so if you wouldn't mind crafting a Delve Gateway: Turkeytopia at the Turkeytopia Table and checking out what's going on there, that would be great.

The Turkeytopia delve is only available during Friendsgiving each year. You should craft a Gateway at the Turkeytopia Table and see what's going on in there.

entries.name: Complete a Turkeytopia Delve
entries.description: Friendsgiving 2024 13/14: Now with that you can place it, head into the Turkeytopia Delve, and complete it. Please make sure everything's alright down there for me.

entries.name: Complete Friendsgiving Dailies
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2024 14/14: I forgot to mention, but we had a few more guests come late, the Qubeslys. Seems like they want your help, so go check out what they need. I don't have anything left for you, so once you're done I hope you have a great Friendsgiving!

The Qubeslys, at the Qubesly table by the Crafting Corner, have some requests for you. Complete some of their daily requests.

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Speak with Elfsly in the Hub
entries.description: Snowvasion 1/12: Trovian! I've got terrible, chilling news! Snowmen are INVADING! Come speak with me in the hub as soon as you can, please! We have to put a stop to this!

entries.name: Speak with Frostay the Snowman
entries.description: Snowvasion 2/12: Our friend and ally, Frostay the Snowman, is also here to help! He and I have come up with a plan to end this invasion.

entries.name: Collect Snowvader Remnants
entries.description: Snowvasion 3/12: Ice to meet you, Trovian! We're not sure what went wrong with these invading Snowmen, but we think we have a way to fix it! To implement this plan, the first thing we need are some SNOWVADER REMNANTS. Although Snowvaders can technically show up across all of Trove, they are naturally most concentrated in PERMAFROST--they much prefer the cold, you see. Head there and collect a SNOWVADER REMNANT!

entries.name: Speak with Elfsly in the Hub
entries.description: Snowvasion 4/12: If we repurpose those Remnants you've gathered, we can reconstitute classic, kind-hearted Snowmen. If we get enough Classic Snowmen in Permafrost, that should stop the invasion! Elfsly has agreed to help us with the next step, go speak with him!

entries.name: Bleach Snowvader Remnants
entries.description: Snowvasion 5/12: To make Classic Snowmen, we need Classic Snowman Gear. Frostay can dye those Remnants the necessary blue, but we need to BLEACH them first! That's where I come in!

entries.name: Speak with Frostay the Snowman
entries.description: Snowvasion 6/12: Now go see Frostay to see what it takes to DYE the Remnants!

entries.name: Craft Classic Snowman Gear
entries.description: Snowvasion 7/12: Using DYE is simple, but I need the materials to make some! Once you've got the materials, bring them to me and DYE some BLEACHED SNOWVADER REMNANTS to create CLASSIC SNOWMAN GEAR!

entries.name: Collect Pristine Snow
entries.description: Snowvasion 8/12: Once you've collected all the materials, I can help you craft a CLASSIC SNOWMAN. The rarest material of all, however, is PRISTINE SNOW. But I know where you can find some! The TREE DUNGEONS which appear throughoug Trove during Snowfest are where you need to go!

entries.name: Craft Classic Snowmen
entries.description: Snowvasion 9/12: Now return to me and craft a CLASSIC SNOWMAN!

entries.name: Use Classic Snowmen in Permafrost
entries.description: Snowvasion 10/12: Now it should be a simple step: just head to PERMAFROST and release that Classic Snowman! That'll begin to tip the scales in our favor!

entries.name: Return 20 Classic Snowmen to Permafrost
entries.description: Snowvasion 11/12: Easy, right?! But repelling the invasion will require fortitude and persistence! You'll need to do this a few more times if you want to really have an impact on the invasion, so let's get to it!

entries.name: Speak with Elfsly in the Hub
entries.description: Snowvasion 12/12: Nice work, Trovian! You're really making an impact! Come back to the hub for a well-deserved reward!

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Speak to Garx
entries.description: Renewus 2025 1/9: Another new year is upon us, Trovian! The Champion has returned: me! Garx! I've been training since four o'clock this morning. Come join me, and let's get fit!

entries.name: Equip Trove Fitness Unlimited Membership
entries.description: Renewus 2025 2/9: The most important part of my regimen is this: it's for members only! Equip the Trove Fitness Unlimited Membership to get started. If you are a new member, use the Championship Training Weights to craft it!

entries.name: Daily Warm Up
entries.description: Renewus 2025 3/9: First things first. It's important to properly warm up before any work out! Check the Championship Training Weights for today's Daily Warm-Up, and get it done!

entries.name: Complete a Daily Exercise
entries.description: Renewus 2025 4/9: Now that you're good and warmed up, it's time to pick your first exercise for the day! Once again, you can find it on the Championship Training Weights.

entries.name: Drink a GARX-ADE
entries.description: Renewus 2025 5/9: Exhausted? GOOD! To get your energy back, you can drink one of my patened GARX-ADE beverages! It's specially formulated to rejuvenate even the most enervated Trovian! Fair warning, you HAVE to drink it in Permafrost, otherwise the miraculous chemical processes won't be as effective!

entries.name: Complete another Daily Exercise
entries.description: Renewus 2025 6/9: Back on your feet? GOOD! It's time for another exercise! Check the Championship Training Weights and put in that effort!

entries.name: Drink another GARX-ADE
entries.description: Renewus 2025 7/9: Very impressive, Trovian! Now head back to Permafrost and drink another Garx-Ade! The most important test of strength is coming up next!

entries.name: Fight Garx!
entries.description: Renewus 2025 8/9: Are you ready to bring it? Come find me in the hub and go toe-to-toe with me for a round or two, Trovian! Let's see how much you've been training!

entries.name: Collect your reward from Garx
entries.description: Renewus 2025 9/9: Well, the Champ is still the Champ... But you put up a good fight! Keep up your training! In the meantime, come see me for a reward for all the impressive effort you've put in so far!

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Meet H.E.C.K. Helper Hailey
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 1/12: Trovian! I am Hailey, an Ambassador from H.E.C.K., here visiting Trove to spread goodwill! What is H.E.C.K., you ask? Why it's an intergalactic organization to which I belong: Helpers of Exotic Creatures... for Karma! Come meet me in the hub!

entries.name: Help Heckbugs in Geode Caves
entries.description:
What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 2/12: As you may have noticed, Heckbugs have taken to Trove & Geode for their yearly spawning migration. While they can be vicious & deadly, they can also be cute & cuddly! Since this species is categorized as Exotic, our organization has tasked itself with ensuring their protection! And you can help!

Head into one of the Geode Caverns (Sunken Sunvault, Verdant Veins, or Moonglow Grotto), and use CRITTER TREATS, COMFORT BLANKETS, and CURING KITS to Feed, Warm, and Heal-up the poor lil' Heckbugs!

entries.name: Meet H.E.C.K. Heartwarmer Harold
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 3/12: HELLO, TROVIAN! I see you've met my counterpart, Hailey. While she helps the young Heckbugs thrive in their new environments, I have a much more exciting job: helping to get those young Heckbugs born in the first place! Come see me in the Hub so we can get started!

entries.name: Purchase Amorous Heckbugs from Heartwarmer Harold
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 4/12: Heckbug mating can be a complex process, but we've nearly perfected it. I've got quite a collection of Amorous Heckbugs, ready to find love! Buy some from me to get ready for the next step.

entries.name: Use an Amorous Heckbug in Dragonfire Peaks
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 5/12: Now just head to DRAGONFIRE PEAKS and let one of those lil' cuties loose!

entries.name: Help Amorous Heckbugs find Love
entries.description:
What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 6/12: Now run around and find another Heckbug for your Heckbug to romance! Heckbugs are notoriously picky, so it may take a few!

Repeat this 10 times, and you'll have some idea of what I do every day this season!

entries.name: Hatch a Heckbug Egg
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 7/12: It's me again, Hailey! Are you ready for the final stage in building this circle of life? It's time to hatch a Heckbug Egg! You can find these eggs all around the Geode Caverns, and hatch them at the EGG INCUBATOR!

entries.name: Meet the Heckbug Hunter
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 8/12: Trovian... the H.E.C.K. isn't all they claim to be... Meet me behind their structure in the Hub to learn more...

entries.name: Complete the Heckbug Hunter's Daily Quest
entries.description:
What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 9/12: Hailey and Harold are keeping themselves blind from the truth: Heckbugs are bloodthirsty killers! They'll destroy entire planets, they will! I've seen it happen, and it'll happen again! UNLESS we put a stop to them! You've got to cull their numbers, and every day that you do I'll reward you for it!
AND REMEMBER! If you don't have my banner, you'll need Amorous Heckbugs to strip their blasted shielding!

entries.name: Equip the Standard of the Heckbug Hunter
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 10/12: I knew you had that killer instinct. There's one last step, and it requirest he Standard of the Heckbug Hunter. Purchase the banner from me and equip it!

entries.name: Defeat Heckbug Invaders
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 11/12: To save Trove from the heckbug hordes, we have to target the Heckbug Invaders. You may have already seen some, dropping from the sky. But they also hide out in dungeons, and with the Banner equipped you can draw them out!

entries.name: Return to the Heckbug Hunter
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2025 12/12: Great work, Trovian! Return to me, I've got a reward for ya--something I took from those silly H.E.C.K.-heads, Haily & Harold.

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Speak with Captain Markos Ybarra
entries.description: Marquitillo Missing 1/4: Trovian! My nephew is missing! Please, come find me in the Hub to help me find him!

entries.name: Complete 5-Star Dungeons
entries.description:
Marquitillo Missing 2/4: He said something about... a Rubber Duckhat? Rubber Duckats have recently shown up in 5-Star dungeons... maybe search those for something related?

5-Star dungeons can primarily be found in Geode Topside worlds or Long Shade difficulty worlds.

entries.name: Find Marquitillo in 5-Star Dungeons
entries.description: Marquitillo Missing 3/4: I'm hearing talk of Rubber Duckats in 5-Star dungeons across Trove. I guess Marquitillo was onto something afterall... Please, find him and bring him home!

entries.name: Return to Captain Markos Ybarra
entries.description: Marquitillo Missing 4/4: You found him! Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! Please come back so I can reward you, Trovian!

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Meet with St. Qubesly
entries.description: 1/11 St. Qubeslick 2025: Happy St. Qubeslick Trovian! Come over and speak with me in the Events area of the Hub to join in the celebration!

entries.name: Collect Sir O'Lucky's Coins
entries.description: 5/11 St. Qubeslick 2025: Did you see that extra chest that spawned? That was a box of Sir O'Lucky's Coins. They should spawn at the end of any dungeon you complete in the DESERT FRONTIER, NEON CITY, LUMINOPOLIS, and JURASSIC JUNGLE during St. Qubeslick. Go ahead and collect some of those, they're going to be needed later.

entries.name: Craft Something at the Pot o' Gold
Send Lucksnakes to the Mini-Pot o' Gold
Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Greet Qubesly in the Bunfest Pavillion
entries.description: Bunfest 2025 1/12: Trovian! Bunfest is here again and that means our friends have returned! Come greet our Hoppin' friends and me at the pavillion in the hub.

entries.name: Hunt for Eggs
entries.description:
Bunfest 2025 2/12: Each year Bunfest comes and each year we celebrate. My favorite part is hiding eggs all over Trove. I start hopping with joy whenever I think about Trovians finding the little things. Why don't you go out and find a few?

Eggs can be found in the Medieval Highlands, Fae Forests, Candoria, Frobidden Spires, and Geode Topside at Adept Difficulty (1) or higher.

entries.name: Defeat Eggmen
entries.description: Bunfest 2025 3/12: Trovian! There are Eggs all over Candoria, and not the ones that I placed! They're scrambling up all the fun, why don't you go and teach them not to mess with Bunfest.

entries.name: Defeat King Egon
entries.description: Bunfest 2025 4/12: The eggmen have a leader, King Egon. Unfortunately there's a lot of 'King Egons' out there. Find an Egg Dungeon in Candoria and depose this would be ruiner of Bunfest.

entries.name: Defeat Bunfest Delve Bosses
entries.description: Bunfest 2024 5/12: Well done Trovian, but it turns out they're even in the Delves. Well we'll have to deal with that too. Head back to the Hub and craft any of the Depth Steppers, then head in there and defeat a few of these yolksters.

entries.name: Complete an Egghunt
entries.description:
Bunfest 2025 6/12: Did you see the Tyr-egg-asaurus? Well you should be happy you didn't if not. I'm starting to think this may be a longer term problem. It might be best to get back to the festivities of Bunfest.

Now, all this unrest might be a little my fault. You see I kind of, sort of, a little bit, maybe borrowed some teeny, tiny, itty-bitty pieces of King Egon's kingdom for Bunfest. I'm going to give them back, I promise! For now just have some fun and let me deal with the politics.

In the meantime, find one of my Bunfest Egghunts in Candoria and have some fun. The eggs can have Chocolate, Bunfest Tokens, and even a few more little treasures.

entries.name: Complete Bunfest Dalies
entries.description: Bunfest 2025 7/12: Well, I have never been condescended to in such a rude manor. King Egon really needs classes on manners. But nevermind Bunfest continues, and what is Bunfest without the bun-fwens. They're here in the HUB and looking for your help. Once you're done feel free to keep on hunting eggs, after all you can only make a king so mad.

entries.name: Make a Donation
entries.description: Bunfest 2025 8/12: With all that completed there's only one thing left, sharing the joy of Bunfest! Head over to the Events Area of the Hub and make a donation at the Bunfest Station.

entries.name: Open your Leaderboard
entries.description:
Bunfest 2025 9/12: That's most everything there is to do Trovian.

I almost forgot, there's a Leaderboard this year! Each time you defeat an Egg Dungeon, complete a Daily quest, complete a Delve, or each egg you open in an Egghunt will earn you Score on the Bunfest Leaderboad. You can track your progress under the Daily Contests tab of the Leaderboards UI.

Open the Leaderboard with [HK:Leaderboards].

entries.name: Talk with Lepora
entries.description: Bunfest 2025 10/12: Trovian, a curious visitor has been hanging around the Bunfest Pavillion this year. She goes by Lepora, why don't you introduce yourself?

entries.name: Trade Chocolate to Lepora
entries.description: Bunfest 2025 11/12: I'm not just here to learn, I'm also collecting Refined Bunfest Chocolate to bring back to my time! It's a LOT more expensive there! Tell you what, if you can get me some, I'll trade you this nifty futuristic phone I've got!

entries.name: Return to Sir Qubesly
entries.description:
Bunfest 2025 12/12: A visitor from another time?! Fascinating! I wonder what the future is like... I bet it smells different!
Anyway, thanks again for all your effort this year, Trovian! Come see me for a reward!

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Talk to Sir Dapper Duckington Esquire
entries.description: Spring Sting 2025 1/8: QUACK, QUACK, QUACK! THAT'S RIGHT, TROVIAN! YOU HEAR THE QUACK, YOU KNOW I'M BACK. QUACK! COME ON OVER FOR A QUACK.

entries.name: Fling Spring Flingers
entries.description: Spring Sting 2025 2/8: QUACK! I AM SIR DAPPER DUCKINGTON ESQUIRE! QUACK! OF COURSE YOU KNOW THIS ALREADY, QUACK, AND IF YOU KNOW THAT YOU KNOW THAT IF IT'S SPRING YOU MUST FLING. QUACK! LUCKILY FOR YOU I HAPPEN TO HAVE SOME SPRING FLINGERS, QUACK, SO LET THE FLINGING BEGIN! QUACK!

entries.name: Defeat Waspiders in Medieval Highlands, Permafrost, or Neon City
entries.description:
Spring Sting 2025 3/8: QUACK, SEE HOW MUCH FUN IT IS! QUACK! YOU KNOW WHAT'S NOT FUN? WASPIDERS! QUACK! WASPIDERS HARASS BEES AND RUIN FUN, QUACK! HEAD ON OVER TO THE MEDIEVAL HIGHLANDS, THE PERMAFROST, OR NEON CITY AND FIGHT THEM, QUACK! 

DON'T FORGET, YOU'LL NEED SPRING FLINGERS TO SUMMON BEES TO HELP YOU, QUACK! OTHERWISE YOU WON'T EVEN BE ABLE TO HURT THE WASPIDERS, QUACK!

entries.name: Fill Beehives with Bees
entries.description: Spring Sting 2025 4/8: QUACK! SPRING FLINGERS CAN DO MORE THAN HELP DEFEAT WASPIDERS, QUACK! FIND A BEEHIVE IN THE FAE FOREST OR NEON CITY AND THROW FLINGERS AT THEM TO FILL THEM UP, QUACK!

entries.name: Defeat 1 Star Dungeons for Qubesly
entries.description:
Spring Sting 2025 5/8: Excuse me Trovian, sorry to interrupt the quacking and the flinging but those dungeons won't clear themselves. Could you please get back to the everyday tasks before resuming the Spring Fling activities?

Defeat 1 Star Dungeons for Qubesly.

entries.name: Collect an Item from a Beehive
entries.description: Spring Sting 2025 6/8: QUACK! TROVIAN, PLEASE DISREGARD ANY REQUESTS FROM QUBESLY DURING SPRING FLING, QUACK! I HAVE SERVED HIM WITH AN OFFICIAL CEASE AND DESIST. QUACK! I STLL NEED ONEMORE THING FROM YOU, QUACK! FIND MORE BEEHIVES AND THROW SPRING FLINGERS AT THEM AND WHO KNOWS, QUACK, YOU MIGHT FIND SOMETHING SPECIAL! DO THAT AND THE BEES MIGHT SEND YOU A GIFT, QUACK! SERIOUSLY, THAN-CKS FOR HELPING OUT WITH THE BEES AND THE WASPIDERS, QUACK! IT MEANS A LOT. QUACK!

entries.name: Defeat the Waspider Alpha In Fae Wilds and Neon City
entries.description: Spring Sting 2025 7/8: QUACK! TROVIAN! ALERT! ALERT! WE'VE SPOTTED THEM! THE WASPIDER HIVES! IT'S TIME TO END THIS FEUD ONCE AND FOR ALL TROVIAN! DIVE DEEP INTO THEIR 3-STAR HIVES AND DRIVE THEM OUT. FLINGERS WONT HELP IN THIS ONE. BE READY.

entries.name: Return to Sir Dapper Duckington for Your Reward
entries.description: Spring Sting 2025 8/8: QUACK! TROVIAN! YOU DID IT! YOU BESTED THE WASPIDERS! THE BEES HAVE SENT AN ESTEEMED EMISSARY TO ASSIST YOU IN YOUR BATTLES FROM HENCEFORTH!

entries.name: Complete Qubesly's Quest to access Events
entries.description: Finish helping Qubesly to participate in Events! You can change your tracked quest at the Adventures Board.

entries.name: Visit GMQubesly in the Hub.
entries.description: Splendid Summer 1/8:  Hello Trovian! Come check out my colorful wares! A celebration of being a prideful Trovian!

entries.name: Spend some Valor Coins
entries.description: Splendid Summer 2/8: Use your Valor Coins to purchase a reward.

entries.name: Defend your fellow Trovians!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 3/8: Your next quest requires your might, defeat 3 Star Dungeons and gather more Valor Coins for more rewards from my shop!

entries.name: Return to GMQubesly in the hub!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 4/8: Visit me in the hub! As the Grand Marshal, your many Valor Coins will grant access to more rewards! Come see!

entries.name: Show off your new gear and jump in the Hub!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 5/8:  Show your valor all month long! This month is a reminder of supporting, encouraging, and showing love in more ways than one. Share that with your fellow Trovians.

entries.name: Defeat 3 Star Dungeons
entries.description: Splendid Summer 6/8: Celebrate your power and strength Trovian! Your strength is beyond compare of the void that we live in. Show your true might in this realm and in the next to bring down powerful enemies!!

entries.name: Complete CHALLENGES and make friends with everyone!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 7/8: This month is about being a part of a whole! To take pride in solving the world's problems together! Join CHALLENGES and embark on a journey with others and learn how it is to be a community!

entries.name: Protect your friends from harm and defeat their foes!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 8/8:  This month is about being yourself, and allowing people to be their true selves. Protect your friends from enemies that prevent that. Share the love, encourage others, and have fun Trovians!

entries.name: Event: Sunfest
entries.description: To access the Sunfest Questline, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Meet Patrolsly in the Hub
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 1/31: Good tidings, Trovian. Sunfest is finally back! Can you believe it's been 10 years since the Sunfest Statue first went up? I'm in the Hub in the Events Area, patrolling the premises because of how things happen spontaneously around this part of the year. Come on by and check out what the Dragon Houses are up to this year.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

entries.name: Meet a House Panatea Quartermaster
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 2/31: Each year, three of the Dragon Houses celebrate Sunfest in the hub with all the other Trovians. The House Quartermasters help organize Sunfest.

Meet with a HOUSE PANATEA QUARTERMASTER to see what they've got in store this year, then work your way through the other houses.

entries.name: Craft Sunfest Fireworks for House Panatea
Collect Radiant Shards for House Carys
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 5/31: Greetings, Trovian! Welcome to House Carys. We fly the flag of Carys, the Seraph of the Golden Vale. For us, she represents the wealth that we all shared when we first came into this land, and to commemorate that, we should decorate our Hub with material that celebrate her divine radiance!

Collect Radiant Shards in the RADIANT RUINS.

entries.name: Return to House Carys
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 6/31: You get those Shards, Trovian? Now we can make the festival shine with Carys' light! Please return to me when you get a chance!

entries.name: Meet with a House Tysorion Quartermaster
Return in a Few Days
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 Intermission: Shadowy invasions, eh? Interesting. Something to keep an eye out for, but shouldn't disturb our festivities. Continue helping the Dragon Houses prepare for the Sunfest celebration, Trovian!

Return in a few days (JULY 8) and I may have more tasks for you!

entries.name: Talk to Patrolsly in the Hub
Clear 1-STAR Dungeons
entries.description: Sunfest 2024 12/31: Trovian! Please don't panic, but I've gotten reports that the Shadows have really been growing. It's no longer faint whispers. I need you to see for yourself if it really is true. Our first lead points us to Dungeons, go follow up on it, will you?

entries.name: Visit a House Panatea Quartermaster
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 13/31: Hey Trovian! House Panatea Quartermaster, here! I hear you've been researching the appearance of Shadows around Trove.

Come see me in the Hub, and I'll share our findings.

entries.name: House Panatea: Somber Essence
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 14/31: There have always been Shadows, but this year their numbers are steadily inreasing. The other Dragon Houses are too weak to pull us out of this, so I need you to defeat some Shadows and collect their essence so we can research it some more.

Collect SOMBER ESSENCE across Trove by defeating Shadowy Invaders, wherever they may be.

entries.name: Defeat Shadows in Delves
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 15/31: Trovian! Valiant work up there! But the shadows are not just coming from the surface, they also are coming in droves in Delves. Help us drive their numbers down!

Defeat the Shadowy Invaders in Delves.

entries.name: Visit a House Carys Quartermaster
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 16/31: Trovian! We've done some research in figuring out what to do about this Shadow Problem. Come see me in the Hub and I can tell you all about it!

entries.name: House Carys: Collect Golden Souls
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 17/31: Trovian. In our ancient text, Carys used her golden light to banish the Shadows. To replicate her power, you need to collect some GOLDEN SOUL found all over Trove and synthesize it. We might be able to salvage this. IF only the other Houses pulled their weight, then the Goddess' power would be enough to protect us.

Collect Golden Souls for House Carys.

entries.name: Speak with a House Tysorion Quartermaster
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 18/31: Trovian! I've caught wind of your intention to synthesize your Golden Souls. Smart... but misguided! Come find me in House Tysorion.

entries.name: Collect Somber Souls for House Tysorion
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 19/31: Though the text may have archived the synthesis, the key to it is the special compounds that House Tysorion makes - and the only way to complete it?

Find some Somber Souls! Return with the Somber Souls, and before you know it, our scientists will have us going on the offensive!

entries.name: Speak to Patrolsly
entries.description:
Sunfest 2025 20/31: Trovian, I have a report! The Shadows' numbers have gone from bad to worse, and nothing we've been doing, or the Dragon Houses have been doing, has helped quell this chaos! Not only that but the houses have been bickering even worse than they ever did before.

Come chat with me so we can get on the same page...

entries.name: Return in a Few Days
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 Intermission: Right now, we still need to stop the Shadows' advance. The Three Houses have launched three separate initiatives to try to get to the root of this Shadow invasion. Continue helping the Draconic Houses with their work. Return to me in a few days (JULY 15) and check in on our progress.

entries.name: Speak to Patrolsly
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 21/31: Trovian!! Bad news, we have reports of increased Shadow activity from all across Trove. Not just that, but the MOONTOUCHED MENACE has returned! Come see me in the Hub, and we can talk about moving forward with our plan of attack.

entries.name: Speak to a House Tysorion Quartermaster
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 22/31: The Menace has the Houses are in panic. You have to ease their minds. The Shadows will not overwhelm us, as long as we keep our heads up. Now, I need you to speak to each House and get them to cooperate. If this is how Trove ends, at least it should be with us fighting together.

entries.name: Deliver Apology Letter To House Carys
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 23/31: Trovian, I apologize for being too late. Our plan did not succeed. If only I was less stubborn, and cooperated with the other houses. If there's any consolation, I wish to make ammends - please, deliver this letter to House Carys. It's a heartfelt apology.

entries.name: Deliver Apology Letter To House Panatea
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 24/31: What's this, Trovian? An apology letter from House Tysorion? I don't know what to say. I have always thought of them as kin, as brethren. I too apologize. Had I not been so boneheaded, we could've found this solution on time. Please extend my apologies, and see this letter off to House Panatea, expressing my deepest apologies.

entries.name: Speak to Patrolsly
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 25/31: An apology from House Carys? This is quite, relieving. We didn't have to keep butting heads. Honestly, the Panatea the Partifier would have glady invited all of the other houses to a great big party... Unlike how we've been doing it. If we make it through this, we solelmny swear to make it the biggest party ever, and EVERYONE will be invited. IF we make it.

entries.name: Fight Shadowy Invaders Across Trove
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 26/31: Looks like everyone is in high spirits, and they'll probably need you to lead the charge. Go, fight the Shadows, wherever you may find them. Seeing you out there will inspire them to fight back. We still have a chance.

entries.name: Speak to a House Tysorion Quartermaster
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 27/31: Trovian! Your bravery to put yourself out there in the frontlines in front of us has inspired all of us. We're reminded of the Dragons' fortitude and the Blessings the Goddess gave us. Please visit us, we may have figured out how to stymie the shadow invasion!

entries.name: Craft Slowburn Fluid
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 28/31: Trovian... this is it! The reason why we failed is because we were never united as one! The Houses were meant to honor the Dragons who, together, sealed the Menace away many years ago. With Panatea, Carys, and Tysorion all working together--and with you're help--we can finally recreate the magical ritual to keep the Menace at bay! ... But you need to defeat his currest manifestation first, sorry! Use a House Sunfest Bench to craft Slowburn Fluid!

entries.name: Defeat the Moontouched Menace
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 29/31: Alright, everything's ready Trovian. One final fight. If you want to reach the Moontouched Menace and perform the ritual, you will need to use the MYSTERIOUS LUNAR PORTAL. It shows up periodically here in the Hub.

entries.name: Use Slowburn Fluid on the Sunfest Pyre
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 30/31: Don't celebrate just yet! He's only weakened. If we want to keep him that way, you'll need to perform that Ritual on the Sunfest Pyre.

entries.name: Meet Patrolsly in the Hub
entries.description: Sunfest 2025 31/31: You did it! You faced the Moontouched Menace and came back in one piece! Now, we can all rest and Sunfest is back on schedule! Meet me in the Hub for your reward! And THANK YOU for saving Sunfest!

entries.name: Event: Elysian Initiation
entries.description: To access the Elysian Initiation Questline, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Trial of Courage: Defeat Enemies
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 3/15:  And with that, you've now comitted to our Trials! Now let’s see if you are cut out for Knighthood. You need to steel yourself as the Trial of Courage will have defeat the enemies across the land – once completed, the next trial will proceed.

Defeat Enemies all across Trove.

entries.name: Trial of Honor: Speak with Lunar Knight Qubesly
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 4/15: Well done! You've definitely shown your courage out there! You still have some ways to go, but You're on your way up!

Lunar Knight Qubesly will give you your next task! Speak with him in the Hub!

entries.name: Trial of Honor: Complete a Delve
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 5/15: Trovian! Since they first appeared, the Delves have served as a Trial of Honor for the Knights of Elysia. I don't need to tell you how dangerous they can be! Go complete a delve, and see let your Honor shine through!

Complete a DELVE, using a placed MATCHMAKER, or the green PUBLIC DELVE QUEUE portal in the Delve building in the Hub.

entries.name: Trial of Honor: Return to the Hub and meet Sir Windster
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 6/15: You were great out there! Pretty honorable, if I say so myself. That being said, you’ll have to impress the others as well. Speak with SIR WINDSTER in the HUB for your next Trial!

entries.name: Trial of Loyalty: Look for High Priest Lunavic in Fae Wilds
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 7/15: Trovian! Sorry to interupt your Trials, but High Priest Lunavic has gone missing! He said he was going to the Fae Wilds for a short errand. Please Look for him!

entries.name: Trial of Loyalty: Earn Lunavic's Gratitude
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 8/15: Thanks for coming. It appears that I have injured my leg and I can’t move. I can defend myself from enemies here, but I’ll have a hard time getting home. If you could somehow find me something that can fix my leg, like a Curing Kit perhaps. I'll be eternally grateful.

Return with a Curing Kit from Crystallogy Workbench and Craft Lunavic's Gratitude.

entries.name: Trial of Loyalty: Return to Tauri in the Hub
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 9/15: Thank you, Trovian! I was right about you, and this perfectly demonstrates your loyalty! Please, return to Tauri and let her know that I am safe, and that you've passed the Trial of Loyalty! In fact, now that I'm healing up... maybe I'll beat you there!

entries.name: Trial of Wisdom: Solve the Hub Riddle
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 10/15: Thank you for finding Lunavic, Trovian! Your next Trial is a little different. Here's a note from your next target:

Ah! You're finally here! Strong, Courageous, Loyal. Traits befitting a Knight of our Order. But are your wits in check? For your Trial of Wisdom, you must find my Steward somewhere in the hub. The only clue is this riddle.

Where heat breathes below and shadows dwell
Take the northern path, but do not yell.
Beneath the stone where the fire sighs
Find the one you seek, near he who lies.

entries.name: Trial of Wisdom: Speak with Lady Harasol
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 11/15: I had a feeling you'd pull through. You have that look about you that says that you're some kind of a genius. Well, to me, you're already the whole package so I better send you off to your next challenge. See me in the HUB near our friend Lunavic, now safe thanks to you!

entries.name: Trial of Endurance: Clear 3-Star Dungeons
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 12/15: You are smart as you are strong, but we need to know you can tough out the hard times with us. In my Trial of Endurance, you have to dig deep and go out there to clear 3-Star Dungeons. You can do it. Anyone who has made it this far, usually makes it till the end. Best of luck.

entries.name: Trial of Endurance: Return to Tauri
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 13/15: I had no doubt that you could do it. You have an air about you that says, GRIT and GRIND. I respect that, and for that, you earn your place in the Order. Go make it official and speak with Tauri. She will tell you what to do next.

entries.name: Trial of Discipline: Complete Elysian Dailies
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 14/15: And finally, to put it all together - you have to show that you've learned all the core tenets of the our Order. Clear Elysian Dailies from our Knights to make your acceptance official. Good work, and

entries.name: Trial of Discipline: Return to Tauri
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 15/15: Amazing, Trovian! I knew you could do it! Please, return to me to celebrate! ... and for a little reward. Congratulations, Trovian! Congratulations, Knight of Elysia!

entries.name: Event: Healthy Food vs Junk Food
entries.description: To access the Healthy Food vs Junk Food Questline, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Meet with Qubesly in the Hub
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 1/11: Trovian, we’ve got a real food feud brewing! Delegates from the Medieval Highlands and Candoria have both rolled into the Hub, and I can’t tell if they're here for a dinner or desert. Care to help me sort this out?

entries.name: Meet the Highlands and Candoria delegates
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 2/11: As you’ve probably noticed, the Highlands envoy is all about their healthy food, while the Candorians rep their Junk food. I hear they don't like each other, so why don't you step in before they start bickering.

entries.name: Speak with Berry Bones
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 3/11: Grapes, huh? You know, I heard that creepy, boney cat in the Hub talking about grapes. Maybe he knows something? Talk with him!

entries.name: Buy Grapes from the Skeleton Clan
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 4/11:  According to our boney friend, the Highlands and Candoria factions are fighting over if Grapes are healthy or junk food. You have to show them which side you're on. Find the Skeleton Grapeherds in CANDORIA and HIGHLANDS and give them SOUL FOOD, to exchange with GRAPES they harvested.

entries.name: CHOOSE a delegate to give GRAPES to
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 5/11: Now that you've got some grapes, you'll have to pick a delegate in the HUB whose favor you'd like. Our boney friend say that you can only donate to ONE delegate per day, so choose wisely!

entries.name: Equip a HEALTHY FOOD or a JUNK FOOD banner
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 6/11: Wear your Banner with pride to signal your loyalty. This will let you to speak with Denizens of your chosen faction all across Trove!

entries.name: Complete a Delegate Assistant's Task
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 7/11: With that banner equipped, you should be able to accept and complete a task benefitting the Delegate by-way-of their assistant.

adventures.name: Deliver food to MEDIEVAL HIGHLANDS denizens

entries.name: Speak with Skeleton Cat
entries.description: HEALTHY  FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 8/11: Did they just give you a BALLOT? Return to the Skeleton Cat in the EVENTS AREA in the HUB, for more information.

entries.name: Interact with a BALLOT BOX
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 9/11: Apparently, the denizens have launched a final campaign to classify grapes. Denizens who say Healthy will vote in the HIGHLANDS ballot box, and those who say Junk Food vote in the CANDORIA BOX. Might as well ROCK THE VOTE at one of the Ballot Boxes here in the HUB.

entries.name: Vote at one of the HUB BALLOT BOXES
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 10/11: Well... I guess we just... collect more 'ballots'? By delivering food to citizens?...Sounds more like a Survey than a debate. A pretty biased one too!

entries.name: Return to QUBESLY
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 11/11: Great work, Trovian! The Delegates are both pleased with the vote turnout. They don't care about anything except rocking THEIR vote ...and eating their favorite food. Return to me for your reward, my way of saying thanks for the good will you've generated!

entries.name: Event: Shadows Eve
entries.description: To access the Shadows Eve Questline you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Talk to Wolfsly in the EVENTS AREA in the HUB
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 1/15: Awooooo to you, Trovian! Shadow's Eve is here again! Come see me in the EVENTS AREA in the HUB to see what's happening this year.

entries.name: Meet the Lost Soul in the EVENTS area
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 2/15: This year, the veil between this world and the other side are crossing into each other and it's spooking me out! Souls have been seen everywhere in Trove! In fact, one is here right now! Talk to it and see if you can help in any way.

entries.name: Collect LOST PAGES to craft GHOSTLY APPROVAL
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2025 3/15: Hello Trovian. Sorry for bothering you. I seem to be unable pass over to the other side. What binds me to this place are the pages of my book which cost a fortune and they've been scattered everywhere!

The pages can be found in Dungeon Chests all across Trove Adventure Worlds. Once you gather them, return to me and I'll give you my GHOSTLY APPROVAL for reuniting me with my favorite book!

entries.name: Talk to Fiona Catastra
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 4/15: Greetings Trovian. I saw you gain that Lost Soul's approval. For that, you have gained my attention. Come closer. I have something to ask of you.

entries.name: Find a Lost Soul to help in the CURSED VALE
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2025 5/15: There has been an influx of Lost Souls that refuse to pass over to the other side. As the one who manages their passage, this is very frustrating to me. Could you be a dear and help those Lost Souls out?

Some of the Lost Souls are attracted to cursed places, so it makes sense to check the CURSED VALE for traces of Souls.

entries.name: Collect 40 HUNTER'S MEMORIES to help LOST HUNTER's SOUL
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2025 6/15: Why hello Trovian. It looks like I'm a ghost. I'm not sure who I was or what I did in my past life, but I know that I really don't like CURSED VALE WOLVES. Can you defeat some for me and help me jog my memory? 

The LOST SOUL lost its memories and needs them back. Defeat Wolves and Werewolf enemies and help the soul recover its Lost Memories.

entries.name: Return to Fiona Catastra in the HUB
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 7/15: The Lost Soul recovered his memories and now is on its way to fulfillment. That soul did NOT like wolves at all, after what they did to him. But I shan't say what happened. Regardless, return to me and I'll lead you to your next soul.

entries.name: Help the LOST SOUL Escape Castle Catastra
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2025 08/15: With all these Lost Souls everywhere, some have found themselves in my domain. I need your help getting them out of there. They won't come out until it's safe, so it's important that you clear the Delve. I gave you a Depth Stepper so you can get in.

Despite being given one, Depth Steppers can also be crafted at the Delve Workbench or purchased at Gateway Gladys. The Furrious Fiona Depth stepper can also be used to access Castle Catastra.

entries.name: Return to Fiona Catastra
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 09/15: Thank goodness. Now, I have peace of mind for the mean time. Return to me for your reward, and the next soul you need to help me with.

entries.name: Find a Lost Soul in the FORBIDDEN SPIRES
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 10/15: As the herald of souls, I have an awareness of every soul in the mortal plane. I hear a weary soul humming a sorrowful tune. It's very bad, Trovian. This Soul cannot sing. Please, it needs to pass over to the other side. This soul's life signature is in the FORBIDDEN SPIRES. Please help.

entries.name: Collect 25 Instrument Fragments to help Lost Soul
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2025 11/15: Oh pardon! I didn't know anyone was listening. I'm just a wandering soul looking for my favorite instrument. I was a musician you see. I was trying to calm down some PUMPKIN CREATURES with my music...Then, I forgot what happened next. My instrument must be wherever those creatures are.

Defeat PUMPKIN BOSSES in PUMPKIN DUNGEONS to collect Instrument Fragments and return to the Lost Soul in the FORBIDDEN SPIRES to craft Ghostly Approval.

entries.name: Return to Fiona Catastra in the HUB
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 12/15: Purrrfect! Meet me in the HUB, and I have one final task for you.

entries.name: Talk to Wolfsly in the HUB
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 13/15: You might have noticed souls around Trove that attack you. They might be bad, but they're still Lost Souls too. I've left Wolfsly the power to restore them to their pure state. Please approach him.

entries.name: Bring 30 BAD SOUL ESSENCE to Wolfsly and Craft a GHOSTLY APPROVAL
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 14/15: Awoooo! Trovian, just who I wanted to see! Those rowdy souls causing a ruckus needs an old fashion shining courtesy of my wolfly tongue. Go defeat Bad Souls running around Adventure Worlds and come back with their essence. I'll lick them clean and poof! Good souls again!

entries.name: Return to Fiona Catastra in the HUB
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2025 15/15: That should teach those nasty souls. You did it! Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Trovian. Now, there are still so much work to be done, and so much more Lost Souls to help out there. So please continue to work hard and help them all. For now, come up one last time, and receive MY Approval.

entries.name: Event: Turkeytopia
entries.description: To access the Turkeytopia Questline you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Meet with Chefsly
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 1/15: Hello Trovian! Friendsgiving is here, our friends are coming soon and while we prepared the ingredients in the HUB, we still have to cook before everyone's arrival! Thankfully, they sent in letters to help us accommodate for them in advance.

Come to the Event's area of the Hub and speak with me so we can make sure this Friendsgiving goes without a hitch.

entries.name: Craft Trovian Bouillon
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 2/15: The first and most important ingredient when cooking for Friendsgiving is Trovian Bouillon. I sent the recipe to your claims. You can buy the materials from my sous-chef or, if you're so inclined, at the MARKETPLACE [HK:Marketplace]!

Use the Friendsgiving Oven to make Trovian Bouillon, then you can read the first letter from our guests.

entries.name: Clear Dungeons in the Lost Isles for the Three Houses
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 3/15: Dear Trovian, we're coming in from faraway seas. We don't want our ship looted by pirates on the way. Please clear the path for us, if you don't mind. 

Clear Dungeons in the Treasure Isles or the Lost Isles biomes.

entries.name: Cook THREE HOUSE TURKEY for the 3 House Representatives
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 4/15: Good job Trovian! Now get back here, the Houses would want their Three House Turkey cooked perfectly. I've sent you the recipe, so get cooking! After that, you can move on to the next guest's letter.

Cook THREE HOUSE TURKEY for the Representatives of Carys, Tysorion and Panatea.

entries.name: Clear Dungeons in the Medieval Highlands and Candoria for their delegates
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 5/15: Greetings Trovian. The Candorian and Highlands factions have agreed to come together in peace to share a meal after you settled our debate. However, some of our own faction members might disagree. Please, don't let them get in the way of this joyous occasion. 

Clear Dungeons in the Medieval Highlands and Candoria.

entries.name: Cook BURGER AND BROCCOLI for the Delegates
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 6/15: Excellent work Trovian! Now, let's get their dish cooked pronto. Junk food, healthy food, doesn't matter. You can have them both at once! Once again I've sent you the recipe. Once done, please go ahead and read the next letter.

Cook BURGERS AND BROCCOLI for the Highlands and Candoria delegates. As always, my sous-chef is selling materials, as well as the MARKETPLACE.

entries.name: Clear 3-Star Dungeons for Garx
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 7/15: Trovian! I hope you're in high spirits. I know you're the one preparing food for us but I'll only eat food from someone I know who is tough enough, otherwise you wont be able to squeeze the flavor out of the ingredients. Please work out a sweat before cooking my meal. It'll help it be... edible.

Clear 3-Star Dungeons.

entries.name: Cook MIGHTY LASAGNA for Garx
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 8/15: You look like you've gained some muscle! That'll make Garx's food really really flavorful this year. Now get cooking, there's not much time till he's here. Then you can read the next guest's letter.

Cook MIGHTY LASAGNA for Garx.

entries.name: Clear Dungeons in the Cursed Vale for the Fiona Catastra
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 9/15: Dearest Trovian, I'm honored that you invited me to Friendsgiving. The Lost Souls issue is past us, so I'm able to attend. Although, one of the Not-So-Lost Souls is tagging along this year. He's still scared of the Cursed Vale. Please help clear out the bad guys before we arrive.

Clear Cursed Vale Dungeons.

entries.name: Cook UNDERWORLDLY DISH for Fiona Catastra
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 10/15: Thanks for paving the way for Madame Catastra's arrival. Now we just have to cook her favorite meal. I've prepared the recipe for you, so all you have to do is get cooking. This is the last one, I swear. Our guests are almost here! 

Cook UNDERWORLDLY DISH for Fiona Catastra.

entries.name: Grab a bite of the food
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 11/15: You've saved Friendsgiving, Trovian! I can't thank you enough. Go grab a bite from something before our guests arrive. You've earned it.

Press [HK:Loot] to grab a bit of food while looking at one of the main dishes at the table.

entries.name: Craft a Turkeytopia Gateway
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 12/15: Our guests have arrived, and they seem pleased! You really saved Friendsgiving. Well, my Friendsgiving anyway.

There seems to be activity going on in Turkeytopia Delve, so if you wouldn't mind crafting a Delve Gateway: Turkeytopia at the Turkeytopia Table and checking out what's going on there, that would be great.

entries.name: Complete a Turkeytopia Delve
entries.description: Friendsgiving 2025 13/15: Now with that you can place it, head into the Turkeytopia Delve, and complete it. Please make sure everything's alright down there for me.

entries.name: Return to Chefsly
entries.description: Friendsgiving 2025 14/15: Ah, you resolved the disturbance, thank you! If everything is safe and sound, head on back here and have some fun with us! We even have a gift for you!

entries.name: Complete Friendsgiving Dailies
entries.description:
Friendsgiving 2025 15/15: We had a few more guests come late, the Qubeslys. Seems like they want your help, so go check out what they need. I don't have any other tasks left for you, so once you're done I hope you have a great Friendsgiving!

The Qubeslys, at the Qubesly table by the Crafting Corner, have some requests for you. Complete some of their daily requests.

entries.name: Event: Snowfest
entries.description: To access the Snowfest Questline you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Speak with Elfsly in the Hub
entries.description: Snowvasion 1/13: Trovian! I've got terrible, chilling news! Snowmen have come in full force with their INVASION! Come speak with me in the hub as soon as you can, please! We have to put a stop to this!

entries.name: Speak with Frostay the Snowman
entries.description: Snowvasion 2/13: Our friend and ally, Frostay the Snowman, is also here to help! He and I have come up with a plan to end this invasion.

entries.name: Collect Snowvader Remnants
entries.description: Snowvasion 3/13: Ice to meet you, Trovian! We're not sure what went wrong with these invading Snowmen, but we think we have a way to fix it! To implement this plan, the first thing we need are some SNOWVADER REMNANTS. Although Snowvaders can technically show up across all of Trove, they are naturally most concentrated in PERMAFROST--they much prefer the cold, you see. Head there and collect a SNOWVADER REMNANT!

entries.name: Speak with Elfsly in the Hub
entries.description: Snowvasion 4/13: If we repurpose those Remnants you've gathered, we can reconstitute classic, kind-hearted Snowmen. If we get enough Classic Snowmen in Permafrost, that should stop the invasion! Elfsly has agreed to help us with the next step, go speak with him!

entries.name: Bleach Snowvader Remnants
entries.description: Snowvasion 5/13: To make Classic Snowmen, we need Classic Snowman Gear. Frostay can dye those Remnants the necessary blue, but we need to BLEACH them first! That's where I come in!

entries.name: Speak with Frostay the Snowman
entries.description: Snowvasion 6/13: Now go see Frostay to see what it takes to DYE the Remnants!

entries.name: Craft Classic Snowman Gear
entries.description: Snowvasion 7/13: Using DYE is simple, but I need the materials to make some! Once you've got the materials, bring them to me and DYE some BLEACHED SNOWVADER REMNANTS to create CLASSIC SNOWMAN GEAR!

entries.name: Collect Pristine Snow
entries.description: Snowvasion 8/13: Once you've collected all the materials, I can help you craft a CLASSIC SNOWMAN. The rarest material of all, however, is PRISTINE SNOW. But I know where you can find some! The TREE DUNGEONS which appear throughoug Trove during Snowfest are where you need to go!

entries.name: Craft Classic Snowmen
entries.description:
Snowvasion 9/13: Now return to me and craft a CLASSIC SNOWMAN!

Return to Fostay the Snowman in the Hub and use Pristine Snow to craft Classic Snowmen.

entries.name: Use Classic Snowmen in Permafrost
entries.description: Snowvasion 10/13: Now it should be a simple step: just head to PERMAFROST and release that Classic Snowman! That'll begin to tip the scales in our favor!

entries.name: Return 20 Classic Snowmen to Permafrost
entries.description:
Snowvasion 11/13: Easy, right?! But repelling the invasion will require fortitude and persistence! You'll need to do this a few more times if you want to really have an impact on the invasion, but don't fret! You can free them en masse at the FROSTY WORKENCH in the Frozen Tundra!

Return Classic Snowmen to Permafrost by throwing them or using the Frosty Workbench

entries.name: Speak with Elfsly in the Hub
entries.description: Snowvasion 12/13: Nice work, Trovian! You're really making an impact! Come back to the hub for a well-deserved reward!

entries.name: Complete Dailies
entries.description: Snowvasion 13/13: The invasion has been slowed, but not completely stopped! Approach the visitors from other biomes and see if they need keeping their Snowvader problems in check.

entries.name: Visit Qubesly in the Hub
entries.description: Renewus 1/9: Trovian! It's a new year! You know what that means, right? Renewus! As the name suggests, this is meant to be a time of renewal... for all of us! Meet me in the HUB [HK:Homeworld] to get started!

entries.name: THROW a Confetti Ball!
entries.description: Renewus 2/9: First and foremost, Renewus is about REVELRY! Craft some CONFETTI BALLS and toss a few!

entries.name: CRAFT a Cocoon Handler's Banner
entries.description: Renewus 3/9: Alright, alright. That's enough revelry for now. Let's get down to business. The Renewus Butterflies are back! We used to think they were extinct, but we're happy to be wrong! We're making efforts to further help their recovery and YOU can help! You just need to craft a COCOON HANDLER'S BANNER!

entries.name: EQUIP a Cocoon Handler's Banner
