entries.description: Renewus 4/9: Equipping the banner should imbue you with the Arcane wherewithal to successfully collect some of the precious Renewus Butterflies! Without it? You probably won't manage to catch them...

entries.name: HARVEST Renewus Butterflies
entries.description: Renewus 5/9: Now keep that banner equipped while you head out to Adventure Worlds across Trove to find some Renewus Butterflies!

entries.name: DONATE Renewus Butterflies
entries.description: Renewus 6/9: That's it! Now help us preserve their future by donating them to me! For science!

entries.name: Complete one of GARX'S WARM UP Exercises
entries.description:
Renewus 7/9: Pretty simple! Just keep doing that. These Butterflies have a great ally in you, Trovian!

Oh! Have you spoken to Garx yet? He's also excited about this time of year, though I'm not sure how much it has to do with butterflies...

entries.name: HIT the Renewus Ball in the HUB
entries.description: Renewus 8/9: Feeling the burn! I like Garx, but he has more energy than me. I hope he warmed you up, because I have one last Renewus tradition for you to partake in... Smacking the Renewus Ball! The Renewus Ball will drop--here in the Hub--every couple of minutes. Wait around then smack it a few times when it shows up!

entries.name: Return to Qubesly
entries.description: Renewus 9/9: Fun, no? That's Renewus, Trovian! Please keep help our efforts preserving the wonderful Renewus Butterfly, and enjoy the coming year!

entries.name: Event: Heckbugs in Love
entries.description: To access the Heckbugs in Love Questline, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Meet H.E.C.K. Helper Hailey
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 1/12: Trovian! It is I, Hailey from H.E.C.K., here visiting Trove for another year to spread goodwill! What is H.E.C.K.? Why, we're Helpers Of Exotic Creatures...for Karma, of course! Come meet me in the hub!

entries.name: Help Heckbugs in Geode Caves
entries.description:
What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 2/12: As you may have noticed, Heckbugs have taken to Trove & Geode for their yearly spawning migration. While they can be vicious & deadly, they can also be cute & cuddly! Since this species is categorized as Exotic, our organization has tasked itself with ensuring their protection! And you can help!

Head into one of the Geode Caverns (Sunken Sunvault, Verdant Veins, or Moonglow Grotto), and use CRITTER TREATS, COMFORT BLANKETS, and CURING KITS to Feed, Warm, and Heal-up the poor lil' Heckbugs! You can find shortcuts to the Caverns inside the EVENTS AREA Heckbug building.

entries.name: Meet H.E.C.K. Heartwarmer Harold
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 3/12: HELLO, TROVIAN! I see you've met my counterpart, Hailey. While she helps the young Heckbugs thrive in their new environments, I have a much more exciting job: helping to get those young Heckbugs born in the first place! Come see me in the Hub so we can get started!

entries.name: Purchase Amorous Heckbugs from Heartwarmer Harold
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 4/12: Heckbug mating can be a complex process, but we've nearly perfected it. I've got quite a collection of Amorous Heckbugs, ready to find love! Buy some from me to get ready for the next step.

entries.name: Use an Amorous Heckbug in Dragonfire Peaks
entries.description:
What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 5/12: Now just head to DRAGONFIRE PEAKS and let one of those lil' cuties loose!

A shortcut to the Dragonfire Peaks is located in the EVENTS AREA Heckbug Building.

entries.name: Help Amorous Heckbugs find Love
entries.description:
What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 6/12: Now run around and find another Heckbug for your Heckbug to romance! Heckbugs are notoriously picky, so it may take a few!

Repeat this 10 times, and you'll have some idea of what I do every day this season!

entries.name: Hatch a Heckbug Egg
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 7/12: It's me again, Hailey! Are you ready for the final stage in building this circle of life? It's time to hatch a Heckbug Egg! You can find these eggs all around the Geode Caverns, and hatch them at the EGG INCUBATOR!

entries.name: Meet the Heckbug Hunter
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 8/12: Trovian... the H.E.C.K. isn't all they claim to be...I’m not the only one watching H.E.C.K. — others like me operate in the dark, watching the Heckbug actvity. Meet me behind their structure in the Hub to learn more....

entries.name: Complete the Heckbug Hunter 's Daily Quest
entries.description:
What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 9/12: Hailey and Harold are keeping themselves blind from the truth: Heckbugs are bloodthirsty killers! They'll destroy entire planets, they will! I've seen it happen, and it'll happen again! we put a stop to them RIGHT NOW, and every day! Talk to my operative and get to work.
AND REMEMBER! If you don't have my banner, you'll need Amorous Heckbugs to strip their blasted shielding!

entries.name: Equip the Standard of the Heckbug Hunter
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 10/12: I knew you had that killer instinct. There's one last step, and it requires the Standard of the Heckbug Hunter. Purchase the banner from me and equip it!

entries.name: Defeat Heckbug Invaders
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 11/12: To save Trove from the heckbug hordes, we have to target the Heckbug Invaders. You may have already seen some, dropping from the sky. But they also hide out in dungeons, and with the Banner equipped you can draw them out!

entries.name: Return to the Heckbug Hunter
entries.description: What the H.E.C.K.?! 2026 12/12: Great work, Trovian! Return to me, I've got a reward for ya--something I took from those silly H.E.C.K.-heads who've come with some reinforcements. Ugh.

entries.name: Event: St. Qubeslick
entries.description: To access the St. Qubeslick Questline, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Craft Something at the Pot o' Gold
Send Lucksnakes to the Mini-Pot o' Gold
Event: Bunfest
entries.description: To access the Bunfest Questline, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Greet Qubesly in the Bunfest Pavillion
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 1/15: Trovian! Bunfest is here again and that means our friends have returned! Come greet our Hoppin' friends and me at the pavillion in the hub.

entries.name: Hunt for Eggs
entries.description:
Bunfest 2026 2/15: Each year Bunfest comes and each year we celebrate. My favorite part is hiding eggs all over Trove. I start hopping with joy whenever I think about Trovians finding the little things. Why don't you go out and find a few?

Eggs can be found in the Medieval Highlands, Fae Forests, Candoria, Frobidden Spires, and Geode Topside at Adept Difficulty (1) or higher.

entries.name: Defeat Eggmen
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 3/15: Trovian! There are Eggs all over Candoria, and not the ones that I placed! They're scrambling up all the fun, why don't you go and teach them not to mess with Bunfest.

entries.name: Defeat King Egon
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 4/15: The eggmen have a leader, King Egon. Unfortunately there's a lot of 'King Egons' out there. Find an Egg Dungeon in Candoria and depose this would be ruiner of Bunfest.

entries.name: Defeat Bunfest Delve Bosses
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 5/15: Well done Trovian, but it turns out they're even in the Delves. Well we'll have to deal with that too. Head back to the Hub and craft any of the Depth Steppers, then head in there and defeat a few of these yolksters.

entries.name: Complete an Egghunt
entries.description:
Bunfest 2026 6/15: Did you see the Tyr-egg-asaurus? Well you should be happy you didn't if not. I'm starting to think this may be a longer term problem. It might be best to get back to the festivities of Bunfest.

Now, all this unrest might be a little my fault. You see I kind of, sort of, a little bit, maybe borrowed some teeny, tiny, itty-bitty pieces of King Egon's kingdom for Bunfest. I'm going to give them back, I promise! For now just have some fun and let me deal with the politics.

In the meantime, find one of my Bunfest Egghunts in Candoria and have some fun. The eggs can have Chocolate, Bunfest Tokens, and even a few more little treasures.

entries.name: Complete Bunfest Dalies
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 7/15: Well, I have never been condescended to in such a rude manor. King Egon really needs classes on manners. But never mind, Bunfest continues, and what is Bunfest without the bun-fwens. They're here in the HUB and looking for your help.

entries.name: Make a Donation
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 8/15: Good work! I'm sure you made a lot of bun-fwends! And now to spread the love of Bunfest all over! Head over to the Events Area of the Hub and make a donation at the Bunfest Station to make it known!

entries.name: Open your Leaderboards
entries.description:
Bunfest 2026 9/15: I almost forgot, there's a Leaderboard this year! Each time you defeat an Egg Dungeon, complete a Daily quest, complete a Delve, or each egg you open in an Egghunt will earn you Score on the Bunfest Leaderboad. You can track your progress under the Daily Contests tab of the Leaderboards UI.

Open the Leaderboard with [HK:Leaderboards].

entries.name: Talk with Lepora
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 10/15: Trovian, looks like the curious Lepora is back to hang out! And this time, she brought a friend. Why don't you ask her what brings her here?

entries.name: Talk to Unga Bun-ga
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 11/15: Hey Trovian! I'm back, and this time I came from the past and I brought a visitor with me and we kinda need your help! Please talk to Bun Bun across the room of this Beautiful Bunfest Pavilion.

entries.name: Defeat Lagorian Troglodytes
entries.description:
Bunfest 2026 12/15: Me Unga Bun-ga from past. Traveling to future make other Lagorian Troglodytes like me exist. Go crush them. Don't worry. They not die. They go back to past. They hide in JURASSIC JUNGLE.

Defeat Cave Bunnies in JURASSIC JUNGLE to send them back to the past.

entries.name: Return to Lepora
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 13/15: Trovian! Great work. Now those temporal distortion bunnies can go back to their time. Return to me for my final request.

entries.name: Crack Eggs from JURASSIC JUNGLE
entries.description: Bunfest 2026 14/15: The temporal cave bunnies have left behind some of their stolen Eggs, and now are all over the place in the JURASSIC JUNGLE. Why don't you head over there and crack them open, collect the delicious chocolate inside, and bring it back to me. I'll trade you for a neat invention from the past for them if you so choose!

entries.name: Return to Qubesly
entries.description:
Bunfest 2026 15/15: First it was a future bunny, then a past bunny! That was quite...heavy.

Anyway, thanks again for all your effort this year, Trovian! Come see me for a reward!

entries.name: Event: Spring Fling
entries.description: To access the Spring Fling, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Talk to Sir Dapper Duckington Esquire
Defeat Waspiders in Medieval Highlands, Permafrost, or Neon City
Collect an Item from a Beehive
Defeat the Waspider Alpha In Fae Wilds and Neon City
Fling Migration Capsules in PEACEFUL HILLS
Return to Sir Dapper Duckington for Your Reward
Event: Splendid Summer
entries.description: To access the Splendid Summer, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Visit GMQubesly in the Hub.
entries.description: Splendid Summer 1/9:  Hello Trovian! The celebration of being a prideful Trovian is here once more! Come find me in the HUB and check out my wares!

entries.name: Spend some Valor Coins
entries.description: Splendid Summer 2/9: Use your Valor Coins to purchase a reward.

entries.name: Defend your fellow Trovians!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 3/9: Your next quest requires your might, defeat 3 Star Dungeons and gather more Valor Coins for more rewards from my shop!

entries.name: Return to GMQubesly in the hub!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 4/9: Trovian! As the Grand Marshal, it is my responsibility that everyone is allowed to express themselves freely. There have been reports of emotionless Trovians in Adventure worlds. Please see me in the HUB, and I will show you where they are.

entries.name: Dance for the Unfeeling Trovians in Candoria!
entries.description:
Splendid Summer 5/9: We all need joy and laughter in our lives. Sometimes, when all is lost, a little dance with a friend may be all you need. Find those Unfeeling Trovians who are trying to reignite their childhood by hanging out in CANDORIA and show them your moves! Make them glow green with joy!

Type /dance near an Unfeeling Trovian to restore their joy!

entries.name: Find the Unfeeling Trovians in the Cursed Vale!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 6/9: Restoring their hearts is no easy task. Some lack fire but others lack the feeling of sadness. Remind them by sharing with them a book filled with deeply sad and blue emotions (purchased from me of course!) and give them their feelings back!! They are found in the CURSED VALE trying to absorb negative emotion, but unfortunately they feel nothing.

entries.name: Defeat the ANGRY INCARNATION in Dragonfire Peaks!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 7/9: This one is a little different, Trovian! The angry feelings of the land manifested into something tangible, and are hanging around DRAGONFIRE PEAKS. Please, defeat this concentrated anger so the souls of the land can feel joy again!

entries.name: Return to GMQubesly in the HUB!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 8/9: Splendid, Trovian! Thank you for showing us that our expressions bring color to the world! You truly are the embodiment of the splendor of summer. Now return to me and receive your just rewards!

entries.name: Show off your new gear and JUMP!
entries.description: Splendid Summer 9/9: One last thing Trovian! Since you have been our example of Valor for this month, let us see you JUMP as high as you can so that everyone can see that you are a shining light that supports everyone with your courage!

entries.name: Event: Sunfest
entries.description: To access the Sunfest Questline, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Meet Patrolsly in the Hub
entries.description:
Sunfest 2026 1/9: Good tidings, Trovian! Sunfest is back, and this year the Three Dragon Houses are uniting to rebuild the RADIANT STANDARDS that keep the Shadows at bay. Meet me in the Event area in the HUB, and I'll point you to the first House that needs you.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

entries.name: Talk to the House Panatea Quartermaster
entries.description:
Sunfest 2026 2/9: Hey, Trovian! I'm sure you've been filled in. Yes, this is a year of peace for the Three Houses. We intend to rebuild the pillars that protect us from the Shadows, but we need your help! Repairing the Radiant Standards requires synthesized materials, and we don't have the reagents on hand to make them.

Please, talk to me inside House Panatea for more information.

entries.name: Complete a Daily Quest for House Panatea
entries.description: Sunfest 2026 3/9: To repair the pillars and seal away the darkness, House Panatea needs you to clear out the Cake Dungeons so we can access the Fluxyattium we need. Talk to our Representative outside to take on a Daily Adventure to get started.

entries.name: Talk to the House Carys Quartermaster
entries.description:
Sunfest 2026 4/9: Salutations, Trovian! Good work out there taking care of business for House Panatea. That's one piece of the puzzle done! Now House Carys also needs a favor from you.

Return to the HUB and meet me in House Carys' Quarters.

entries.name: Complete a Daily Quest for House Carys
entries.description: Sunfest 2026 5/9: Repairing the pillars requires dark energy refined into light. As THE House of Light, refining is our specialty! Gathering dark energy? Not so much. That's where you come in. Speak to our representative outside House Carys to learn how you can help!

adventures.name: Bring Somber Souls to the House Carys Sunfest Bench

entries.name: Talk to the House Tysorion Quartermaster
entries.description:
Sunfest 2026 6/9: Greetings, Trovian, House Tysorion is pleased to have you! We need your help with the final piece to repair the Radiant Standards: Flux mk. II!

Please, speak to our representative just outside House Tysorion.

entries.name: Complete a Daily Quest for House Tysorion
entries.description: Sunfest 2026 7/9: House Tysorion needs you to hunt down the Pinata Invaders which carry the valuable Flux mk. II. Take on our Daily Adventure to get started! Our quest-giver is just outside!

entries.name: Repair Radiant Standards in the RADIANT RUINS
entries.description: Sunfest 2026 8/9:  Good work, Trovian. You've put together your first set of materials. Now head to the RADIANT RUINS and start repairing the RADIANT STANDARDS. Every one you restore pushes the darkness back a little further

entries.name: Return to Patrolsly in the HUB
entries.description:
Sunfest 2026 9/9: You were amazing out there, Trovian. Your actions today mark the start of a new era of peace for our land. With the Three Houses united and our defenses restored against the Shadows, the future looks brighter than it has in years...

Now come see me in the HUB so I can reward you for your efforts.

entries.name: Event: Elysian Initiation
entries.description: To access the Elysian Initiation Questline, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Meet Tauri in the Hub
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 1/14: Trovian! The Knights of Elysia are gathering to induct a new member into our order, and your name keeps coming up. If you're interested in joining our ranks, meet me at the EVENTS area in the HUB!

entries.name: Craft an Elysian Emblem
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 2/14: I've heard tales of your exploits everywhere I go! My fellow knights and I agree — you are ready to walk our path. We are the Knights of Elysia, and our order is built in the space between the core Pillars of Elysia: Fury, Body, Balance, and Mind. Each will be tested in turn. Master all four, then prove you can wield them as one.

First, prove your commitment. Gather 50 Sol Sigils and craft an Elysian Emblem at TAURI in the HUB.

entries.name: Pillar of Fury: Defeat Enemies
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 3/14: And with that, you've committed to the Path! Fury is simple: Fury is needed for it is the spark that drives our courage! Yet like steel, fury must be tempered. Show us your fury and your mastery of it and the next trial will proceed.

Defeat Enemies all across Trove.

entries.name: Speak to Lunar Knight Qubesly
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 4/14: Well done, your Fury burns true! You still have some ways to go, but you're on the path.

Lunar Knight Qubesly will guide your next steps. Speak with him in the Hub!

entries.name: Pillar of Body: Complete a Delve
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 5/14: Trovian! Where Fury is the strike, Body is the will to keep striking. The Delves have served as our test of Body since they first appeared and I don't need to tell you how grueling they can be! Go complete a Delve, and let your endurance speak for itself.

Complete a DELVE, using a placed MATCHMAKER, or the green PUBLIC DELVE QUEUE portal in the Delve building in the Hub.

entries.name: Speak to Sir Windster
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 6/14: You were great out there. Your Body held firm under the worst of it. That said, you'll have to impress the others as well. 

Speak with SIR WINDSTER in the HUB for your next Trial!

entries.name: Pillar of Balance: Find High Priest Lunavic in Fae Wilds
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 7/14: Trovian! Sorry to interrupt, but High Priest Lunavic has gone missing! He said he was going to the Fae Wilds for a short errand. Elysia's third Pillar is Balance: knowing when your own pursuits must give way to a comrade's call. Please look for him!

entries.name: Pillar of Balance: Earn Lunavic's Gratitude
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 8/14: Thanks for coming. It appears that I have injured my leg and I can't move. I can defend myself from enemies here, but I'll have a hard time getting home. The strongest blade is the one that knows when to not fight. That is Balance. If you could find me something that can fix my leg, like a CURING KIT perhaps, I'll be eternally grateful.

Return with a Curing Kit from Crystallogy Workbench and Craft Lunavic's Gratitude.

entries.name: Return to Tauri
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 9/14: Thank you, Trovian! I was right about you! You walk in Balance with ease. Please, return to Tauri and let her know that I am safe, and that you've passed the third trial! In fact, now that I'm healing up... maybe I'll beat you there!

entries.name: Pillar of Mind: Solve the Hub Riddle
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 10/14: Thank you for finding Lunavic, Trovian! Your next trial is a little different. Here's a note from your next target:

Ah! You're finally here! Fierce, resilient, balanced. Traits befitting a Knight of our Order. But the fourth Pillar is Mind — even the sharpest blade is dull without the eye to aim it, and steel will not see you through what comes next. Find my Steward somewhere in the Hub. The only clue is this riddle.

Upon this HUB, a Goddess stands,
Her wings outstretched, welcoming hands,
Tucked in her feathers, hidden from view,
You'll find my one-man skeleton crew.

entries.name: Pillar of Mind: Speak with Lady Harasol
entries.description:
Elysian Initiation 11/14: I had a feeling you'd pull through. You have that look about you that says you're some kind of a genius. Well, to me, you're already the whole package. I'd better send you on to your final challenge. 

See me in the HUB near our friend Lunavic, now safe thanks to you!

entries.name: Trial of Mastery: Clear 3-Star Dungeons
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 12/14: Fury, Body, Balance, and Mind. You've shown each one on its own. But a true Knight wields all four as one. The Trial of Mastery asks you to bring every Pillar to bear at once. Dig deep and clear 3-Star Dungeons. Few walk this path, and even fewer see it through to the end. Be among them.

entries.name: Trial of Mastery: Complete Elysian Dailies
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 13/14: I had no doubt that you could do it. You move with the focus of someone who has all four Pillars at their fingertips. But mastery isn't proven in a single moment, it's carried day after day. Complete Elysian Dailies from our Knights to walk the path as we do.

entries.name: Return to Tauri
entries.description: Elysian Initiation 14/14: Amazing, Trovian! I knew you could do it! Please, return to me to celebrate! ... and for a little reward. Congratulations, Trovian! Congratulations, Knight of Elysia!

entries.name: Event: Healthy Food vs Junk Food
entries.description: To access the Healthy Food vs Junk Food Questline, you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Meet with Qubesly in the Hub
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 1/13: Trovian, we've got another great plate debate cooking and this year it's all about GRAPES! Delegates from the Medieval Highlands and Candoria are back in the Hub, each claiming the humble grape belongs on THEIR menu. Care to help me sort this out?

entries.name: Meet the Highlands and Candoria delegates
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 2/13: As you've probably noticed, the Highlands delegate insists grapes are nature's perfect HEALTHY snack, while the Candorian swears they're best candied and enjoyed as JUNK FOOD. I hear they don't like each other, so why don't you step in before the grape debate turns sour.

entries.name: Speak with Berry Bones
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 3/13: The boney cat Berry Bones is back again, playing both sides by peddling her hand-grown PURP'LILS to anyone with an appetite. Talk to her in the EVENTS area in the Hub and see what the little scamp is up to.

entries.name: DONATE a Purp'lil to a delegate to choose your faction.
entries.description:
HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 4/13: According to the cat, the delegates are arguing about GRAPES. One side says grapes are HEALTHY, the other says they're JUNK FOOD, and the factions are going to need your help to tip the scales to their side! To declare your loyalty, a PURP'LIL is needed. Donate yours to the side you support to earn their favor.

Harvest Purp'lils by GARDENING or buy them from BERRY BONES in the Hub, then donate to the faction of your choice. You can only support one faction per day.

entries.name: Equip a LOYALTY FLAG banner from HIGHLANDS or CANDORIA
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 5/13: Now that you've pledged your support, your delegate will allow you to craft their faction's Banner. Craft it and equip it to show your loyalty and unlock your faction's recipes at the Delegate!

entries.name: Complete a Delegate Assistant's Task
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 6/13: With that banner equipped, you should be able to accept and complete a task benefitting the Delegate by-way-of their assistant.

adventures.name: Collect ROCK CANDY in the Confectious Caverns

entries.name: Craft a Special Grape Snack
entries.description:
HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 7/13: The delegates want to win over the other faction's citizens to settle this debate.

Prepare your faction's SPECIAL GRAPE SNACK from the ingredients you've collected at your chosen delegate in the Hub.

entries.name: Convert Rival Faction Citizens by throwing a SPECIAL GRAPE SNACK
entries.description:
HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 8/13: With a Special Grape Snack in hand and your faction BANNER equipped, go win over the rival's citizens out in their home turf! If you fly for Grapes as Healthy Food, then go to Candoria. If you want Grapes acknowledged as Junk Food, then spread the word in Medieval Highlands! Every citizen holds Multiple Pledges and the more they like your snack, the more they hand over.

You can prepare additional Special Grape Snacks at your chosen faction's delegate.

entries.name: Talk to Berry Bones in the Hub
entries.description:
HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 9/13: Some citizens just aren't easily impressed. They'll take your snack and hand over a single measly pledge. Berry Bones claims she has just the thing.

Head to the EVENTS area in the Hub and hear her out.

entries.name: Make the SECRET GRAPE SPICE
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 10/13: Berry Bones let you in on her recipe, a SECRET GRAPE SPICE so potent that no citizen can resist it. Gather what you need and cook up a batch of your own.

entries.name: Gather more PLEDGES from Indecisive Citizens
entries.description:
HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 11/13: With this SECRET SPICE at your disposal, your snacks turn irresistible. Use it to gain the GRAPE GOURMAND buff! While it's active, even the most stubborn citizens cave the moment they taste your snack and they will hand over the max amount of pledges every single time. 

Track down the last holdouts in the Medieval Highlands and Candoria and gather their pledges to give your faction the edge in the Great Grape Debate!

entries.name: Donate PLEDGES at your faction's PLEDGE BOX
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 12/13: You've gathered quite the pile of PLEDGES from the citizens you've won over! Submit them at your faction's PLEDGE BOX to advance your faction's cause. The delegates may even show their thanks from time to time!

entries.name: Return to Qubesly
entries.description: HEALTHY FOOD VS JUNK FOOD 13/13: Trovian, what a showing! You swayed more citizens than anyone thought possible. The Great Grape Debate isn't truly settled, of course. Everyone's entitled to their own taste, and there's no shame in changing your mind down the road. But today, the side you chose stood tall. Come find me in the Hub so I can give a Title that properly suits you!

entries.name: Event: Shadows Eve
entries.description: To access the Shadows Eve Questline you must first complete "Complete a Delve Floor" in Qubesly's Tutorial Questline [HK:ActivityTracker]!

entries.name: Talk to Wolfsly in the EVENTS AREA in the HUB
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2026 1/17: Awooooo to you, Trovian! Shadow's Eve is here again, and the veil is thinner than I have ever smelled it. Come see me in the EVENTS AREA in the HUB and I'll tell you what we're up against this year.

entries.name: Meet the Lost Soul in the EVENTS area
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2026 2/17: Souls have been slipping through all over Trove this year, and one has wandered right into the Hub. Poor thing looks stuck. Talk to it and see if you can help in any way.

entries.name: Collect 25 LOST PAGES in ADVENTURE WORLDS
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 3/17: Hello Trovian. Sorry for bothering you. I cannot pass over to the other side while my book sits unfinished, and the pages have been scattered everywhere!

The pages can be found in Dungeon Chests all across Trove ADVENTURE WORLDS. Gather what you can and bring them back to me.

entries.name: Bind Lost Pages with the Lost Soul to complete the Unfinished Book
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 4/17: You found them! Oh heavens, thank you!

Come back to the Hub and I'll help put those pages together and then my finest work is finished at last. Then I can go, and I'll leave you some of my GHOSTLY LIGHT for the kindness.

entries.name: Talk to Fiona Catastra
entries.description: Shadow's Eve 2026 5/17: Greetings, Trovian. I saw you send that soul along its way. Really well done for someone still alive. Come closer. I have a great many souls to help and am burdened with being the only one to do it. Unless maybe you want to help?

entries.name: Find a Lost Soul to help in the CURSED VALE
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 6/17: There are so many of them this year, and not one of them can cross on their own. I worry for every last one.

A Hunter's soul drifts toward cursed ground to where they met their end. Find them in the CURSED VALE for me.

entries.name: Collect HUNTER MEMORIES in the CURSED VALE
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 7/17: Why hello, Trovian. It looks like I'm a ghost. I'm not sure who I was or what I did in my past life, but I know that I really don't like the Wolves around the Cursed Vale. I feel that my fate had something to do with these wolves, so perhaps that is where my memories can be found.

Defeat Wolves and Werewolf enemies in the CURSED VALE, and find Hunter's Memories that they may have.

entries.name: Return the HUNTER MEMORIES to help Lost Hunter's SOUL
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 8/17: That's it. I can feel my memories resonating with you.

Give them back to me and let me remember what I was, and what those wolves did. Whatever GHOSTLY LIGHT is left in me afterward is yours.

entries.name: Return to Fiona Catastra in the HUB
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 9/17: The Lost Soul recovered his memories and has now accepted his fate after finding out what those wolves did. He now is ready to face the afterlife.

Now return to me because I feel another soul may be calling to us.

entries.name: Find a Lost Soul in the FORBIDDEN SPIRES
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 10/17: As the herald of souls, I have an awareness of every soul in the mortal plane, and one of them is humming. It cries to play music.

This soul's life signature is in the FORBIDDEN SPIRES. Please help it.

entries.name: Collect 4 INSTRUMENT FRAGMENTS from PUMPKIN BOSSES
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 11/17: Oh pardon! I didn't know anyone was listening. I'm just a wandering soul looking for my favorite instrument. I was a musician, you see. I was playing to calm down some PUMPKIN CREATURES with my music, and then I forgot what happened next. My instrument must be wherever those creatures are.

Defeat PUMPKIN BOSSES which can be found in PUMPKIN DUNGEONS and gather the fragments for me.

entries.name: Repair the Instrument to help the Lost Soul
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 12/17: You have the pieces! Every last one! And I had given up hoping.

Find me and let's put it back together Trovian. Then I'll go, and my GHOSTLY LIGHT goes with you.

entries.name: Return to Fiona Catastra in the HUB
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 13/17: You saw what came for the souls? That was no accident of the veil, Trovian, and it was certainly not my doing.

Q'BTHULHU has been reaching across and taking my souls before they finish crossing. You can drive his creatures off, I have no doubt of that. But you cannot stand beside every soul in Trove. They cross alone, and they cross with nothing with them to fight the creatures off. So we need to arm them. Come to me at once!

entries.name: Interact with the GEARCRAFTING FORGE
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 14/17: I call it SOUL GEAR. Weapons forged out of GHOSTLY LIGHT and tempered with what is left of the souls Q'bthulhu has already spoiled. No living smith would know what to make of it.

Go and look over the Gearcrafting Forge. You and I will be spending a great deal of time there.

entries.name: Craft SOUL GEAR at the Gearcrafting Forge
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 15/17: SOUL GEAR asks for both GHOSTLY LIGHT and BAD SOUL ESSENCE.

The BAD SOULS are invading every Adventure World, but they gather thickest in the DRAGONFIRE PEAKS, the FROZEN TUNDRA, and the FAE WILDS. Take the bad essence from them so the good can be left to pass, then forge it!

entries.name: Arm 10 Lost Souls in ADVENTURE WORLDS with SOUL GEAR
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 16/17: Now go and put it in their hands, dear. Some have already been helped and need only the gear. Others still carry their troubles, and will need both.

Seek them out in the ADVENTURE WORLDS, give them SOUL GEAR, and stand with them when the dark creatures come. They will not always have someone like you watching their shoulder. Arm and protect as many as you can.

entries.name: Return to Fiona Catastra in the Hub
entries.description:
Shadow's Eve 2026 17/17: Purrrfect. They crossed on their own two feet, armed, and Q'bthulhu may gnash about it as much as he likes.

There is always more work to be done and always more Lost Souls out there, Trovian, so do keep at it. For now, come up one last time and collect what you have earned.
